I wish you the best of luck; you shall need every bit of it!
8955.objectivesText: Return to Deliana in Ironforge with a set of Devout Sandals, Devout Skirt and Devout Mantle.
8955.title: Anthion's Parting Words

8957.description: Valthalak's soul was stored in this amulet.  In our greed we foolishly split it into three parts, not knowing the curse that would await us.$B$BThe only way to stop Valthalak's spell is to put the amulet back together.  Return to Mokvar and tell him that Bodley is his only hope for finding the remaining pieces.  Speak to him about any rewards you've arranged for.$B$BI, for once, shall rest in peace.  I wish you the best of luck; you shall need every bit of it!
8957.objectivesText: Return to Mokvar in Orgimmar with a set of Boots of Elements, Kilt of Elements and Pauldrons of Elements.
8957.title: Anthion's Parting Words

8960.description: So we need to recover the rest of the medallion?  Finding Bodley's going to be a bit of a headache.  He went back to Blackrock Mountain to attempt to re-enter Blackrock Spire and never came back.$B$BI'd suggest taking the goblin's ghost revealing device with you, as I fear the worst might have happened.
8960.objectivesText: Travel to Blackrock Mountain and use the Extra-Dimensional Ghost Revealer to find Bodley near Blackrock Spire.
8960.title: Bodley's Unfortunate Fate

8961.description: In order to summon Lord Valthalak we're first going to need to gather the other two-thirds of the amulet. To do that we need to get a brazier and some special coals to burn in it.$B$BThere are three nobles of fire, Lord Incedius in Blackrock Depths, Pyroguard Emberseer in Blackrock Spire and Executor Asharell in the Steppes, with what we need. Collect from each a piece of their remains, and then return to me with a Hallowed Brazier, which can be purchased from the Argent Dawn if you are honored by them.
8961.objectivesText: Gather the Incendicite of Incendius, the Ember of Emberseer and the Ash of Asharell, along with a Hallowed Brazier, and return them to Bodley inside Blackrock Mountain.
8961.title: Three Kings of Flame

8964.description: $C, listen closely. Now that we have the brazier, and the means to light it, we still need another component to suffuse it with; something that will provide a focus strong enough to summon the remains of my deceased, former comrades.$B$BThe siblings, Jarien and Sothos, were believers in the way of the Scarlet Crusade. They aspired to knighthood within that vile organization. Go to Tyr's Hand in Eastern Plaguelands and retrieve a Brilliant Sword of Zealotry from the praetorians there.
8964.objectivesText: Retrieve a Brilliant Sword of Zealotry and return it to Bodley inside Blackrock Mountain.
8964.title: Components of Importance

8967.description: It became known to us in later days, as we were doing what we could ourselves to survive, that Isalien, a night elf priestess of our company, had gone to the night elvic ancestral city, now known as Dire Maul. From what we gathered, she went there both for personal reasons and also to unlock the secrets of the piece of the amulet that she had in her possession.$B$BShe didn't quite make it, though. Word got back to us that she was ambushed at the Shrine of Eldretharr by Alzzin the Wildshaper and his forces.
8967.objectivesText: Use the Brazier of Beckoning to summon forth the spirit of Isalien and slay her. Return to Bodley inside Blackrock Mountain with the Left Piece of Lord Valthalak's Amulet and the Brazier of Beckoning.
8967.title: The Left Piece of Lord Valthalak's Amulet

8978.description: It's been great working with you, $n.  Here is the finished product.$B$BI hope it helps you in your current endeavors.  And hey, if you don't mind, help spread the word.  I wouldn't mind having more customers!
8978.objectivesText: Return to Mokvar in Orgrimmar with the Extra-Dimensional Ghost Revealer.
8978.title: Return to Mokvar

8986.description: $C, listen closely. Now that we have the location of the last amulet piece, we still need another component to suffuse the brazier with; something that will provide a focus strong enough to entice the spirit of my deceased, former comrade.$B$BMor Grayhoof, our most prominent druid, had many close friends amongst the Cenarion Circle, some of which have fallen to the silithid. I need you to retrieve some Druidical Remains from the silithid that inhabit the environs of Hive'Regal in southeastern Silithus.
8986.objectivesText: Acquire Druidical Remains and return them to Bodley inside Blackrock Mountain.
8986.title: More Components of Importance

8988.description: $C, listen closely. Now that we have the location of the last amulet piece, we still need another component to suffuse the brazier with; something that will provide a focus strong enough to entice the spirit of my deceased, former comrade.$B$BAn ogre necromancer that traveled with us, Kormok, delighted in summoning forth the souls of the banished dead of Purgation Isle, off the south coast of the Hillsbrad Foothills. Go there and retrieve some Soul Ashes of the Banished from their remains.
8988.objectivesText: Obtain Soul Ashes of the Banished and return them to Bodley inside Blackrock Mountain.
8988.title: More Components of Importance

8990.description: It became known to us in later days, as we were doing what we could ourselves to survive, that Isalien, a night elf priestess of our company, had gone to the night elvic ancestral city, now known as Dire Maul. From what we gathered, she went there both for personal reasons and also to unlock the secrets of the piece of the amulet that she had in her possession.$B$BShe didn't quite make it, though. Word got back to us that she was ambushed at the Shrine of Eldretharr by Alzzin the Wildshaper and his forces.
8990.objectivesText: Use the Brazier of Beckoning to summon forth the spirit of Isalien and slay her. Return to Bodley inside Blackrock Mountain with the recombined Lord Valthalak's Amulet and the Brazier of Beckoning.
8990.title: The Right Piece of Lord Valthalak's Amulet

9003.description: That's an amazing story, $n! You have my thanks, and the heartfelt gratitude of all who were involved. Now maybe I'll be able to sleep at night with both eyes shut.$B$BAs to your reward, I believe I have a few things that you'll really enjoy.
9003.objectivesText: Give Deliana your Devout Crown and Devout Robe.
9003.title: Saving the Best for Last

9007.description: A truly amazing story, $n! You have my thanks, and the heartfelt gratitude of all who were involved, I can assure you. Through your efforts we are delivered from the mistakes of our past.$B$BAs to your reward, I believe I have a few things that you have definitely earned and will truly enjoy.
9007.objectivesText: Give Mokvar your Wildheart Cowl and Wildheart Vest.
9007.title: Saving the Best for Last

9015.description: Heed me well, $n.  For the banner to work in the desired way, you will need to step into the Ring of the Law in Blackrock Depths.  Allow yourself to be sentenced by High Justice Grimstone and place the banner firmly on the ground in a sign of defiance.$B$BYour victim will not be able to restrain himself and shall enter the fray filled with a desire to fight you.  Once you obtain that which you seek, go back to Anthion.
9015.objectivesText: Travel to the Ring of the Law in Blackrock Depths and place the Banner of Provocation in its center as you are sentenced by High Justice Grimstone.  Slay Theldren and his gladiators and return to Anthion Harmon in the Eastern Plaguelands with the first piece of Lord Valthalak's amulet.
9015.title: The Challenge

9017.description: Valthalak's soul was stored in this amulet.  In our greed we foolishly split it into three parts, not knowing the curse that would await us.$B$BThe only way to stop Valthalak's spell is to put the amulet back together.  Return to Mokvar and tell him that Bodley is his only hope for finding the remaining pieces.  Speak to him about any rewards you've arranged for.$B$BI, for once, shall rest in peace.  I wish you the best of luck; you shall need every bit of it!
9017.objectivesText: Return to Mokvar in Orgimmar with a set of Beaststalker's Boots, Beaststalker's Pants and Beaststalker's Mantle.
9017.title: Anthion's Parting Words

9032.description: The medallion contained Valthalak's soul?  It's no surprise it was guarded by such a powerful curse.$B$BLocating Bodley presents a bit of a problem.  Last time I heard of him, he was preparing to venture back into Blackrock Spire.  He was never heard of again.$B$BSeek him out in Blackrock Mountain, though I'm afraid to say he's probably dead by now.  I suggest taking the goblin's device with you, friend.
9032.objectivesText: Travel to Blackrock Mountain and use the Extra-Dimensional Ghost Revealer to find Bodley near Blackrock Spire.
9032.title: Bodley's Unfortunate Fate

9051.description: The toxin you helped me create is for a special purpose.  The great devilsaurs of the crater make it dangerous to hunt and difficult for me to survive.  Even if I possessed the necessary strength, killing a devilsaur simply allows another to move into its territory.$b$bTake this poisoned barb and stab it deep into a living devilsaur.  The toxin should pacify the creature, though I do not know how quickly...
9051.objectivesText: Stab a Devilsaur with the Devilsaur Barb. Return to Torwa Pathfinder in Un'Goro Crater when you have completed this task.
9051.title: Toxic Test

9052.description: I would ask you to help me create a toxin of sorts, to pacify a great creature living here in the crater.  It is not deadly, and only the keen eyes of a $c can hope to collect the ingredients.$b$bYou can find the bloodcap mushrooms growing within the bloodpetal sprouts all across the crater.  Gorishi stings are from the giant flying wasps inside and around the Slithering Scar, located in the southern part of the crater.
9052.objectivesText: Collect 8 Bloodcap and 8 Gorishi Stings, and return to Torwa Pathfinder in Un'Goro Crater.
9052.title: Bloodpetal Poison

9063.description: A hunter by the name of Torwa Pathfinder has requested the help of a druid.  He said only we would possess the necessary skills and respect for nature to help him.$b$bThere is a road that connects the Un'Goro Crater and the desert of Tanaris.  As that road enters the crater, you will find Torwa close by.
9063.objectivesText: Speak with Torwa Pathfinder in Un'Goro Crater.
9063.title: Torwa Pathfinder

9128.description: Greetings, adventurer! Are you interested in some work? I pay those under my employ with insignias. These insignias can be used at the Quartermaster to purchase items of power.$B$BAll I need you to do is bring me as many core of elements as you can carry. The more the better!$B$BYou'll find them on elementals of varying shapes and sizes that exist across our world.
9128.objectivesText: Archmage Angela Dosantos at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands wants 30 Core of Elements.
9128.title: The Elemental Equation

9153.description: The floating necropolises of the Scourge plague the lands of Horde and Alliance alike. Tanaris, the Blasted Lands, Winterspring and the Burning Steppes are blanketed in the shadows of the flying fortresses.$b$bOnly through our combined efforts will they be turned away.$b$bThe necropolises are supported by magical circles at various points in the invaded areas. We have determined that destroying the mindless hordes that surround these circles will destroy their defenses.
9153.objectivesText: Check your map to find an area under Scourge attack. Go there and damage a necropolis by defeating the Scourge around them. Return 10 of their Necrotic Runes to Commander Thomas Helleran at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands.
9153.title: Under the Shadow

9154.description: The Scourge have returned in greater numbers than we have seen before. The Argent Dawn is recruiting all willing and capable men and women to defend our lands.$b$bIf we share common cause, take this document to the Keeper of the Rolls at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands.
9154.objectivesText: Deliver the Call to Arms Announcement to the Keeper of the Rolls at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands.
9154.title: Light's Hope Chapel

9204.description: The bearer of this writ is entitled to payment in the form of an insignia of their choice upon completion of the contracted work order.$B$BWork Order FS-5:$B$B40 Stonescale Eel.$B$BAll filled orders should be delivered to Packmaster Stonebruiser at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands.$B$BContract is null and void if tampered with or damaged.$B$B-Dispatch Commander Metz, The Argent Dawn
9204.objectivesText: Deliver 40 Stonescale Eel and the Craftsman's Writ - Stonescale Eel - to Packmaster Stonebruiser at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands.
9204.title: Craftsman's Writ - Stonescale Eel

9250.description: With the frame formed, Atiesh is nearly whole. Only the head and base of the staff are now missing. There is also a minor issue regarding the staff being a conduit for Sargeras's evil.$B$BFind someone that can assist you in locating the remaining pieces and exorcising the evil from the staff.
9250.objectivesText: Find someone that will help you in recovering the last two pieces of the staff and ridding it of evil.
9250.title: Frame of Atiesh

9261.description: The Scourge is camped upon our very doorstep; we cannot remain idle! Surely you will step up to defend Ironforge from these accursed invaders? $b $bThere are strange runic circles outside, glowing with the same energy that surrounds the undead and the Necropolis above. They have significance, I'm certain, and I want you to find out what. Thin the numbers of those aberrations while you're at it; bring me proof of their death along with your results, and I will reward you.  Go!
9261.objectivesText: Collect three Dim Necrotic Stones from the Scourge outside Ironforge and investigate the glowing runic circles nearby their encampment.
9261.title: Investigate the Scourge of Ironforge

9292.description: On the corpse of the fallen abomination, you discover a cracked crystal, slowly pulsing with necrotic energy.
9292.objectivesText: Bring the Cracked Necrotic Crystal to Lieutenant Orrin outside the gates of Stormwind.
9292.title: Cracked Necrotic Crystal

9299.description: You found this letter on one of the many Scourge minions you've slain. From its appearance and smell, it has been with the undead for some time. Perhaps someone at Light's Hope Chapel would be interested in examining it further...
9299.objectivesText: Take the Careworn Note to the Keeper of the Rolls at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands.
9299.title: Note from the Front

9304.description: You found this letter on one of the many Scourge minions you've slain. From its appearance and smell, it has been with the undead for some time. Perhaps someone at Light's Hope Chapel would be interested in examining it further...
9304.objectivesText: Take the Smudged Document to the Keeper of the Rolls at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands.
9304.title: Document from the Front

9322.description: The Midsummer Fire Festival is celebrated everywhere in Azeroth, and the diverse land of Kalimdor is no exception. You look fit to travel -- perhaps a journey is in order.$b$bMidsummer cannot be truly appreciated unless you've seen the blistering blue fires abroad. The celebrants have lit fires in chilly western Winterspring, northeastern Azshara, near Valor's Rest in the wastes of Silithus, and by the entrance to lush Un'Goro. Return once your journey is complete.
9322.objectivesText: Visit the Midsummer camps located in Azshara, Silithus, Un'Goro Crater, and Winterspring, then return to the Festival Flamekeeper.
9322.title: Wild Fires in Kalimdor

9324.description: This flame, stolen from the heart of Orgrimmar itself, floods you with warmth. This raw power is foreign to you, but the Loremaster might know more...
9324.objectivesText: Return the Flame of Orgrimmar to the Festival Loremaster.
9324.title: Stealing Orgrimmar's Flame

9325.description: This flame, stolen from the shaman of Thunder Bluff, floods you with warmth. This raw power is foreign to you, but the Loremaster might know more...
9325.objectivesText: Return the Flame of Thunder Bluff to the Festival Loremaster.
9325.title: Stealing Thunder Bluff's Flame

9326.description: This flame, stolen from the ruins above the Undercity, floods you with warmth. This raw power is foreign to you, but the Loremaster might know more...
9326.objectivesText: Return the Flame of the Undercity to the Festival Loremaster.
9326.title: Stealing the Undercity's Flame

9364.description: My research has revealed a unique purpose for the prismatic shell.$b$bCarry the shell and cast your polymorph spell on the Spitelash in Azshara.  If you wait a few moments, the chaotic aura of the shell will cause them to split into several smaller clones for a few moments.  Kill these clones as quickly as possible, and the shell will collect their essence.$b$bWhen the shell is full, return it to me.
9364.objectivesText: Polymorph the Spitelash of Azshara and kill the clones that appear several seconds later.  When you have slain 50 Polymorph Clones, return to Archmage Xylem in Azshara.
9364.title: Fragmented Magic

9367.description: Midsummer is upon us once again!$b$bEach year, as tradition dictates, Flamekeepers are chosen to tend the bonfires within our capitals. While fires are burning throughout Azeroth, it is imperative that ours be the hottest and brightest, to properly pay homage to the season.$b$bIn fact, I have a task for you, if you don't mind. I've not yet heard if the fires in all capitals are properly burning. Travel there yourself and warm yourself by the fires--make sure they're hot!
9367.objectivesText: Touch the bonfires within Stormwind, Ironforge, and Darnassus, then speak to a Festival Loremaster within the capital cities.
9367.title: The Festival of Fire

9368.description: Midsummer is upon us once again!$b$bEach year, as tradition dictates, Flamekeepers are chosen to tend the bonfires within our capitals. While fires are burning throughout Azeroth, it is imperative that ours be the hottest and brightest, to properly pay homage to the season.$b$bIn fact, I have a task for you, if you don't mind. I've not yet heard if the fires in all capitals are properly burning. Travel there yourself and warm yourself by the fires--make sure they're hot!
9368.objectivesText: Touch the bonfires within Orgrimmar, Thunder Bluff, and the Undercity, then speak to a Festival Talespinner within the capital cities.
9368.title: The Festival of Fire

9388.description: There are many flames burning throughout the world today, $n. The trickiest fires to tend are those that burn green; they do not stay lit long without supervision. Make certain the emerald fires still burn on Kalimdor for our Flamekeeper, eh?$b$bYou will find them near Ratchet in the Barrens, close to the Master's Glaive in Darkshore, in the forest of Ashenvale by the bridge near Silverwing Outpost, and near the road to Windshear Crag along the main road in Stonetalon Mountains.
9388.objectivesText: Visit the bonfires within Ashenvale, the Barrens, Darkshore, and Stonetalon Mountains, then speak with the Festival Flamekeeper.
9388.title: Flickering Flames in Kalimdor

9415.description: Are you Marshal Bluewall's new recruits? Of course you are.$b$bWhat are you waiting for? Good soldiers are dying in the desert. Aren't you excited to join them?$b$bNow, get going and don't dry out on the way.
9415.objectivesText: Speak with Marshal Bluewall at the Alliance encampment near Hive'Zora.
9415.title: Report to Marshal Bluewall

9416.description: You must be one of General Kirika's new recruits. It's about time you showed up. Bodies wear down quick in the desert.$b$bThe dwarves have been getting reinforcements daily, and we can't afford to lose ground in our struggle for resources in Silithus.$b$bGet your instructions from the General. It's not my job to train you, just find you.
9416.objectivesText: Speak with General Kirika at the Horde encampment near Hive'Regal.
9416.title: Report to General Kirika

9664.description: Welcome to the Plaguelands, $n. As you know, the Forsaken and their allies hold the lands to the west of here against our best efforts. The Alliance commanders have decided that here in the east, we will establish new fortifications to tighten the noose around our enemies.$b$bTowers long abandoned since the days of Lordaeron are to be seized and rebuilt for this purpose. These lands are dangerous, and we could use your help.
9664.objectivesText: Capture Crown Guard Tower, Eastwall Tower, Northpass Tower and Plaguewood Tower in the Eastern Plaguelands, then return to Emmisary Whitebeard at Light's Hope Chapel.
9664.title: Establishing New Outposts

65593.description: An incubus will be drawn to the hearts of lovers, and the most aching love will create the most irresistible lure.$b$bMy scrying has revealed two that should serve exceptionally.$b$bIn Silverpine Forest, Avelina Lilly provides her tailoring services to the fallen wizards at Ambermill. In the Barrens, Isaac Pearson hopes to make his mark in the seaside town of Ratchet.$b$bThey toil on opposite ends of the world, yet their hearts yearn only for each other. Bring those hearts to Carendin.
65593.objectivesText: Bring the hearts of Avelina Lilly and Isaac Pearson to Carendin Halgar in the Temple of the Damned.
65593.title: Hearts of the Lovers

65601.description:
A sayaad male is known as an incubus. A creature of profound evil and singular mind.

The demon must be lured into our world with an item of enticement - an object that represents great love and devotion.

If you trust a blind man to lead you, $n, then listen. East from the Cleft of Shadow, along the main drag of Orgrimmar, lives Magar. He longs for the return of his mate, Krilge.

Seek him out. He'll ask you to search for something precious. That is the key which you must bring to Gan'rul.
65601.title: Love Hurts

65603.description:
The time has come. Take the figurine and descend into the crypts below. A summoning circle has been prepared, and you must place the figurine at its center.

Then the gateway will open, and the incubus will cross into our world.

A sayaad is not to be underestimated. The demon will not hesitate to attack when it realizes your ruse. You must draw upon all you have been taught to defeat it.

If you succeed, return to me and I shall bind the creature to your will. Fail, and your soul is forfeit.
65603.objectivesText: Using the Wooden Figurine, summon and subdue an incubus, then return the Wooden Figurine to Gakin the Darkbinder in the Slaughtered Lamb.
65603.title: The Binding

76240.description:
I have one last idea that may lead us to success. I still feel there is hidden talent in you, but let us try and coax it out with a less direct approach.

Go and procure a Raw Brilliant Smallfish, then bring it back here. Use these daggers to clean and fillet it. Do not think too hard - do what comes naturally.
76240.objectivesText: Buy or catch a Raw Brilliant Smallfish, then use the Knife Set to fillet it in front of Boarton Shadetotem in Thunder Bluff.
76240.title: Stalk With The Earthmother

conditionalDescriptions.text:
<The mysterious orb you hold fills you with cold dread. You can almost hear a voice echo faintly in your mind. Low and guttural, you understand well that the language being spoken is demonic in nature. 

Even as a paladin, this magic is beyond you. Delgren the Purifier might be able to help you discern the nature of this sinister object.>

78088.description:
<The mysterious orb you hold fills you with cold dread. You can almost hear a voice echo faintly in your mind. Low and guttural, you understand well that the language being spoken is demonic in nature. 

Even as a paladin, this magic is beyond you. Find a more senior paladin here in Kalimdor who might be able to help you discern the nature of this sinister object.>
78088.objectivesText: Bring the Althalaxx Orb to Delgren the Purifier at Maestra's Post in Ashenvale.
78088.title: A Strange Artifact

78090.description:
I'm not sure what to make of this orb, $n. I think we will need the help of... a specialist.

We are aware of a warlock sect operating out of Stormwind. Officially we reject the presence of warlocks in the city. Unofficially, their knowledge can be of use when dealing with demonic forces.

Find a representative of these warlocks, and seek their opinion on the orb.
78090.objectivesText: Find the warlock sanctum within Stormwind and seek advice on the orb.
78090.title: A Second Opinion

78676.description:
<A note sits in the chest>

Glad to have you back, $n.

The latest object of my desire is an artifact known as the Eye of Bhossca. My sources tell me the eye is somewhere within the Scarlet Monastery. As with Shadowfang Keep, you must infiltrate the monastery alone.

It may behoove you to find a disguise before going in. It will make getting around a touch easier. I'm sure you could find something on the monastery's grounds.

Return the eye here, and payment will be delivered as before.

- C
78676.objectivesText: Find The Eye of Bhossca inside of the Scarlet Monastery. Then, return it to C's dead drop near Pyrewood Village. You must complete the job alone.
78676.title: The Eye of Bhossca

78830.description:
This drawing reminds me of a story I'd heard on another expedition, not long ago. I was told of a great bird, Gharrik, who reigns over the Badlands as an apex predator.

She was last spotted northeast of Camp Cagg. Perhaps her nest is somewhere nearby?

You'll need live bait to draw her out. I'll lend you a cage to catch some. Small wildlife is scarce in the Badlands, so you'll need to find your bait elsewhere.

A quill from Gharrik would make a fine prize. You'd certainly be the talk of the camp.
78830.objectivesText: Get a Crimson Trophy Quill from Gharrik in the Badlands. Then, return to Hemet Nesingwary in Stranglethorn Vale.
78830.title: Terror of the Desert Skies

78916.description: The dread beast Aku'mai lies dead.  Hidden amongst the viscera and gore of its swollen corpse is an enormous iridescent pearl teeming with raw Void energy.
78916.objectivesText: Bring the Blackfathom Pearl to Dawnwatcher Selgorm in Darnassus.
78916.title: The Heart of the Void

79007.description:
<The faint radiance of the embers darkening, you stumble across the remnants of a recent fire.

Amidst the scattered provisions, you discover a blistered note.>

"Not all that burns is lost. Find the twin land, find the place."
79007.objectivesText: Charred remains of the note serve as your only guide.
79007.title: ... and that note you found

79093.title: Rumi of Gnomeregan: The Collected Works

79192.description: The note begins, "Mission said they were both making deliveries for New Plague. Looks like simple apothecary accidents to me. Find my cozy spot in the mountains between The Barrens and Desolace if you want a safe place to talk."
79192.objectivesText: You tear the note from the plank and read the scrawled writing.
79192.title: Stepping Stones

79229.description:
The campsite before you is a grisly scene. Judging by the remains, the victims were two humans and a dwarf. Markings on the bones indicate a savage attack, but the looted supplies tell you this wasn't done by an animal. The wounds don't match centaur weaponry either.

Perhaps an experienced scavenger of these lands would know what to make of this.
79229.objectivesText: Find someone in Desolace who knows about the pillaged campsite.
79229.title: Highway Robbery

79235.description:
I've found a couple of scenes like you describe, $n. Always camps of humans and dwarves. Rumor among the caravans is a group of Horde marauders did it. Seems likely given the victims, and how brutal the attacks were.

Apparently the bandits fled Desolace once an Alliance marshal got hot on their trail.

If you're looking to track one of 'em down, I'd check Booty Bay. Ports always have shady characters coming and going. You might catch one trying to get a boat to somewhere.
79235.objectivesText: Find one of the Desolace marauders.
79235.title: On the Lam

79364.completionText: Speak with Prate Cloudseer in Thousand Needles.
79364.description:
The note you found says the Razormane have burrowed into the Thousand Needles for some sort of unseen ritual. Raging storms and rising tides...

The quilboar must be using some cruel sorcery they learned from Hirzek, a shaman who went to great lengths to twist the elements. If they plan to flood the canyon, this would require devastating elemental powers.

We are ill equipped to deal with this, but a powerful shaman like you must have an idea. Return to your allies and see if you can't find an answer.
79364.objectivesText: Speak with Prate Cloudseer in Thousand Needles.
79364.title: Eyes on the Sky

79677.description:
Other ogres laugh at Skonk because Skonk smaller than them. They say small ogre weak, so Skonk learn to cook instead of fight. This only cause more teasing, so Skonk run away to follow dream.

Skonk can make dish, but need ingredients. You take note. Find ingredients. Skonk more focused on craft; not really logistics guy.
79677.objectivesText: Gather the ingredients for Skonk's dish, then bring them to him in Arathi Highlands
79677.title: A Quick Grocery Run

79949.title: A Web of Lies: Debunking Myths and Legends

79951.title: Mummies: A Guide to the Unsavory Undead

79974.description:
"Always like to keep a reserve stash nearby in the off chance I've got to flee in a hurry.

The face of this mountainside is so beautiful you might say it was carved from the waterfalls of time. 
That's the eagles nest, that's what you're looking for."
79974.objectivesText: Dusting off a messenger bag emerging from the soil, you find a parchment nestled among the supplies.
79974.title: Wet Job

79975.description:
<You find a carefully folded letter inside of the toolbox.>

"From here, with the right tools, you call the shots. Great place to launch a parachute glider.

My loyalty to the Eagle and Fist requires distance in order to serve them best. This barricade has had better days, like the Old Kingdoms it once defended, but I'll never abandon it."
79975.objectivesText: Water spray dampens the air, the view is incredible.
79975.title: Eagle's Fist

79976.description:
"So, I've decided to take my work back underground. To stop it falling into the wrong hands."

<The paper is torn just large enough to fit the message. You aren't sure if these are the last words you'll read from the author, or if they're a clue to the next hideout. An inadequately secured sleeping bag is unrolling itself onto your feet...>
79976.objectivesText: Whoever was here, you just missed them.
79976.title: This Must Be The Place

79980.description: "Not so bad, eh? Since you're reading this, it means my stash is still there. Take a hundred paces due north and don't break your ankles going down the steep cliffside. There should be enough to keep you going."
79980.title: Scramble

80453.description:
Take the talisman down to Zan Shivsprocket, in the basement. I've asked him to rig the artifact with a mechanism that will detect any attempt to channel magic energy into, or out of, it.

The mechanism is all but invisible to the naked eye, and will detonate when triggered. With any luck, Caius will be killed in the blast. At the very least, his plans for the talisman will be foiled.
80453.objectivesText: Bring the Talisman of Kazdor to Zan Shivsprocket in the basement of Ravenholdt Manor.
80453.title: Best Laid Plans

80455.description: The job is done. Better return to Ravenholdt and notify Fahrad.
80455.objectivesText: Report back to Fahrad at Ravenholdt Manor.
80455.title: Biding Our Time

80526.description:
Not a moment too soon, $n
 
The manor has been keeping tabs on this "C" character you've been dealing with. 
 
C's true identity is Caius Blackwood; a powerful magic user working with the Syndicate. Our sources say he has been gathering artifacts for an unknown purpose. Only recently did we discover *you* were the one providing them.
 
Caius must be stopped, and I believe the onus of doing so falls on you. Fortunately, I've devised a plan. Come speak to me when you're ready to clear your name.
80526.objectivesText: Speak to Fahrad when you're ready to hear his plan.
80526.title: Fool Me Twice

81570.description: I have cutting to do.  I can't tell you what I'm going to cut, but... I need myself a blade.  A certain blade...$B$BSome people call it a moonsteel broadsword.  I call it a swing blade.$B$BYou help me?  Maybe you find it in town, maybe you talk to a blacksmith and he'll make it special.$B$BBut don't sleep on this.  What I'm cutting won't keep forever...
81570.objectivesText: Bring a Moonsteel Broadsword to Jarl in Dustwallow Marsh.
81570.title: Jarl Needs a Blade

81732.description: While these demons distract us here, the Emerald Dream is being corrupted into nightmare. Quick, travel through the Emerald Dream Portal in the Twilight Grove, and journey to the Nightmare Incursion at the Yorgen Farmstead. Defeat dragonkin there and return to me.
81732.objectivesText: Defeat 3 Wyrmkin Terrorwalkers and 10 Nightterror Whelps in the Duskwood Nightmare Incursion at the Yorgen Farmstead and return to Field Captain Palandar.
81732.title: Duskwood Mission III: Defeat Dragonkin

81733.description: While these demons distract us here, the Emerald Dream is being corrupted into nightmare. Quick, travel through the Emerald Dream Portal in the Twilight Grove, and journey to the Nightmare Incursion at the Vul'gol Ogre Mound. Retrieve an intelligence report from Dreamwarden Thalinar there and return to me.
81733.objectivesText: Gather intelligence from Dreamwarden Thalinar in the Duskwood Nightmare Incursion deep inside the Vul'gol Ogre Mound and return to Field Captain Palandar.
81733.title: Duskwood Mission IV: Ogre Intelligence

81735.description: While these demons distract us here, the Emerald Dream is being corrupted into nightmare. Quick, travel through the Emerald Dream Portal in the Twilight Grove, and journey to the Nightmare Incursion at the Yorgen Farmstead . Retrieve an intelligence report from Dreamwarden Amalia there and return to me.
81735.objectivesText: Gather intelligence from Dreamwarden Amalia in the Duskwood Nightmare Incursion in the farmhouse at the Yorgen Farmstead and return to Field Captain Palandar.
81735.title: Duskwood Mission VI: Dragon Intelligence

81736.description: While these demons distract us here, the Emerald Dream is being corrupted into nightmare. Quick, travel through the Emerald Dream Portal in the Twilight Grove, and journey to the Nightmare Incursion at the Rotting Orchard. Retrieve a powerful artifact known as the Shadowscythe and deliver it to me.
81736.objectivesText: Recover the Shadowscythe in the Duskwood Nightmare Incursion upstairs in the farmhouse at the Rotting Orchard and return to Field Captain Palandar.
81736.title: Duskwood Mission VII: Recover Shadowscythe

81739.description: While these demons distract us here, the Emerald Dream is being corrupted into nightmare. Quick, travel through the Emerald Dream Portal in the Twilight Grove and collect Nightmare Moss from within the Nightmare Incursions. We can harness its magic to reverse the damage. You will need the assistance of an herbalist.

I know of a ritual that may be able to destabilize the orb and allow us to destroy it, but it requires components with specific magical significance. We already possess some of the required materials, but you'll need to retrieve the rest. 

Take this, it should help you in your search.
81790.objectivesText: Use the hints in Gregory's Note to determine where to find the magical components needed for the ritual. You will need help from allies for this.
81790.title: Materials of Significance

81885.description:
I wanted to thank you for your efforts, $n. Without you, I'd likely be dead and the servants of the legion would still have possession of this dangerous artifact. I know its difficult to trust an agent of the Lich King, but it is my hope that after this is over we can sway my friend back to the light. It's clear that the man I cared for is still in there. He may only need a nudge.

Come now, we are needed by Gregory to help him complete the ritual. Let us speak again when it's done.
81885.objectivesText: Speak with Gregory to begin the ritual.
81885.title: The Ritual

81924.description:
Whatever Kaldorei knowledge you seek will not be found among these ruins, $c. Not anymore.

However, while the physical lies in ruin, the spiritual remains.

Seek the guardian spirits of Azshara, the Hinterlands, and Feralas. You will know them by their shrines. Prove yourself to them, and heed their words. Their wisdom will be passed on to you, so that it will not be lost to time as so much was here.
81924.objectivesText: Prove yourself to the guardian spirits of Feralas, Azshara, and the Hinterlands, then return to Tyrisius in Feralas.
81924.title: Wisdom of the Guardians

82062.description:
Had to be sure we could trust you. These kind of friends are hard to come by. 

There's a malignancy growing, a sinister faction within Azeroth. Both the Horde and Alliance are unwittingly working towards their own ends. Slowing their advances and forming information networks are all we have resources for.

Take this, raise your spirits, and harken back to better days. There will be a time soon where we need our bolstered numbers for a show of force.
82062.title: Ever After

82084.description:
Your progress in the arcane arts has been exemplary, $n. I think you are ready to author a spellbook of your own.

Let's see... a quill from the Owlbeasts of the Hinterlands, and ink derived from silithid resin... yes, that will do. And for the pages, the finest Farraki Papyrus!
82084.objectivesText: Track down and collect the spellbook materials requested by the librarian.
82084.title: A Lesson in Literacy

82135.description: <Aeonas says nothing, he merely hands you the orb and turns away>

82657.description: Wild Leather vests are the staple of any Wild Leather armor set.  The frame of the vest blends with the wildvine to produce a product that offers maximum protection of the torso while allowing for the potent magic to work its way through the garment.$B$BFor this pattern, I will require two Turtle Scale breastplates, two sets of Turtle Scale gloves, and a wildvine.  It's a tall order, but one you should have little difficulty in filling for me.
82657.objectivesText: Bring 2 Turtle Scale Breastplates, 2 Turtle Scale Gloves, and a Wildvine to Pratt McGrubben in Feathermoon Stronghold.
82657.title: Wild Leather Vest

82662.description: As a weaponsmith you'll find that more often than not, heroes and adventurers will be coming to you for gear. While the workload can be unbearable at times, the riches more than make up for the back strain and ash lung.$B$BOh yes, $n, weaponsmiths are the ones with all the gold!$B$BIf you wish to join our ranks, you'll need to show me that you can make me a silver or two - I mean, show me that you've got what it takes to be the go to $g guy:girl; when people need superior quality weapons. Get to work!
82662.objectivesText: To become a Weaponsmith, you must make the following items and return them to Ironus: 4 Moonsteel Broadswords, 4 Massive Iron Axes, 2 Heavy Mithril Axes, and 2 Big Black Maces.
82662.title: The Way of the Weaponsmith

83934.description: Heya! You look like the "resourceful adventurer" type so maybe you can help me out. See, my brothers and I came from Kezan looking to start up a new business venture but we ran afoul of some pirates who stole our startup money. The people who are funding our operation back home aren't exactly what I'd call understanding, so we'd make it worth your while if are able to find any of the coin and return it. It's no ordinary gold but you should know it when you see it.
83934.objectivesText: Bring a Tarnished Undermine Real to Pix Xizzix in Booty Bay.
83934.title: Show Me the Money!

84138.description:
I'm the chief engineer, founder and lead researcher of the Deepsea Exploration and Liquefaction Technologies Alliance. I've nearly finished my latest experiment, and I need your help! I am working on a special device to geolocate resource-rich dimensions.

To complete my construction, I need something back: a book of arcane formulas that I lent to an old colleague of mine, Nami, who continues her work in Winterspring.

Retrieve the book for me and you'll be included as a published contributor!
84138.objectivesText: Explain the book situation to Doctor Jurgens' colleague, Nami, in Winterspring.
84138.title: Frosty Favors

84147.description: Well met, $c.  I've something that might interest you.$B$BI have in my possession a set of armor much like the one worn by those of your profession, but of much higher quality.  I'd be willing to trade the bracers for ordinary ones in exchange for a small favor.$B$BThe blood of the frostsabers and bears that inhabit Winterspring has properties I'm in need of at the moment.  Bring me a sizeable sample of it along with the bracers and a small amount of gold.  You shall find the effort worth your while.
84147.objectivesText: Acquire 15 Winterspring Blood Samples and 20 gold and bring them along with a set of Wildheart Bracers to Deliana in Ironforge.
84147.title: An Earnest Proposition

84159.description: Hail, $c!  I can tell by your demeanor that you've seen and done much in this world.  Yet I'm willing to wager you haven't seen a piece of armor like this.$B$BPerform a small favor for me and I'll be willing to trade it to you for an ordinary set of bracers.$B$BI'm in need of a sizeable sample of venom drawn from the spiders and scorpions that inhabit Silithus.  Bring this to me along with a few gold coins and I'll perform the exchange.
84159.objectivesText: Acquire 15 Silithus Venom Samples and 20 gold and bring them along with a set of Shadowcraft Bracers to Mokvar in Orgrimmar.
84159.title: An Earnest Proposition

In our greed we foolishly split it into three parts, not knowing the curse that would await us.$B$BThe only way to stop Valthalak's spell is to put the medallion back together.  Return to Deliana and tell her that Bodley is her only hope for finding the remaining pieces.  Speak to her about any rewards you've arranged for.$B$BI, for once, shall rest in peace.  I wish you the best of luck; you shall need every bit of it!

84212.objectivesText: Return to the D.E.L.T.A lab with the book Jurgens was looking for.
84212.title: Bookin' it Back

84213.description:
Join me in this historic experiment and witness the wonders of my invention! I've calculated two locations with suitable geothermic bioflux energy. With manual-auto-locking phasers, I'm ready to send us to the coordinates within compatible regions.

Once you're at compatible coordinates, use this remote transponder to send the signal to me. I'll configure the warp transmitter to fold the space between here, and there.

What I'm saying is, I'll meet you there when you say you're ready!
84213.objectivesText:
Use the Distant Communication Device to send the signal to Jurgens at either Tirisfal Glades or Westfall
Then, assist him in demonstrating the capabilities of his elecro transmitter.
84213.title: Rift Away

84318.description:
Oi! $c! Yes, ye! Ye did me a solid by smashing up that depressin' mess of a meatsuit I've been riding in all these years, but I dinnae feel much of a pull to move on. I'm expectin' it's because I got some "Unfinished Business" to get up to 'afore I can be on me way. Well dull-wit, ye just been conscripted to help!

I need ye to fetch me hammer. Should be somewhere in Corrin's Crossing and it'll be hard to miss. 

Oi, take this too. It's me favorite gold tooth. Give it a rub when you've found me weapon.
84318.objectivesText: Find Orthas' missing hammer in Corrin's Crossing.
84318.title: Oi!

84330.description:
So ye see, we need to find a suitable Dwarf corpse and do a bit o' ritual to em' to get my spirit grounded so I can be sent on me way! All perfectly normal stuff, o' course! We'll also need a bit o' Necrotic Runestone from a necromancer type, of course. There's one in Stratholme that goes by Maleki the Pallid. Can't expect he'll be too willin' to part with it willingly but there's a solve for that!

Get me that stone and then head to the undercroft. There's a corpse there that'll do!
84330.objectivesText: Obtain a Necrotic Runestone from Maleki the Pallid in Stratholme, then find the Rotting Dwarf Corpse near the Undercroft in southwestern Eastern Plaguelands.
84330.title: A Wee Bit O' Necromancy

86585.description:
The fallen mountaineer bears a standard of Ironforge. Perhaps she was scouting, or making a doomed charge. Either way, the standard has been cast down and trampled. The mountaineer was hit on the head so hard that her helm was knocked off and she was killed outright by a trogg, likely with a spiked club.

The trogg that killed her is probably still nearby, and likely remembers the banner. Raising the banner of Ironforge once more may call it out.
86585.objectivesText: Raise the standard of Ironforge, call out the trogg Headsplitter and kill it, then report to Captain Rugelfuss.
86585.title: Banner of the Fallen

86611.description:
<The pool of fetid slime has eroded the statue of the stag. It is unclear how it arrived here at the bottom of the lake.

A single crystal stone set in a medallion around its neck bears an unwholesome green gleam. It is worth taking to someone who might know the history of this monument.>
86611.objectivesText: Take the Stag Lord's Bauble to someone in Talonbranch Glade who may know about it.
86611.title: Stag Lord's Bauble

86616.description:
As a shaman, one of the challenges of communing with the elements is that there are other shaman with opposing agendas. The elements do not care why we do what we do, they just do as we ask!

The trolls at Jintha'alor also practice the shamanic arts, and their interruptions and attacks are a constant thorn to us here.

Find their Vilebranch totems and bring them back to me so that I can nullify their powers. Some they carry, some they place as wards around their altar.
86616.objectivesText: Bring $1oa Vilebranch Totems back to Maret Firetend.
86616.title: Repurposed Totems

86792.description:
The satyr within the Legashi stronghold are even more fearsome than those of the outer camps. When our party was discovered, we found ourselves overwhelmed.

One of us was slain, and another captured. I was the only one able to successfully retreat. I cannot return to Rageroar with my head hung in shame, but I cannot fight the Legashi alone, either.

I ask you, then, to assist me in weakening the satyr's forces. Go into their stronghold and slay them.
86792.objectivesText: Kill $1oa Legashi Hellraisers, $2oa Legashi Soulstealers, and $3oa Legashi Blackguards for Korsa outside Legashi Stronghold.
86792.title: Thinning Their Forces

86796.areaDescription: Help Graal break out of Legashi Stronghold
86796.description:
You there, $r!

These fiends ambushed my scouting party, and have taken me captive. I don't know what plans they have for me, but I don't intend to find out. I must escape and return to Ursolan; no doubt Korsa is worried about me.

While I would love to break out of this cage and leave a trail of satyr corpses in my wake, I'm afraid I'm slightly outnumbered.

Perhaps you share my hatred for the fiends, and would help me escape?
86796.objectivesText: Help Graal break out of Legashi Stronghold, then inform Korsa outside Legashi Stronghold.
86796.title: Later, Satyr

86797.description:
With the Legashi stronghold weakened, we can return to Ursolan in honor.

Go ahead of me, and inform Gatekeeper Rageroar of the situation here.
86797.objectivesText: Return to Gatekeeper Rageroar at Ursolan.
86797.title: Return to Rageroar

86798.description:
With the satyr weakened, now is the time to mount a counter-offensive. Prince Halanox, commander of the Legashi Stronghold, will be our target. However, we still lack the numbers to face him head-on.

Since the Legashi drove us out we have been cut off from the furbolgs of Timbermaw Hold. We could call upon them for reinforcements, but we will need an emissary. You will be that emissary, $n.

Go to Timbermaw Hold and find a furbolg named Gorn One Eye. He will provide us with the soldiers we need.
86798.objectivesText: Speak to Gorn One Eye in Timbermaw Hold and ask him to provide reinforcements.
86798.title: Timbermaw Reinforcements

86799.description:
<Furze lets loose an ugly, hacking, cough.>

Hear me, $r, I haven't much strength to speak. I am stricken by an illness unlike any I have ever known. It is as if my blood itself is aflame, and my very essence is coming undone. I can hardly move, much less fetch help.

Please, go find Elder Bramblesnap. Her tent is just northwest of here. She will know what to do.
86799.objectivesText: Speak to Elder Bramblesnap about Furze's illness.
86799.title: Encroaching Corruption

86812.description:
I have transmuted the firewater into a tincture which I believe will be the key to undoing the Legashi's corruption. Eager as I am to ease the suffering of the Blackmaw, it must be tested.

I have seen many of the coursers and skystormers east of Ursolan suffering from the satyr's corruption. They will serve as our test subjects.

Go, and test my would-be cure on the afflicted beasts. Before giving the tincture the beast must be weakened to ensure it can be administered with little resistance.
86812.objectivesText: Use the Satyrweed Tincture on $1oa Mosshoof Coursers or Thunderhead Skystormers after weakening them.
86812.title: Transmuted Tincture

86813.description:
I must say, $c. I have not felt this optimistic in some time. This tincture could be the panacea that saves us from the satyr's ever-expanding blight. Even if we remain in these camps for the rest of our lives we will stand strong and free of corruption.

Go to Furze and give him this panacea. He has suffered for long enough. Return to me to report any findings.
86813.title: Potential Panacea

86925.description:
It appears this cauldron could be used to brew the firewater that Elder Bramblesnap is after.

If only you knew how. Surely, one of the satyr in the Legashi Encampment must carry a recipe.
86925.objectivesText: Find a Legashi Firewater Recipe from satyr in the Legashi Encampment.
86925.title: Toil and Trouble

86926.description:
The recipe reads:

Harvest ye the sprout of hell
bushel o' five will serve ye well
mixed with mote of demon's power
shall usher in their final hour
86926.objectivesText: Bring $1oa Satyrweed and a Fel Mote to the Legashi Cauldron in the Legashi Encampment.
86926.title: Felfire Burn, Cauldron Bubble

87346.description:
When the Legashi overran the Blackmaw, the rest of the Timbermaw sealed their passage to the hold to keep out the satyr. We had no idea they lived on as refugees.

I would gladly aid my brethren, but we are fighting our own battles. Like the Legashi threaten the Blackmaw, the Deadwood do likewise to us. We haven't many warriors to spare.

The Deadwood chieftain, Bloodmaw, is in Felpaw Village to the south. Eliminating him would greatly ease our struggle. Bring me his mace, and you will have our aid.
87346.objectivesText: Kill Chieftain Bloodmaw and bring his mace to Gorn One Eye in Timbermaw Hold.
87346.title: Chieftain Bloodmaw

88857.areaDescription: Help Keldara Sunblade escape the Haldarr Encampment
88857.description:
<The sentinel speaks in a low whisper>

Listen, $c, before they hear us. I am a sentinel from Talrendis Point. The satyr here believe me injured, but I am only feigning; waiting for the moment they drop their guard and I can escape.

Your arrival is perhaps such a moment.

Help me out of here, would you?
88857.objectivesText: Help Keldara Sunblade escape the Haldarr Encampment, then speak to Commander Truesong at Talrendis Point.
88857.title: Saving a Sentinel

89001.description:
Greetings traveller!

If yer lookin' for a place to hang yer hat, look no further than Berdun's travel lodge! The tent's in a bit o' disrepair right now, but that can be remedied.

Tell ye what. If ye get me what I need to fix the tent, I'll let ye stay here for free. How's that sound?

I'll need some mosshoof hides. The easiest to hunt mosshooves are just north o' here, but the hide of any mooshoof will do.
89001.objectivesText: Bring 5 Mosshoof Hides to Berdun Cliffbrew at Talrendis Point in Azshara.
89001.title: Home on the Range

89015.description:
If ye fancy yourself a real angler, there's bigger fish out here than ye can catch with a rod.

Mammoth Sharks lurk in the deepest waters of the northern an' southern coasts. They swim far out, right before the sea floor drops away into the great ocean.

They're mighty big; I'd advise ye take a group of anglers with ye. 

Dwarf like me? I prefer dry land. Those sharks'd swallow me in one bite.

If ye do go hunting one, bring me a cut o' the meat. I'd be mighty thankful.
89015.objectivesText: Bring a Mammoth Shark Steak to Berdun Cliffbrew at Talrendis Point in Azshara.
89015.title: Deadliest Catch

89038.description:
It is said that Queen Azshara once bestowed a gift upon the kaldorei of House Ravencrest; an emblem of great beauty and magical power. This mark was given as recognition of the Ravencrests' unwavering loyalty to the queen. 

The mark was last seen near the Ravencrest Monument, atop the cliffs of the southern peninsula. Securing such a relic would be the discovery of a lifetime.

As always, the ruins of the monument are crawling with Spitelash, but I trust you're rather adept at handling them by now.
89038.objectivesText: Search for the Mark of the Queen among the ruins of the Ravencrest Monument, and bring it to Saria Fairmoon in Azshara.
89038.title: A Monumental Task

89053.description:
I know you were initially sent here on reconnaissance, $n, but you've done a great deal for the field of archaeology.

Surely, after all of your toil, you'd like to know what fruits my studies will come to bear.

To that end, before you return to your camp, I'd like to show you something. Would you oblige me?

objectives.text: See what Saria has to show you

89053.objectivesText: See what Saria has to show you.
89053.title: Your Final Reward

89228.description:
Any travel lodge worth its salt's gotta have somethin' to eat.

Squid are in season, and ye can fish 'em up from the coasts here in Azshara. Never was much of an angler myself, but I'm a mean cook!

What do ye say? Feelin' some seafood?

If ye aren't much for fishin', try makin' friends with one! Or pay 'em for their goods and buy some.
89228.objectivesText: Fish up 10 Winter Squid for Berdun Cliffbrew at Talrendis Point, in Azshara.
89228.title: Winter Frontier Fishery

89470.description: <With Saria's true intentions revealed, and a bag of powerful artifacts in hand, perhaps now would be a good time give Commander Truesong her report.>
89470.objectivesText: Bring Saria's Knapsack back to Commander Truesong at Talrendis Point.
89470.title: Ill Tidings

90702.description:
<Someone, or something, has rummaged through the dirt, leaving fragments of bone scattered about. An oddly shaped indentation leads deeper into the cold, wet dirt.

Something within the area may have caused the disruption.>
90702.objectivesText: Search the area for the grave's missing contents.
90702.title: Disturbed Grave

90854.description:
Livin' out in da wild for five years done take a toll on our supplies. We had to make dis place from scratch! We could use your skills as a leatherworker.

I need to repair some of da tents and buildings, and patch up some armor. You bring me a pair of Rugged Armor Kits and a Cured Rugged Hide, I help you turn it into something special.
90854.objectivesText: Bring $1oa Rugged Armor Kits and $2oa Cured Rugged Hide to Zet'gan in Elderwild on Mount Hyjal.
90854.title: Leather for Inclement Weather

90865.description:
Just north of here lies the ruins of battles past. A dwindling scourge presence remains.

Though the mindless undead are a threat themselves, the watchers maintain a vigilant eye on those entering the area, making removal of the scourge threat even more difficult.

Remove the threat by taking from these watchers that which they value most.
90865.title: Eyes of the Watchers

90902.description:
I am proud to welcome another newly risen paladin to our ranks. As you begin to reconnect with the light you may notice that certain abilities that were once second nature to you may cause you considerable pain to use now, particularly those involving channeling the light to heal yourself or others. 

The only way around this problem is--unfortunately--to go through it. Like any other muscle that has atrophied, you must push through the pain and exercise the flesh for it to return to full function.
90902.objectivesText: Heal $1oa Injured Deathguard with your Holy Light ability.
90902.title: Rediscovering the Light

91294.description:
Now that the immediate threat of the murloc attacks is under control, I'd encourage you to show yourself around our stronghold. It isn't much yet, but it's home.

When you are done exploring, seek out Danitha Morr, our leader. She can help you get settled in.

I'm very glad to have met you, $n. May the light be your guide.
91294.objectivesText: Speak to the residents of Bandarion Keep.
91294.title: Touring the Grounds

91316.description:
This far from the Undercity, logistics are challenging and we have a dire shortage of building materials needed to help restore this fortress. I'd like your help with that.

The ruined village of Shadowvale can be found in the Whispering Forest, just southwest of here. One of the buildings has an old root cellar used to store all sorts of things. There are likely to be usable materials down there. Scavenge what you can and return to us.
91316.objectivesText: Collect 12 pieces of Sturdy Lumber from Shadowvale in Tirisfal Glades.
91316.title: Making Repairs

91548.description:
I do not speak Thalassian, but these diagrams are familiar to me.

Knowing the blood elves' addiction to mana, I'd say they were trying to summon demons to drain them of their fel magic.

Simply consuming such powerful energy is a waste. We could harness it for a much greater purpose.

<Zevrost bookmarks a page in the tome>

There is an Altar of Storms in the Blasted Lands. Perform this ritual there to summon the demon Vek'zol. His heart will make a potent reagent. Think of the power we could have!
91548.objectivesText: Use the Sin'dorei Tome of Summoning to summon Vek'zol at the Altar of Storms in the Blasted Lands. Bring the Heart of Vek'zol to Zevrost in Orgrimmar.
91548.title: Vek'zol

91564.description:
We've been stuck here for five years, and we've had to build everything from scratch! Do you know how much I've had to improvise just to do any engineering?

Hey, if you can help me out with some materials, I can make it worth your time! Build me a couple of Mithril Casings and a Mechanical Repair Kit so that I can fix up some stuff, and I'll show you a few things I've figured out.
91564.objectivesText: Bring $1oa Mithril Casings and $2oa Mechanical Repair Kit to Hnaz Blunderflame.
91564.title: Itching for a Fixing

91688.description:
You've managed to cut a swath through the undead that have kept us trapped here for so many years, and for that we can never repay you.

I have one more favor to ask, on behalf of us all. We know that there are druids at the summit. They protect Nordrassil and the Well of Eternity.

Why did they never come help us to escape?

For five years we have been trapped here. At last we have a glimmer of hope... but why didn't the druids come for us?

Let someone know that we're still alive!
91688.objectivesText: Travel to the Summit of Eternity and speak with the druids about the survivor village.
91688.title: To the Summit of Eternity

91696.areaDescription: Escort the Furbolg family out of Deadwood Den
91696.description:
Deadwood set on my pup and his sire. He stood fast, fought to the death as our guard. We must go home, but the way is dark and full of jaws.

Stay near, guard us well. I will lead, you will fend, and we will see den safe.
91696.objectivesText: Escort the Barkskin Matriarch out of Deadwood Den and return to Barkskin Burrow.
91696.title: Open Season

91725.description:
I was sent by Master Theocritus to pick up some enchanting supplies from the trading post, but on the way back I was ambushed by a pack of gnolls!

I dropped the package and escaped, but if I return without it, I'll be cleaning up after the polymorph experiments for weeks as punishment! Do you think you could find the supplies for me?
91725.objectivesText: Collect 5 Stolen Enchanting Supplies from gnoll camps around Stone Cairn Lake, then return to Blixie Fitzwink near the Tower of Azora.
91725.title: Stolen Enchanting Supplies

91732.description: Good steel is in short supply after the war, and our tools have suffered for it. The Jasperlode miners used finely-crafted picks, and I imagine some of them are still there in the depths of the mine. Could you retrieve some for me, and I'll see if I can repurpose the steel?
91732.objectivesText: Collect 4 Mining Tools from Jasperlode Mine, then return to Hagar Lowe in Eastvale Logging Camp.
91732.title: Good Steel

91733.description:
I was bringing back a supply shipment from the trading post, but my wagon tipped over and the supplies fell in the river! Before I could catch them, they had already washed downstream.

Between the murlocs and wolves down there, I don't stand a chance of retrieving the supplies on my own. You seem like the hardy sort. Do you think you could find them for me?
91733.objectivesText: Collect the Waterlogged Axe, Waterlogged Saw, and Waterlogged Toolbox that have washed downstream from Eastvale Logging Camp, then return to Ormin Pelford.
91733.title: Downstream

91734.description:
<The Forsaken sways unsteadily> 

'ey! <hic> Do me a favor ... would ya? 

Go to uh ... Azshara 'n ... tell <hic> Jediga ...

Expectin' a ... 'mportant deliv'ry <hic>
91734.title: Remote Contact

91735.description:
Listen, $c, you'd best not be hangin' round here for long. But since you are, perhaps you can do a little favor for me?

I be expecting a certain something from a Jediga, in Azshara. She and some orcs be havin' a camp out there. Go and tell her Jes'rimon sent you, and I'll owe you one.
91735.title: Remote Contact

91737.description:
My duties occasionally require reagents from the farther corners of Azeroth. However, I am always needed here in Thunder Bluff, and so I am in need of competent aides.

To that end, I am awaiting a delivery from an orc named Jediga, in Azshara. If you care to make yourself useful, find her camp, and inquire as to when I can expect it to arrive.
91737.title: Remote Contact

91743.description: Those awful kobolds are eating my books! You have to get them back before they devour my whole library.
91743.objectivesText: Retrieve $1oa Stolen Books from kobolds in Northshire Valley and return them to Brother Paxton.
91743.title: Rascally Rodents

91770.description:
With the ingredients you brought, I can make some simple medicine. This poultice should aid Fraxinus. He is old, you know, and he was badly burned during the wars. His bark hurts and his limbs ache. He is my best friend and I just want him to feel better!

Take this poultice and apply it liberally to all of the places where his bark is split and his sap is weeping.
91770.title: Bark Bite

91859.description:
Cutting straight to it, these "dignitaries" are no ordinary diplomats. One was a Tauren. Ordinary enough for the Earthen Ring, but the other--and you'll scarcely believe this--was an elf. A *high* elf. They were cloaked, but I've seen quel'dorei before and I'd bet my good pinky finger that's what I saw.

Why was an elf accompanying a Tauren through horde territory? Well, your guess is as good as mine. That's as much as I know, so I'd suggest speaking with Deathguard Baldren near the entrance to town.
91859.objectivesText: Speak with Deathguard Baldren about the mysterious Earthen Ring travelers who recently passed through The Sepulcher.
91859.title: A Curious Pair

91860.description:
Out on patrol last night I spotted a group of gnolls dumping a very large body onto a pyre on the shores of Fenris Isle. I didn't see an elf or any smaller corpses, but I'd say this doesn't bode well for them.

If you are brave or stupid you are welcome to charge into Fenris Isle to learn more, but if you ask me, it's a lot of work to find some snooty elf that's probably long dead.

I know you paladins love swearing oaths and taking on lost causes, but this one isn't worth it. Trust me.
91860.objectivesText: Investigate Fenris Isle to the east and learn the fate of the Earthen Ring traveling party.
91860.title: A Grim Fate

91861.description: <The fact that you found only one body is a hopeful sign. Perhaps the High Elf that Trevan and Hadrec described is still alive somewhere deeper inside the nearby fortress?>
91861.objectivesText: Investigate Fenris Keep to the north and attempt to locate the missing member of the Earthen Ring party.
91861.title: Into Fenris Keep

91877.description:
Not many demon hunters remain on Azeroth now, but a few of us continue to hunt the most dangerous or hidden threats.

A colleague of mine, Maerion Thaelemaches, headed to Hyjal to investigate rumors of demons there. While there are many demons in the dangerous Darkwhisper Gorge, there is suspicion that the demons that assaulted the mountain during the last war might not be completely defeated.

This bears investigation.
91877.objectivesText: Find Maerion Thaelemaches somewhere on Mount Hyjal.
91877.title: Demon Hunter's Hunter

91881.description:
With the warlocks under control, I'd say this area's well in wing.

<The crow nods sagely, looking pleased.>

Though our work here is done, there are other areas that could use your help and as an underwing of mine I would like you to go see what all the fuss is about.

Follow the path northwest up the road to the old tern outpost. An old friend awaits!
91881.objectivesText: Meet Sefira Everbright at the outpost.
91881.title: The Western Post

92009.description:
There's something you should know about this order. There's a few inverted mana cells padded as well as I could at the bottom of the box. The cells have a tendency to discharge when they get bumped, and when not stabilized in time. It takes about two hours for the contents to fizzle.

Kaylaena will know what to do when she receives them, but I suggest going slow if you're going to ride saddled up Mount Hyjal.

If you need a refill, come back and I'll top off the canisters. Be careful, you know?

objectives.text: Shipment delivered to Mount Hyjal before it expires

92009.objectivesText: Gently transport the crate of parts and baubles to Kaylaena Springwhisper in Mount Hyjal.
92009.title: Crate Expectations

92014.description:
Every time I take my attention off the supplies I've lugged up here for more than a few minutes, one of nature's finest thieves is pilfering and rummaging through it.

The damned foxes seem to have made a burrow beneath the boulders nearby. Apparently, me digging out this hole gave them an idea of their own.

I'm working on a solution. Tell you what, bring back some of their fox tails. That'll teach them a lesson, and I'll hang the tails around the perimeter to scare the others off!
92014.objectivesText: Return $1oa Rustleaf Fox Tails to Johun "Punchy" Dillas in Hyjal.
92014.title: Fox Hole

92016.description:
The roots of Nordrassil stretch far and deep, thicker than riverbanks and older than memory. Such great size carries a great hunger. In healthy times, they drink of decay and renewal alike, drawing strength from the endless turning of the natural cycle.

But Hyjal has been wounded, its soil fouled by demonic venom.

Descend into the deepest depths of the Well of Eternity. Study the roots there closely. We must know whether they have drawn in too much corruption... or if the World Tree may yet endure.
92016.objectivesText: Enter the Well of Eternity and examine the roots of Nordrassil.
92016.title: Rootwork

92065.description:
Will you aid us in our final battle, $r, and be a savior to the Blackmaw?

Varrox Bleakhoof, bane of the Blackmaw: a demon whose appetite for destruction will never be satisfied. His corruption consumes all that it touches. Even now, he and his underlings continue to lay waste to our burrows.

We've come far in our fight against the Legashi, but for the Blackmaw to ever have a future, Varrox must fall.

Find him in Blackmaw Hold, and strike him down. Only then can the Blackmaw finally be at peace.
92065.objectivesText: Bring Varrox Bleakhoof's Head to Gatekeeper Rageroar at Ursolan.
92065.title: Blackmaw Reclamation

92066.description:
When the Legashi invaded, many precious things were left behind in the commotion. Of particular value to me are two totems. They depict legends of our twin gods, Ursoc and Ursol.

I know our immediate survival is of greatest concern, but we must also think of saving our people's history.

Those totems are likely still in our former hold. If they are, you would be doing a great kindness by returning them to me.
92066.objectivesText: Find the Totem of Ursoc and the Totem of Ursol inside Blackmaw Hold. Then, return them to Lorekeeper Nok at Ursolan.
92066.title: The Twin Bears

92069.description:
Two behemoths patrol the place the Blackmaw once called home: Bonesnout, the Unbroken and Withermaw, the great bear. Generations of hunters have tried to fell them, and all have failed.

I take no joy in asking you to slay these magnificent beasts, but my people need to be able to return home. The least I can do is ensure their deaths are not in vain. If you bring me their remains, I will fashion a weapon in memory of their strength.
92069.objectivesText: Bring the Claws of the Great Bear and the Tusks of the Unbroken to Ogtinc, in Azshara.
92069.title: Claws That Rend, Tusks that Gore

92070.description:
The necklace is adorned with miscellaneous charms: scraps of feathers, acorn shells, and colorful pebbles. Its leather strap is torn. The ornamentation suggests it belonged to a Furbolg, while its small size and rough quality indicate a child's handiwork.

There's a chance the necklace is of some sentimental value to one of the Blackmaw. It may be good to find the owner and return it.
92070.objectivesText: Find the owner of the Feathered Charm Necklace.
92070.title: A Lost Memento

92100.description:
<A spirit materializes before you, recovering from a full-body yawn.>

You have no ranks with you... and you are not dressed as a soldier. We repelled Archimonde then?

It's been so long. I had almost forgotten what I once was, but you... you must be one of the first to walk these craters in years.

<The veteran glances at his surroundings.>

Let us continue our conversation at an overlook with a view I remember vividly, just west of here. Long ago, I left my scabbard to rest there.
92100.objectivesText: Find the Veteran of the Third War's scabbard near Elderwild.
92100.title: Anywhere But Here

92109.description:
Erm... 'Ello, $Gmister:miss;. I'm not supposed to talk to strangers, but... Hey, what are those shiny bottles sticking out of your backpack for? Are you an alchemist? That's so cool!

When I grow up, I want to be an alchemist too. Daddy won't let me play with any of his herbs; too dangerous, he says.

Well, I want to start learning now. Could you maybe get some supplies for me, pretty please?
92109.objectivesText: Bring 5 Empty Vials, 5 Silverleaf, and 5 Peacebloom to the young, aspiring alchemist inside the barn of Moonbrook in Westfall.
92109.title: My First Alchemy Set

92111.description:
I see you try, and try is more than most. We give you good will with time, if you do the same.

Enter our den and talk to Osi. She has open paws, will give you more chance to help.
92111.objectivesText: Enter Barkskin Burrow and find the furbolg they call Osi.
92111.title: Of Friend and Fur

92147.description:
I am one of the last of the Highfeathers, the true followers of Aviana. We respect and revere the Matron of the Skies, and we call the Druids of the Talon our allies.

The Wormwing harpies have overrun much of this plateau. They reject our protector Aviana, and seek only to despoil the lands around us.

Blood has been spilled and must be repaid. Scatter their feathers to the wind.
92147.objectivesText: Slay $1oa Wormwing harpies on Mount Hyjal and bring their feathers to Phoebe Highfeather.
92147.title: Highfeather Helper

92169.description:
The Blackthorne Pact. That's what they call themselves. Apostate druids that have taken over Hyjal Summit. Violent, and extremist. They blame Malfurion Stormrage for robbing them of their immortality, and have sworn to reclaim the power that they were forced to relinquish. I did not understand the magic that empowered them before, but it's becoming clear now.

Take the staff, use it on the Blackthorne druids around the mountain. It should respond to and dispel the wards protecting them.

objectives.text: Test the Staff of the Mountain

92169.objectivesText: Use the Staff of the Mountain on $1oa  members of the Blackthorne Pact on the Summit of Eternity to remove their wards and then kill them.
92169.title: Paying Back the Pact

92189.description:
Och, we had to make this village from scratch with what we could scrounge up after the war. All of the fighting has taken a toll on our weapons, not to mention the need for tools!

I can always tell another blacksmith. Think you could spare the time and materials to make me some Dense Sharpening and Dense Grinding Stones? We could really use 'em!
92189.objectivesText: Bring $1oa Dense Sharpening Stones and $2oa Dense Grinding Stones to Trigg Ironhand in Elderwild on Mount Hyjal.
92189.title: Back to the Grind

92328.description:
With the extra supplies you brought back, I have enough materials on hand to finish up Yaely's original plans for this Glaive Thrower. I've been fixing this thing up for the past... well, it feels like forever!

If you can help me out and be a second pair of hands, it'd make this whole project go a lot faster! I can walk you through it, most of the hard stuff should be out of the way... 

<Kaylaena crosses her fingers.>

The driving system and the energy cells powering it are nearly set up.
92328.objectivesText: Turn the two gears and connect the two battery terminals on both sides of Kaylaena's Glaive Thrower.
92328.title: Siegecraft

92343.description:
The burrow you speak of is a tunnel to Blackmaw Hold. In the past, the furbolg have guarded it fiercely, making it inaccessible to outsiders. With this satyr situation, however, we can get inside.

So close to Nordrassil, there would be actively growing roots. Older roots can be seen on the world's surface, but newer ones can only be found deep underground. Little is known of their magical properties.

If you were to bring me some samples to study, the druids of Thunder Bluff would be in your debt.
92343.objectivesText: Gather 10 Nordrassil Root Caps inside Blackmaw Hold for Nara Wildmane in Thunder Bluff.
92343.title: Get to the Roots of It

92401.areaDescription: Investigate the disappearance of Edward Heartweaver in the Ruins of Lordaeron.
92401.description:
It's my husband Edward...

He has not returned from his weekly journey to the graveyard in the Lordaeron ruins. Our son was lost when Arthas razed the city, and my dear Edward is still filled with guilt and sorrow that we never found his body. I've tried to warn him against searching those overrun ruins, but he refuses to give up. I try not to worry, but it's been days.

There are things there I cannot contend with but if you are willing, I need to know the fate of my husband.
92401.objectivesText: Investigate the disappearance of Edward Heartweaver in the Ruins of Lordaeron.
92401.title: A Frightened Request

92422.description:
Reports have come in from the Lordamere Overlook deep within the Ruins of Lordaeron. An unholy fog has taken over the streets and graveyard, affording the scourge up there some measure of stealth. 

Our scouts indicate they're being conjured by a new power within their ranks, a necromancer known as Rath'mael. We do not have the luxury of waiting this one out, $n.

If you have allies, summon them and their aid to the Forsaken. Drive this creature out of our lands.
92422.objectivesText: Kill Rath'mael in the Ruins of Lordaeron for Deathguard Kristof in Brill.
92422.title: The Wrath of Rath'mael

92433.description:
Hey! I'm pretty busy trying to turn these scraps into something edible. You wanna help out? I could really use some more variety for this meal! It sure would be nice to have something different on the menu.

There's a goblin in Everlook who has this recipe for Savory Stag Sliders... perfect for tiny hands like mine. If you could cook up some of those, that would be great! You can get stag meat from the stags here on the mountain.
92433.objectivesText: Bring $1oa Savory Stag Sliders to Hnaz Blunderflame in Elderwild.
92433.title: Now We're Cooking

92434.areaDescription: Find a way into Dalaran along the Lordamere Lake
92434.description:
Whatever caused Dalaran's barrier to lower has left the city in turmoil. With you having dealt with their patrols, there is no better time than now to make our way inside and discover their secrets.

Take the key you found at the internment camp and seek out their sewers along the northern border of the city. With luck, those mages had no reason to put a ward over such a... disagreeable point of entry.
92434.objectivesText: Find a way into Dalaran along the Lordamere Lake.
92434.title: Blood in the Streets

conditionalDescriptions.text:
If I have to teach you herbalism you can at least make yourself useful. I have an errand I need run.

For a city of mages, Dalaran has a surprising interest in botany. The Kirin Tor keep to themselves, but I would love a sample of their mana-infused vegetation.

You're clearly someone who is comfortable being where people don't want you, maybe you could find a way into the city. If you do, bring me back whatever is growing in their central garden.

92456.description:
If you're going to bother me you can at least make yourself useful. I have an errand I need run.

For a city of mages, Dalaran has a surprising interest in botany. The Kirin Tor keep to themselves, but I would love a sample of their mana-infused vegetation.

You're clearly someone who is comfortable being where people don't want you, maybe you could find a way into the city. If you do, bring me back whatever is growing in their central garden.
92456.objectivesText: Collect a Fel Infused Blossom from the City of Dalaran for Shylamiir in Stormwind City.
92456.title: A Green Sample

92457.description:
The breach has affected many of our factotums and enchantments throughout the city, including many that are seeing to our defenses. This fragmented arcane energy has spoken to rogue elementals who seek to saturate themselves in this free flowing magic.
