While we are busy tending to the wards and other major incidents, it would be a favor to the Kirin Tor if you could cull this elemental throng.
92457.objectivesText: Defeat $1oa Seeking Remnants, $2oa Saturated Remnants, and $3oa Mana Echoes inside the City of Dalaran for Archmage Modera outside of Dalaran.
92457.title: Starving Arcane

92463.description:
If the forest is as thick with these insects as it sounds, simply killing the workers won't be enough.

Go deeper into the forest and find the queen. She'll be close to the hive and surrounded by bigger and more aggressive soldiers, so be careful.

Put her down and return here when it's done. That'll be one less problem to think about around here.
92463.objectivesText: Destroy the Cirrusfly Queen in Thendal Grove.
92463.title: The Cirrusfly Queen

92466.description:
While we owe much of our prosperity to the elements of wind, the path we walk requires that we obey the call of all four of the primary elements and undertake a trial for each. Before you begin your first trial in earnest however, you must prove the strength of your resolve.

Travel to the standing stones to the east. A force of Al'Aketh converts has been spotted there and they must be driven off. Confront the cultists there and bring me one of their signets as proof of your deeds.
92466.objectivesText: Bring a Signet of Akir to Windshaper Boro.
92466.title: Call of Earth

92469.description:
You've done enough here, $c. I'll stay and clean up any stragglers down there.

Head back to the Village and tell Rorian about the cult's presence. He will not be pleased.
92469.objectivesText: Bring word of the Al'Aketh to Rorian the Dayseeker in Thendal Grove.
92469.title: Return to Rorian

92470.description:
Rorian informed you that I've been watching you. I now offer you a test of resolve. However, be warned--it will send you into great danger.

Go to the caves to the west. Thin out the ursera's numbers there, and find their matriarch, one the rangers call "Urs'anah". Put her down and bring me proof of her demise. Once you have done that, you will have taken an important step on your path.
92470.objectivesText: Slay 8 Ursera Scavengers and collect the head of the den mother, Urs'anah in Thendal Grove.
92470.title: Foul Matriarch

92473.description:
The ursera den to the southwest is rapidly becoming a problem. Just last week the rangers had to kill an adolescent ursera who wandered too close to the village and attempted to attack a boy playing near the base of the elder tree in the center of the village.

We were fortunate that the boy escaped with his life. Hunger and desperation makes these beasts too dangerous to be left unchecked. Go south and put the scrawniest among the ursera down. Bring me their claws as proof when it is done.
92473.objectivesText: Collect 6 Scrawny Ursera Claws from Scrawny Ursera in Thendal Grove.
92473.title: Aggressive Encroachment

92474.description:
Well hello there, $n! Want to play a game?

All you've got to do is step up on that ledge... then jump! Use your innate ability to walk on the air to slow your fall and see how far forward you can float.

The rules are made up and the points don't matter, but you get bonus points if you can land right in front of Rorian the Dayseeker and startle him! He won't like it but I'll certainly get a good laugh if you can get him all worked up! Hah!
92474.objectivesText: Jump from the top of the watchtower in Thendal Grove and use your Walk on Air ability to slow your fall.
92474.title: Falling With Style

92480.description: The cultist you just killed dropped what appears to be orders from a high priestess of the Cult of Al'Akir. It makes mention of a spy in Shen'dar Village and cult operations in a place called Falaath Village. The authorities at Shen'dar Village will want to learn of this.
92480.objectivesText: Bring the Orders from the High Priestess to Shen'Dar Village and present it to whomever is in charge there.
92480.title: zzOLD UNUSED Cult Ambush

92482.description: While you were away dealing with our vuldren problem, our resident hunter trainer--Tai'ree Farsight--left this note for you. You can find her just over yonder near the center of the village. Read the note then seek her out.
92482.objectivesText: Read the Scribbled Note and then speak with Tai'ree Farsight in Thendal Grove.
92482.title: The Way of the Hunter

92514.description:
You've got that "Windshaper" air about you. Something about how I can feel a tiny bit of static on my skin when near someone spirit-touched that gives it away. Before I properly put you to work around here, you should check in with our resident Windshaper elder, Illaya Amberwind. She's just outside, near the center of town.

Oh, and check in with Coriella Calmbreeze as well, she runs the local inn and can provide lodging and supplies, should you need them.
92514.objectivesText: Speak with Illaya Amberwind and Coriella Calmbreeze in Shen'dar Village.
92514.title: Welcome to Shen'dar Village

92515.description:
As if bandits and mad cultists weren't enough, the hills are thick with prideclaws as well right now. They are starting to encroach on the village borders and growing bolder by the day. It's only a matter of time before someone's pet or child is taken. It would be a mercy for us to cull their numbers now rather than after some tragedy occurs.

Bring me a dozen or so of their pelts. I can turn them into all sorts of goods that will be of aid to the village.
92515.objectivesText: Collect 10 Prideclaw Pelts from the Prideclaws in Shen'dar Highlands.
92515.title: The Problem With Prideclaws

92517.description:
There's a cave not far to the north, hidden behind a waterfall. It's well known to me that there's a group of bandits that are operating out of that cave. They were a problem for us before the cult arrived, but now they are a real terror. I can't spare the people to go and clear them out, unfortunately.

I need you to go there and take care of them for me. Kill as many as you can, and if possible, take out their leader, the one they call "Badwind" Bennic. That cave is dangerous, so be careful.
92517.objectivesText: Kill 10 Highlands Bandits and their leader, "Badwind" Bennic in the Shen'dar Highlands.
92517.title: The Criminal Element

92521.description:
You know I'm a warlock, right? Now reduced to squalor and meat-cutting, but once a mighty magician!

My imp keeps wandering off and while I could just call him back, I'm kinda curious about what he's doing. He's been sneaking off to talk to a bound satyr at a tower to the southeast of here. If you wouldn't mind, I'd like to know what they're talking about.

I'm sure it's nothing to worry about, but you can never tell with demons, right?
92521.objectivesText: Spy on Hnaz's imp at the tower with the captive satyr.
92521.title: The Demon Tower

92532.description:
While you were gone our warrior trainer--Blademaster Ren--requested that we send you their way when you returned. She dropped this note off for you as well.

Give it a read, then find Blademaster Ren inside the village watchtower.
92532.objectivesText: Read the Crumpled Note you've been given, then seek out Blademaster Ren inside the Thendal Village watchtower.
92532.title: The Warrior's Path

92544.description:
A band of Al'Aketh cult ruffians have taken up residence near the temple ruins just southwest of here, led by a real monster called Malduko Cloudcrush. This rabble has no doubt been dispatched here by High Priestess Lorthuna at the Shrine of Akir to attack travelers and coerce our people into joining the cult.

I need to stay here at my post to alert travelers leaving the grove of the danger, but I would be grateful if you could do something about those cultists and their leader for me.
92544.objectivesText: Slay 6 Al'Aketh Brutes, 4 Al'Aketh Neophytes, and Malduko Cloudcrush in Thendal Grove.
92544.title: Al'Aketh Thugs

92550.description:
Our best defense here might just be a strong offense. The advantage we now have is that we expect an attack is coming. What they won't expect is for us to hit them first.

I've already asked a lot of you, but please head back over to Falaath Village. Kill as many cultists as you can and if you can get close enough, kill the commander and bring me his head. I'll stay here and organize the citizens and our few peacekeepers to prepare a defense... just in case you don't return.
92550.objectivesText: Travel to the ruins of Falaath Village and slay 6 Al'Aketh Stormcallers, 4 Living Lightning and take the head of Commander Cyclas.
92550.title: Havoc in the Highlands

92553.description:
Up for a bit of work? I could use a bit of muscle from a strong adventuring-type such as yourself. With how dangerous things are getting around here, no one's had much time to hunt or forage of late, and I need someone to get out there and source me fresh eggs and strider meat to keep this village fed.

I'd be happy to teach you one of my famous recipes if you can bring me what I need. What do you say?
92553.objectivesText: Collect $1oa Small Eggs and $2oa Strider Meat from creatures found throughout the Shen'dar Highlands.
92553.title: Restocking the Larders

92579.description:
For now it seems the pylon and the village are safe, so I'd like you to deliver this report to Valennia Stormfist in Valanaar, at the southeastern edge of the island. Valennia is the leader of the peacekeepers on the island and she needs to know what happened here.

The cult is expanding rapidly and the peacekeepers have avoided direct conflict until now, but those days are over. Valanaar will need to be ready for a fight.

At any rate, thank you. You'll always have friends in Shen'dar, $n.
92579.objectivesText: Deliver Aonda's Written Report to Valennia Stormfist in Valanaar.
92579.title: To Valanaar

92593.description:
Well, you've shown you're capable enough to handle the busy work. Now we can see if you can be trusted to handle greater threats.

Setting up an intelligence station here is only step one of the job. If you want to help lay the foundations for what's to come, carefully enter Dae'gun, the remains of the Horde base.

Find a high point suitable for an outlook's post. Report back with details about the area, and we'll see about getting you properly briefed.
92593.objectivesText: Enter Dae'gun and locate a high vantage point, then report details to Johun.
92593.title: Avalanche of Corruption

conditionalDescriptions.text:
The aura of arcane energy that surrounds you is strong, even for a mage such as yourself. 

Come, let us sit and speak some on the nature of the arcane and the plight of our homeland.

92596.description:
The aura of arcane energy that surrounds you is strong, even though you are not initiated as a mage. I am quite sure that you are going to be a capable adventurer, and your connection with our ancient magic will only ever be a boon to you even if you were to never utter a single word of power in spellcasting.

Come, let us sit and speak some on my order, the nature of the arcane here on Zephras, and the plight of our people.
92596.objectivesText: Have a seat and speak with Rathiril Sunlance.
92596.title: The High Order

92598.description:
As a Windshaper, you have the ability to use the sacred skysight gifted to us by the elemental spirits. Travel to the standing stones to the northeast of the village. Find the elemental convergence there and use your gift.

You'll find that you may draw upon the skysight anywhere, but its boon is much more powerful if you do so in the presence of an elemental convergence. You may at times receive other bits of wisdom from the spirits that are drawn to such places of power, as well.

objectives.text: Use Skysight near the Elemental Convergence

92598.objectivesText: Use your Skysight racial ability at the Elemental Convergence in Thendal Grove.
92598.title: The Gift of Skysight

92642.description:
Valennia only sent one person to help repel a full-scale assault... by the winds.

You don't look like much but I'll take what I can get. We need to inflict as much damage as possible to stop this soon. My people can't hold out much longer.

Go down the hill and disrupt their logistics. Their healers are keeping the attackers coming, if we take them out we might be able to rally and push them back. Any other cultists you kill while you are out there are helpful as well.
92642.objectivesText: Slay 4 Al'Aketh Healers and 8 Al'Aketh Brawlers in the Gustberry Lowlands.
92642.title: Disrupting Logistics

92644.description: <You reach beneath the still-warm body of the turncoat cultist and recover a small, glowing blue crystal. It appears to be damaged, but it may still be important. High Elder Shadowsong may be interested in this.>
92644.objectivesText: Deliver the glowing crystal to Talanaanis Shadowsong in Valanaar.
92644.title: Unfortunate News

92645.description:
This attack is going to be hard to repel unless we can take out the cult commander. Belguilos "the Breaker" they call her, and she's a veritable terror. She used to be a peacekeeper before the cult got out of control, and even then she was... off. As a cultist I can only imagine how much worse she could be now.

I might just be sending you to your death, but someone needs to take Belguilos out if we are going to survive here. You can find her at the villa at the hill's base. Good luck, $c.
92645.objectivesText: Slay Commander Belguilos in the Gustberry Lowlands.
92645.title: Breaking the Breaker

92679.description:
H--Hello, stranger. You have the look of a capable adventurer about you. I...

<The Skyborne man winces, clearly suffering terrible pain>

...I was wondering if you were seeking employment? I came here to Valanaar to recruit fighters to help save my farm. If you are interested, please go find my wife Aamelia Windfield at our orchard to the west of Valanaar, in the lowlands.
92679.objectivesText: Listen to what Alvarion Windfield has to say and find Aamelia Windfield at the Windfield Orchard.
92679.title: Blood Tithe

92683.description:
I'm sure you've noticed the giant flutterflies out in the outer fields near the orchard? They are pleasant to look at, but they also have other benefits; namely their wing dust. It can be a mess, but if you can gather it up in large amounts, it has useful household applications.

Take this Flutterfly Swatter and give the big bugs a good swat for me. They'll usually just get scared and flee, but sometimes they'll take some offense. Either way, they'll give their rumps a shake and drop a pile of dust.
92683.objectivesText: Gather 5 Flutterfly Dust from the Flutterflies around the Gustberry Lowlands.
92683.title: Flutterfly Dust

92685.description:
The bandits have camps all over and there's a small one in the hills just north of here. Head up there and start cracking skulls. If we can catch them off guard and take them out before they come for us, we might just even the odds enough to stand a chance.

Bring me their masks. The bloodier the better.
92685.objectivesText: Loot 7 Blood-Stained Bandit Masks from Highwayman Bandits in the Gustberry Lowlands.
92685.title: The Hills Have Eyes

92693.description:
You've done a lot to give us a fighting chance. Even if we die today, we'll at least know we gave it our best shot.

This is your last chance, stranger. If you want to head back to Valanaar and live another day, I wouldn't blame you.

On the other hand, if you really have a thing for lost causes just let me know when you are ready to go. We'll walk out there with our heads held high and whatever happens, happens.

objectives.text: Follow Aamelia and make your final stand

92693.objectivesText: Speak with Aamelia Windfield when you are ready to confront the bandit leader.
92693.title: Standing Our Ground

92699.description:
Now that you've arrived in Valanaar, you'll likely want to check in with the other members of the High Order here. The current Supreme Magister, Elaadrin Evengale and his people operate out of the lodge on the far southeastern part of Valanaar.

You should also take care, the High Order and Windshapers don't get along very well here. Be careful and give the Windshapers a good, wide berth. We've got enough to worry about with the cult, I won't tolerate faction violence in the streets of Valanaar.
92699.title: The Supreme Magister

92701.description:
For now it seems the pylon and the village are safe, so I'd like you to deliver this report to Valennia Stormfist in Valanaar, at the southeastern edge of the island. Valennia is the leader of the peacekeepers on the island and she needs to know what happened here.

The cult is expanding rapidly and the peacekeepers have avoided direct conflict until now, but those days are over. Valanaar will need to be ready for a fight.

At any rate, thank you. You'll always have friends in Shen'dar, $n.
92701.objectivesText: Deliver Aonda's Written Report to Valennia Stormfist in Valanaar.
92701.title: To Valanaar

92727.description:
Seeking knowledge is the primary mandate of the High Order, but this work has never been more dangerous than it is now on Zephras.

One of our scholars--Fillion Flamebreeze--was en route to the Shen'dar Highlands to gather data on the windborne magic that congregates in some areas there. Regrettably, he has not returned and we fear that something may have befallen him on the road.

If you can, please locate him for us. He was last seen on the road leading west from Valanaar towards Shen'dar Highlands.
92727.objectivesText: Discover what became of Fillion Flamebreeze.
92727.title: The Missing Scholar

92742.description:
We must determine the source and nature of the poison corrupting this land. Let us begin with the groundwater under the farms in the area.

Go to the Jansen Stead in the north and the Molsen Farm northwest of here, and collect samples from the wells there.
92742.objectivesText: Use the Well Water Sample Kit to collect samples from the wells at the Jansen Stead and the Molsen Farm.
92742.title: Testing the Wells

92744.description:
The corruption affecting Westfall's crops may have seeped into the ocean as well. If the local fish are affected too, it could doom Stormwind to famine.
Collect gills from the murlocs along the shoreline and bring them to me. Murlocs are quite hardy, but their physiology is extremely sensitive to contaminants. Any toxins in the seawater will be readily apparent in the gills you find.
92744.objectivesText: Alba Fairmoon wants you to collect 7 Longshore Murloc Gills along the shoreline of Westfall.
92744.title: Murloc Gills

92747.description:
Strange - the poison does not seem to originate from the mines you investigated.

I am told the Deadmines under the town of Moonbrook are the largest, deepest mines of Westfall, but they have been abandoned since the First War. Could the Deadmines be active again?

Please travel to Moonbrook, $n, and look for evidence of mining or industrial activity. This is the last lead we have!
92747.objectivesText: Collect 8 Suspicious Industrial Supplies from Moonbrook.
92747.title: Moonbrook Espionage

92748.description:
The supplies you found point to a massive industrial operation somewhere in the Deadmines. There's no question that this is the source of the toxins plaguing the farmland of Westfall. We need to stop it, quickly.

Whatever's down there will be difficult to destroy. Go to the Dwarven District of Stormwind, and find an engineer who can supply us with some explosives.
92748.objectivesText: Travel to the Dwarven District in Stormwind and find an engineer who can help.
92748.title: Explosive Consultation

92750.description:
I assume you want a "controlled" explosion? Not as much fun, but a good choice if you want to keep all your limbs.
I'm afraid I don't have a remote detonator--why don't you go check with the sneaky folks down at Stormwind Intelligence? They should be able to find us something.
92750.objectivesText: Talk to someone in Stormwind Intelligence about acquiring a remote detonator.
92750.title: Detonation at a Distance

92752.description: That's it--the bomb's ready to go! Careful with that detonator, now.
92752.objectivesText: Return to Alba Fairmoon in Westfall.
92752.title: Explosive Consultation

92754.description:
Our clanmates continue to venture further south, to and beyond the cursed Valley of Bones.

Despite your standing with our clan, I do not trust you enough to share the details of their ventures. They would be boring to you anyway, outsider.

What matters to you is our need for Greater Shadow Protection Potions, in bulk, to ensure their continued survival. Bring some to me, and I will put in a good word for you.
92754.objectivesText: Maintain your reputation with the Magram, and bring $1oa Greater Shadow Protection Potions to Mirda in the Magram Village in Desolace.
92754.title: A New Need for Shadow Protection

92755.description:
With each passing day, our scavengers return with fewer and fewer armaments from fallen adventurers.

While we cannot use these pieces directly, we do salvage them for scraps. The most magical of the armaments go to me, as I can disenchant them and make use of the mysterious remnants to enchant our weapons, particularly those of our windchasers.

I am in need of Greater Mystic Essences if I am to supply our next raiding party with worthwhile equipment.
92755.objectivesText: Maintain your reputation with the Gelkis, and bring $1oa Greater Mystic Essences to Halea in the Gelkis Village in Desolace.
92755.title: Mysterious Mysticism

92817.description:
Convincing my Gelkis clanmates to put on armor is nigh impossible, despite the numerous losses we have suffered with blades or bolts through the chest.

I have been tasked with designing a vest that offers some reasonable protection, without the supposed 'itchiness' that they complain about. Supplies are scarce, so I dare not waste precious leather on junk.

Outsider, would you bring me a harness fit to a brutish centaur? I would like to learn from your technique.
92817.objectivesText: Maintain your reputation with the Gelkis, and bring a Barbaric Harness to Talra in the Gelkis Village in Desolace.
92817.title: Leather Technique

92819.description: We are almost finished. Use the detonator, and end this.
92819.title: Destruction in Deadmines

92840.description:
Fillion was sent to the Overlook Standing Stones with a special device used to measure and study the elemental energy there.

Take this--an Index Esoteria--and use it to extract data from the massive windstone formations that form there. Be on your guard however, as the Windshapers are likely to be jealously guarding this site now.

Should any attempt to obstruct you, well... do what you need to do. I have no more patience for their interference.
92840.objectivesText: Take the Index Esoteria to the Overlook Standing Stones in Shen'dar Highlands and use it on the Windstone Formations in the area to gather data.
92840.title: Catching Wind

92847.description:
Outsider, did you notice the weapon that the outcast necromancers held in their hands? We will ensure the Gelkis will not live long enough to master the ways of necromancy, but their methods of channeling caught my interest. They even use those same crystals Warug asked you to steal.

I think we can use this technique to our advantage. Venture back into the valley to recover some wood from the accursed trees, and see if Warug will part with some of his crystals. I will make staves from them.
92847.objectivesText: Maintain your reputation with the Magram, and bring $1oa Petrified Bark and $2oa Imbued Tears back to Orgrul.
92847.title: Corrupting Tears

92858.description:
By order of General Feathermoon:

A bounty is being offered to whoever slays the ogre known as Ohk'zi. While not as pressing a threat as the naga, the Gordunni ogres are a similar menace to the lands of Feralas.

Ohk'zi was last seen at the Gordunni outpost east of here. The reward will be given upon proof of his death.

-- Latronicus Moonspear
92858.objectivesText: Bring the Staff of Ohk'zi to Latronicus Moonspear at Feathermoon Stronghold.
92858.title: WANTED: Ohk'zi

92859.description:
Folks have been trying to get onto Mount Hyjal since the end of the war, but there's one big problem... all the demons in Darkwhisper Gorge!

I think I have the solution. A concoction made from locally-sourced ingredients might be able to make the drinker blend in with the Winterspring surroundings so that creatures here can't see you as easily.

I'd love to test this theory, if you're game for bringing me a few small things!
92859.objectivesText: Bring $1oa Winterspring Chimaera Fur and $2oa Winterspring Owl Feathers to Evie Whirlbrew.
92859.title: Shroud of the Winter Wilds

92867.description:
Our heritage may be crumbling, but this is not our final redoubt. We have more in reserve, and it must remain hidden for its own protection.

Support grows for preserving our remaining sculptures and sacred burial grounds. The rabble that have taken up residence in our old kingdom have no notion of the vengeance coming for them.

Drive back the Boulderfist and Syndicate. They must learn Stromgarde is not merely fist, eagle, and stones.
92867.objectivesText: Defeat the Boulderfist, Syndicate, and Witherbark intruders in Stromgarde Keep and return to Groundskeeper Lomar.
92867.title: Ground to Keep

92872.description:
We eternally guard this tomb and the knowledge of ceremonial rites used to honor these fallen souls.

Now that you've descended three levels below the earth, you take your first steps toward returning to the sunlit world with sacred wisdom.

Each season, we carry some of the dust from this tomb and spread it to the oceans of Azeroth. A symbolic act of renewing cycles.

Take this small satchel. Travel to the cliffs behind Stromgarde Keep and cast it into the sea.

objectives.text: Pouch of Tomb Dust thrown into the sea behind Stromgarde

92872.objectivesText: Throw the Pouch of Tomb Dust into The Great Sea and return to Caretaker Alaric in the Stromgarde Keep crypt.
92872.title: Dutiful Steps

92873.description:
We already know these crystals are capable of more than sundering the ground--the Gelkis have proven that they can be twisted for necromantic power. Do you remember the bones I had you collect? I assembled them as best I could just up the hill. There was enough for two workable skeletons.

<Orgrul hands you a newly made staff.>

I will deliver the Necrokhan's staff while you play with your new toy. Return only once you can prove that you know how to use it.
92873.objectivesText: Maintain your reputation with the Magram Clan, then bring $1oa Well Cursed Bones from a successful ritual back to Orgrul.
92873.title: Proof of Concept

92878.description:
<The forsaken points to his missing lower jaw. He then hands you a piece of paper with a hastily scrawled message.>

Can't talk. Lost jaw in fight. Attacked by Grimtotems. Led by a druid. Namida. Camp to northwest.

She must pay.

<The last sentence is underlined twice.>
92878.objectivesText: Bring proof of Namida Grimtotem's demise to Blaise Montgomery at Camp Mojache.
92878.title: Lost for Words

92881.description:
The attacks on both the western and eastern watchtowers are not a coincidence. Based on what you told us about what occurred at the western watchtower with that skypriest, our best guess is that the cult is trying to do something to the anchor pylons.

Please speak with High Elder Shadowsong. He will tell you about a lead that could prove to be promising.
92881.objectivesText: Speak with Talaanis Shadowsong in Valanaar.
92881.title: The High Elder's Request

92911.description:
I see... this gives me some insight into what makes those monsters tick. I have an idea how we could override their systems, at least momentarily.

I'll continue tinkering with the assembly you brought me. In the meantime, could you scrounge up some parts for the device?
92911.objectivesText: Ozwin Ironsprocket at Saldean's Farm wants you to bring him 8 Golem Isosprings, 4 Copper Modulators, and a Crude Scope.
92911.title: Harvesting the Harvesters

92914.description:
<You approach the strange crystal, guarded mere moments ago by emaciated mana elementals.

Its pedestal, though ancient, is noticeably less dilapidated than the elven ruins it is built upon.

A weak hum of power radiates from the fractured gemstone, but with its magic so heavily depleted its purpose will ultimately remain a mystery for the time being.

Perhaps there is more to discover nearby.>
92914.objectivesText: Explore Shen'dralas in an effort to find other pylons like the one you found.
92914.title: Strange Pylons

92947.description:
Everyone is here, good. I've just sent a few of my best fighters in through the front of the shrine to cause a bit of trouble and serve as a distraction, while I lead the the bulk of our forces in from the flank.

If all goes well, we should be able to punch through quickly and take out the High Priestess. As for you, get in there and start cracking skulls. Meet my second, Hyusaa Quickbreeze, near the steps to the shrine after you've caused some trouble.

Winds guide you, $c.
92947.objectivesText: Slay $1oa Al'Aketh Guardians, $2oa Al'Aketh Spiritcallers, and $3oa Al'Aketh Blademasters, then report to Hyusaa Quickbreeze at the Shrine of Akir.
92947.title: Making Our Move

93016.description:
You will have to forgive me for sending you on such a series of tasks without providing any context. I hadn't considered how suspicious this may have seemed, more so now that the skies have taken on such a dramatic appearance.

I will gladly answer your questions.
93016.objectivesText: Speak with Mordent Evenshade in Shen'dralas for information about the crystals you repaired.
93016.title: A Brief History Lesson

93036.description:
You may or may not be aware of this, but Sania Silverstream over there is a "missionary" for the Al'Aketh. They like to play at being a normal religious order and send non-threatening emissaries around to recruit. We've tolerated Sania so far to avoid direct conflict with the cult, but it's obvious the illusion of peace won't last much longer.

You are new here and unknown to most, so I'd like to see if you can use Sania to get close to the cult and find out what their plans are for the village.
93036.objectivesText: Speak with Sania Silverstream in Shen'dar Village.
93036.title: Infiltrating the Cult

93045.description:
I have placed the skull you provided alongside several bones I found while awaiting your return. Immediately I saw a sickly light spread from the skull and claim those old bones as its own. I see now why the call of necromancy is so hard to resist.

Do you remember this crystal? It is draenethyst. I know little of its potential, but I believe it can channel Theradras' power. With it, perhaps you can dispel the curse.

The ritual site can be found by the pond just east of the village.
93045.objectivesText: Maintain your reputation with the Gelkis, and dispel the necromantic curse present on the Accursed Skull. Once successful, report back to Nerlokh near the Valley of Bones.
93045.title: Test Your Theory

93058.description:
There was a brief battle between a few of the necromancers just around the hill, and I used that to take a closer look inside.

$n, not all of our recent losses were defectors. There are Gelkis being held captive further in the valley! I was not able to investigate their situation because a hulking Magram brute started charging my direction. I consider myself fortunate he lost interest quickly.

You must go back into the Valley of Bones and free them. The Gelkis stand together.
93058.objectivesText: Maintain your reputation with the Gelkis clan, and rescue $1oa Gelkis Captives within the Valley of Bones. Return to Nerlokh near the entrance when you are done.
93058.title: Saving Our Own

93065.description: The Peacekeepers are mobilizing and we are all gearing up to head out. Make whatever preparations you need to make and meet us at the eastern road leading north out of town. We'll have one final check-in with everyone before we move out.
93065.objectivesText: Speak with Valennia Stormfist in the Gustberry Lowlands.
93065.title: Prepare for Battle

93122.description:
We have all underestimated the power and presence of the Magram clan in this area, but this could prove an advantage.

With so many of their own distracted and their refusal to accept other clans' exiles, who is left to defend the village? What of their Khan?

I need you to go into the valley, deeper than you have gone before, and look around. If the Magram are as well fortified here as they seem, they may have left themselves vulnerable at their village...
93122.objectivesText: Maintain your reputation with the Gelkis, and investigate centaur points of interest within Shen'dralas. Then return to Nerlokh at the entrance of Valley of Bones with your findings.
93122.title: Checking Things Out

93128.description:
As much as I would like Uthek or Khan Shaka to give the order, I fear our window of opportunity is short. Too short to consult those at Gelkis Village.

I believe with the situation unfolding here at the Valley of Bones that the Magram have left Khan Jehn with minimal defenses. If there was ever a time to attack another clan's Khan, it is now.

But $n, a Khan is not to be trifled with, least of all Jehn. If you are brave enough to make your move, you must be swift but do not underestimate him.
93128.objectivesText: Maintain your reputation with the Gelkis, and slay Khan Jhen at Magram Village. Once you have succeeded, report to Uthek the Wise in Gelkis Village in Desolace.
93128.title: Khan Jehn

93159.description:
Uh, um... h-hello, I mean to say, hi! Greetings, even! I'm sorry... it's um, been so long since I've actually spoken to another person. I'm afraid I'm a bit rusty at this.

<The strange hooded figure shifts uncomfortably before you.>

So er, um... how is your day going?

objectives.text: Learn more about the Strange Hermit

93159.objectivesText: Speak with the Strange Hermit in the Shadowgale Forest and learn more about him.
93159.title: The Strange Hermit

93160.description:
I do appreciate you stopping by to talk with me! I-If you do want to help out, I could use a bit of help gathering up acorns from the forest floor. I've gathered most of the ones close by but there sure are a lot of raptor-bird things in the forest. It's dangerous out there and I'd rather not become a giant bird's lunch!

So if you want, you could maybe gather them for me? I'll make us something tasty if you do!
93160.objectivesText: Gather $1oa Shadowgale Acorns in Shadowgale Forest.
93160.title: The Forest's Bounty

93161.description:
In the faint illumination of your torchlight, you can make out a small glint of metal. Upon further inspection, it's clear that this is the broken hilt of an ancient sword.

Despite missing a blade, you can clearly see that this hilt is a product of masterful workmanship. This is a precious heirloom, and there may be those who are interested to learn more about this.
93161.objectivesText: Find someone who would be interested in the Ancient Hilt you found in the ruins of Ban'aethal.
93161.title: The Ancient Hilt

93172.description:
Most of the elves on this island seem to think that these woods are haunted, and they aren't wrong.

At the old ruins to the northeast, a strange type of ghost-like spirits gather. Some nights, you can almost hear them "singing". It's not like any song I've heard before, but it's definitely a song and it's... just so sad.

I'm not sure why, but I think something terrible happened there at some point, and the spirits are trapped there somehow. If you are feeling brave, maybe you can help set them free?
93172.objectivesText: Destroy 10 Wind Hollows in Shadowgale Forest.
93172.title: Free the Hollows

93176.description:
Admiring my little menagerie, are you? They are my un-life's work. I've spent countless hours studying them: their anatomy, their diets, even their social rituals.

Do you wish to join me in the hobby? Here, take this package. The notes and materials contained within should get you started. If you lose it, you'll have to purchase another one from me for a small fee.
93176.objectivesText: Use the items contained in the Entomology Starter Kit to find and catch an Arbor Tarantula, Hay Weevil Specimen, and a Flesh Picker.
93176.title: My Little Friends

93197.completionText: Parcel of Mail delivered to Innkeeper Vizzie in Winterspring
93197.description:
With all of the fighting and the retreat from the Nordrassil Lodge, we've been terribly shorthanded out here.

If you are traveling back and forth between here and Everlook, I have some mail that needs to go to the town for distribution, and we need any waiting mail brought back up. I have a stack of parcels ready for transport, if you would be so good as to help.
93197.objectivesText: Take mail parcels from Sebelia at the summit camp on Mount Hyjal to Innkeeper Vizzie in Everlook.
93197.title: Mending Communications

93225.description:
I have noticed that centaur from different clans sometimes gather away from settlements and engage in trade. I have observed this across numerous nights and seemingly with every clan; most importantly I have seen the currency they use: carved totems.

I believe we can turn the tides in our favor with either the Gelkis or the Magram if we deliver a heavy bundle of totems right to them. I have already begun carving some, but I doubt they will be easily fooled without a few authentic ones.
93225.objectivesText: Acquire $1oa Carved Centaur Totems by slaying centaur of any clan throughout Desolace, then return them to Gurda Wildmane at Ghost Walker Post.
93225.title: Carved Centaur Totems

93314.description:
<Jereman shifts her weight, her feathers bristling in anger as she clacks her beak in displeasure.>

I do not know what awaits us here, but there is an overwhelming sense of wrongness about the mountain I have not felt in centuries. Having gotten a taste of the Wild King's magic first-talon however, I know he must be stopped.

I only pray we have arrived in time to save the other Wild Gods who reside here.
93314.objectivesText: Fully explore the Verdant Labyrinth, the Undergrove, and the Southern Peaks areas of Hyjal Summit.
93314.title: The Gods of the Summit

93318.description:
By order of Constable Aonda of the Peacekeepers, a bounty is hereby placed upon the scourge of the highlands, Vulgara the Insatiable. Last spotted on a hilltop rise just southwest of Shen'dar Village, the winged vuldren terror is highly dangerous and should be approached with caution.

Deliver the beast's head to Danarii Bellowveil to receive your reward.
93318.objectivesText: Kill Vulgara the Insatiable in the Shen'dar Highlands and bring her head to Danarii Bellowveil.
93318.title: WANTED: Vulgara the Insatiable

93341.description:
As the garden's caretaker, it was my responsibility to ensure it thrived.

I knew there would come a day when I could no longer maintain it, so I enchanted a necklace gifted from my daughter to transform a new generation of saplings into treants, so they could watch over the garden in my stead. I placed it on an enchanted pedestal, sheltered within a small shrine.

The garden was in great hands. I must know what happened.
93341.objectivesText: Investigate the Forlorn Gardens near Shen'dralas and then return to Mithera at the nearby temple.
93341.title: Forlorn Gardens

93362.description:
Please spare the details of how the life may have been twisted there. My heart is broken enough with the loss of my necklace.

But while I weep, the plants suffer.

$n, I would like you to go back to the garden and cull some of the angered flora. Please be swift and merciful; they can feel pain, and they have been hurt enough. If you intend to go hunting for my necklace as well, I would ask you to prioritize that before visiting the gardens again... in the unlikely chance you find it.
93362.objectivesText: Cull plants in the Forlorn Garden and then return to Mithera at Shen'dralas.
93362.title: What They've Done to My Peonies

93394.description:
I suspect your curiosity is luring you toward the grand structure now, yes? Good!

The Shen'dralar there are unlikely to welcome you with open arms, but so long as you tread respectfully, I do not think you will run into any trouble.

With any luck, my old friend Kirandis might be easy to find. Of everyone, he is the most likely to be amicable to your presence.
93394.objectivesText: Locate Magister Kirandis inside the temple of Shen'dralas.
93394.title: Meeting the Magister

93404.description:
I am the ancient. Towering above us. That which still burns despite many rains. I feel its flames in death. Forever burdened by my last mistake.

I do not know why I am cursed to haunt this place. I do not understand why death was not the end.

Please put out the flame. Seek pristine water from a sacred ravine. Such a place exists across Mashan'she. I have heard murmurs of the place in the wind.

Maraudon.
93404.objectivesText: Venture to Maraudon and recover a Vial of Earth Song Water and return it to Woodwyrd at the Forlorn Gardens in Desolace.
93404.title: Rot and Regret

93407.description:
We need to improve our defenses here, and we lack the resources to construct fortifications. We do, however, have all of the bounty of nature.

Search the forest for thorn bushes and bring their seeds back to me. With the power of nature, we will grow our own defenses.
93407.objectivesText: Find thorn seeds in the forests at the summit of Mount Hyjal and bring them back to Tiala Whitemane.
93407.title: A Thorn in the Paw

93465.description:
I suppose it would be more accurate to say I know someone who knows a thing or two about draenethyst.

You see, the warlocks of the Burning Blade have been studying it. It is a substance from beyond the dark portal, so it follows that those involved with darker arts might wish to harness it to their own ends. We cannot allow this, obviously.

The specific warlock you seek is named Gimashi. She can be found atop her tower, which is in a ravine to the southeast. Her notes will have the answers you seek.
93465.objectivesText: Take Gimashi's notes on Draenethyst, and bring them back to Azore Aldamort.
93465.title: Notes on Draenethyst

93521.description:
Ve'han's research notes describe his attempts to steal the power of the Wild Gods, following the ambitions of his leader, the Wild King. His successes were few, and hapless. Had he been a more powerful druid, he likely would have quickly devoured the essence of Jereman and gained even more power still.

The Guardians of Hyjal at the summit camp will definitely want to know about this.
93521.objectivesText: Take Ve'han's Research Notes to Tiala Whitemane.
93521.title: Challenger of the Gods

93547.description:
We are constantly under threat here, both by the Blackthorne Pact and by the hostile creatures of Hyjal. But we can use the thorns to our advantage! With a little help from the power of nature, we can grow new thorn bushes to help protect our enclosure.

Plant thorn seeds near the road to help create barricades by the inn, the storage tower, and the grouping of trees near the road.

objectives.text: Thorn seed planted near storage tower
Thorn seed planted near group of trees

93547.objectivesText: Plant thorn seeds near the inn, the storage tower, and the grouping of trees at the loyalist druid camp.
93547.title: A Thorny Solution

93552.description:
Windstones are a critical resource on Zephras Isle as they contain the raw, concentrated energy of the winds themselves. The wind elementals who used to live here on Zephras with us vanished a number of years ago, and since then, the magic that sustains this island is slowly fading. Not without limitations, the windstones are still a reliable energy source, and are incredibly valuable to us.

You'll find raw windstones scattered around the grove. Think you can help me harvest them?
93552.objectivesText: Collect 15 Windstone Clusters from Raw Windstones in Thendal Grove.
93552.title: Harvesting Windstones

93568.description:
<You hold a grimy collar retrieved from the belly of a slain creature. The material is of a high-quality leather, clearly stitched with care.

A tag dangles from a corroded buckle. You swipe away the gunk and can see Thalassian text, though the letters are stylized beyond readability, perhaps even to those familiar with the language.

Now, you are presented with a choice. Do you disregard this and move on with your life, or do you attempt the impossible and seek to bring closure to its owner?>
93568.objectivesText: Return the Partially Digested Collar to someone who knows about it. Presumably, they can be found in or near Shen'dralas in Desolace.
93568.title: Partially Digested Collar

93574.description:
<With a terrible crunch, you removed a piece of the worm's carapace upon its demise.

Despite its enormous size and hefty weight, it is disappointingly ordinary. This creature was seemingly not the result of a cruel experiment nor carefully bred to be an all-devouring beast.

It is simply an impressive shell, likely desired only by collectors. Perhaps you could find one, though other than the centaur, who else might be alive around here?>
93574.objectivesText: Find someone interested in Corpsefeeder's Carapace.
93574.title: Corpsefeeder's Carapace

93594.description:
Among the treants borne of the necklace, one in particular stood above all the others to have received the gift of life and sentience. I suspect if they have fallen, he may be the only one that remains.

He spent his days tending to each and every bloom and bud, and his evenings rooted in the ground to serve as a nest for the smaller critters.

If he is alive, and I pray that to be true, then he may know what happened.

I am holding out hope for my good friend, Woodwyrd.
93594.objectivesText: Find Woodwyrd in the Forlorn Gardens at Shen'dralas in the Desolace.
93594.title: Word of the Woods

93604.description:
Big $R heard of Razorfen Downs? <Snort.> Of course not! Big place in Barrens. Lots of thorns. Can't miss it.

Agamaggan died there. Important place for all quilboar. Now bristleback not allowed. Belong to sniffle-snorting Razorfen. Razorfen disrespect quilboar history!

Agamaggan's blood feeds the valley. Grow thorns. BIG ones. Bigger than puny elf necklace ever could!

Go to the Downs. Fetch Kog'thug blood. Stale blood from the kraul won't work. Need GOOD blood!

Give blood, get necklace, win.
93604.objectivesText: Venture to Razorfen Downs and acquire Virulent Blood of Agamaggan, then return it to Kog'thug the Brave at Bristleback Retreat in the Desolace. Kog'thug felt it worth reminding that the Blood of Agamaggan inside Razorfen Kraul would not be sufficient.
93604.title: Agamaggan's Blood

93617.description:
The hierarchy of the Wild Gods is bent. Now, all is in motion, and the nature of the world is as malleable as clay!

No more will my kin suffer the fangs of predators, for now, we shall prey upon all who have devoured us!

Tremble, fragile creature, for you have neither the strength nor the speed to dissuade us!
93617.objectivesText: Dissuade stags from acting as predators.
93617.title: Prey and Predator

93678.description:
I've prepared a transcription of Gimashi's notes on draenethyst. It appears the shards possess some degree of energy, but a pure sphere of the stuff is vastly more powerful. That seems to be what the Burning Blade was after.

Many of Gimashi's notes allude to portals and demonic summoning rituals. Portals to where, or to summon which demons, I cannot say for sure.

While my answers are not definitive, please take these notes back to the swamp with you. I hope you'll understand if I don't come along.
93678.objectivesText: Take Azore's transcribed notes back to Magtoor at the Harborage in Swamp of Sorrows.
93678.title: Abridged Notes on Draenethyst

93680.description:
The Alliance had an army of mages known as the Kirin Tor. While they were powerful, the demonic Burning Legion proved to be even more so. In one fell swoop, the arch demon Archimonde flattened their city like it was a child's plaything. Those who remained were reduced to merely dispossessed vagabonds.

That is, until they rebuilt Dalaran. And on the Dark Lady's very doorstep, no less!

While in their camps, search for something that can get us into the city unnoticed. I must know more.
93680.objectivesText: Acquire the Dalaran Sewer Key for Magus Wordeen Voidglare in Tarren Mill.
93680.title: Key to the City

93685.description:
Can your miniscule brain comprehend the rarity of a flawless sphere of draenethyst, $r? Draenei have spent lifetimes in search of just one of these crystals, only to meet horrible fates, their purpose unfulfilled.

So you stand before Kum'isha, knowing what Kum'isha has requested and still wish to assist? Very well, $r... At any time during your travels across these lands, should you find a flawless sphere of draenethyst, return it to me and I shall reward you with riches beyond your wildest dreams.
93685.objectivesText:
Find a Flawless Draenethyst Sphere in the Blasted Lands, and bring it to Kum'isha the Collector.

Be warned, this gem is one of the rarest crystals in all of Azeroth. Any creature in these lands could be holding a Flawless Draenethyst Sphere.
93685.title: To Serve Kum'isha

93689.description:
This is excellent news! With Dalaran returned to peace, I can see no reason the Kirin Tor would not welcome you with open arms!

Please, report to the council with great haste. I'm sure they will be looking forward to meeting the city's savior.
93689.objectivesText: Speak with Archmage Celindra in the City of Dalaran.
93689.title: Friend of the Kirin Tor

93735.description:
Historically, the Windshapers have seen to the tending of the magical instruments and devices that were gifted to us by the spirits of the wind. This includes the myriad of magical constructs around the island. Since the spirits left us, only a scant few of these are still functional.

One of the few remaining working constructs in Valanaar has become damaged. One of our artisans was dispatched to help, but he may be in need of aid. Travel to the west end of the city and offer any assistance you can.
93735.objectivesText: Find Riaani Nightwind on the west side of Valanaar.
93735.title: The Broken Construct

93736.description:
The paramount concern of the Windshapers is to better understand why the spirits left us, and what we may be able to do to bring them back. One curious fixture of Shadowgale Forest to the north is the presence of a curious form of wind sprite that some call "hollows". We know little of them and why they are there, but we do know that they first started to appear after the spirits of the wind left us.

I need you to go there and disperse them. Gather the remains and bring them back here.
93736.objectivesText: Gather 10 Wind Hollow Essences from Wind Hollows in the Shadowgale Forest.
93736.title: Unwelcome Spirits

93737.description:
Oh, hello. Ayessa sent you to assist me? Very well then. 

Not sure what an obvious novice like yourself can do, but if you give me a moment to pull my head out of this construct's innards I might have a few ideas of things you can do to help.

objectives.text: Listen to what Riaani Nightwind has to say
Obtain Crystallized lightning from the Shriekling Cave
Obtain Enchanted Gyrozephyr from Windsong Lake
Obtain Air Construct Core from the Bandit Camp

93737.objectivesText: Speak with Riaani Nightwind and listen to what he has to say.
93737.title: The Broken Construct

93739.description:
Azeroth is a large world, and the territory of the Horde is vast. The Undercity, Orgrimmar, and Thunder Bluff all have very unique people and culture.

If you are to be a guest of the Horde here on Azeroth, it would do you good to visit each of our capital cities in turn. Speak with my advisor Nazgrel for directions.
93739.objectivesText: Speak with Nazgrel in Grommash Hold to receive further instructions. Use the instructions received to locate and speak with Vol'jin, Cairne Bloodhoof, and Lady Sylvanas Windrunner.
93739.title: Exploring the Horde

93786.description:
Does your blade thirst for human blood, $n?

Some years ago, the human defectors laid claim to a small farm to the southwest across the river. With the area rich in lumber and stone, it was only a matter of time before they expanded their reach to the keep along the eastern shore known as Farholde.

Our first skirmishes would have ended in our favor if we'd had the numbers. It's time to remind them of our presence.

Disrupt their farming efforts. Take no prisoners. Send them a clear message.
93786.objectivesText: Slay $1oa Meadowsbrook Farmhands, then return to Krom'rosh with news of your success.
93786.title: A Message in Blood

93787.description:
Humans within these lands have long enjoyed the warmth, comfort and sustenance these lands provide. It's time we start denying these humans such pleasantries.

Seek out the supplies of our enemies at the farm to the southwest. Take whatever you find.

It won't bring pleasure like bloodying a blade, but slowing them buys us time to plan our next move.
93787.objectivesText: Steal $1oa Feed Satchels from the Alliance farm in Meadowsbrook then return to Krom'rosh.
93787.title: Food for the Taking

93791.description:
$n, it is clear your skill with magic is growing and I believe it is time for you to partake in one of the High Order's oldest traditions for young and aspiring mages. It is time for you to craft a spell focus of your own.

Seek out Belann Windwood in Valanaar. He has been crafting staves and wands for the High Order for over a century, so you will be in good hands.
93791.objectivesText: Speak with Belann Windwood in Valanaar.
93791.title: Speak with Belann

93825.description:
You wish to learn from us? The trees of Hyjal speak to us. Their bark holds life, and on it grows the moss we call Moonveil. It is soft, green, and strong with the mountain's soul. We need this moss to heal our hurt and bless roots.

Go, gentle one. Seek the old trees where the mist clings and the sun hides. Take Moonveil moss from their bark and bring it back to me. With it, we will mend what pains us.
93825.objectivesText: Gather $1oa clumps of Moonveil Moss and return to Suma Mossmane.
93825.title: Barkbound Blessings

93826.description:
The old ways are lost to Deadwood. Their claws rip the wood, their hearts burn with rage. They strike at us, and the wilds shake.

You, friend of furbolg, can help. Go to their den. Show them the wild will not bow to greed. Slay those who foul the roots, and come back when their cries fade from the trees. Bring an end to their wise, but sad, sages. They twist fel and foul vines.

Do this, and we will speak to the spirits of your name.
93826.objectivesText: Defeat $1oa Deadwood Totemics and $2oa Deadwood Fel-Tenders and return to Elder Pinespeaker.
93826.title: Deal Dread to Deadwood

93827.description:
The mountain winds bring dark signs. Harpies nest high where our paws do not go. The gems they wear hold strong power. Bound with our charms, they guard us from curse and bind the spirits to our wards.

But the climb is hard, and the harpies strike with claw and storm. If you are strong like they say, go to the high crags where the wind screams. Harpy grounds are in mid land Hyjal, we see them fly above us, in the north east. Take the charms from the sky witches and bring them to me.
93827.objectivesText: Collect $1oa Enchanted Harpy Amulet and return to Thobon Sapclaw.
93827.title: Windswept Wards

93834.description:
Burrow beetles! They're a bane... and now they dig in our den more than their own. We beat them back and swing clubs when we see them skulk by, but they are quick, and to hide in the dark is their shield.

If you spot them as you climb our den, squash them! We will take their crushed shells and make a meal, so it is not all bad.
93834.objectivesText: Gather $1oa Burrow Beetle Bits for Dala Fairmaw.
93834.title: Burrow Beetles

93836.description:
Muln has told me much of the elemental lords and I am afraid that we have good reason to fear Al'Akir. Now that the wards that have hidden Zephras from his view are down, we are utterly defenseless. If he chooses to attack us, we stand no chance against him here in his own domain.

High Elder Shadowsong needs to know of the danger we are in, and more importantly, what our intentions are for our mission to Azeroth. We will find the means to save our home. I swear it.
93836.objectivesText: Speak with Talaanis Shadowsong in Valanaar.
93836.title: The Fate of Zephras

93848.description:
The magic that Ketharas was able to craft to counteract this threat was vital to this victory. Our druids should be able to replicate the magic and use it to dispel the wards empowering the Blackthorne Pact at scale.

You should go back to Ketharas and let him know what transpired here. Tell him that he has the thanks of the Guardians of Hyjal and the Cenarion Circle. He should know that he is always welcome amongst us should he desire a place alongside his fellow druids once again.
93848.objectivesText: Return to Ketharas and inform him of what occurred at the Summit of Eternity.
93848.title: Work Well Done

93952.description:
Barkskin stand on weak roots. Deadwood claw at our land, each day their rot digs deep, sinks more. We cannot hold alone. 

Deadwood Den guards are the brunt of their strength. If you seek our trust, strike down those who foul the wood. When their Guardians fall, the rest of their tribe will weaken. We even our odds.

Bring them down, for balance, and help keep Hyjal whole.
93952.objectivesText: Defeat $1oa Deadwood Den Guardians and return to Brerufa.
93952.title: Balance Through Strength

93963.description:
Stormwind, Ironforge, and Darnassus all have unique peoples and cultures. As a guest of the Alliance here on Azeroth, you should take some time to visit each of our capital cities in turn. 

Speak with Randal Emerson in the southern antechamber for directions to get you started.
93963.objectivesText: Speak with Randal Emerson in Stormwind Keep to receive further instructions. Use the instructions received to locate and speak with King Magni Bronzebeard, High Tinker Mekkatorque, and Tyrande Whisperwind.
93963.title: Exploring the Alliance

93971.description: <The report is sealed with the sigil of Farholde. This information may be of interest to Krom'rosh at Rog'mar.>
93971.objectivesText: Bring the report to Krom'rosh at Rog'mar.
93971.title: Farholde Scouting Report

94003.description:
I am all that remains of the line of Skybreakers here on Zephras Isle. The rest were murdered by the Al'Aketh.

The only thing that outweighs my sorrow is my shame. My family's ancestral shield--the Skybreaker Bulwark--is now in the hands of a cultist named Zaal Stormshield. Family lore holds no harm may befall a worthy wielder of this shield.

Zaal is not worthy, of that I am sure. Find this man at the Shrine of Akir and reclaim my shield from him. Do this and I will teach you the Skybreaker Defense.
94003.objectivesText: Reclaim the Skybreaker Bulwark from Zaal Stormshield at the Shrine of Akir.
94003.title: The Skybreaker Bulwark

94050.description:
You now have the power to tame a pet, but you must also gain the skills to train it. For this, there is none better than my sister, Quel'dora. She will give you the ability to train your new pet. 

Go with the winds, young $c.
94050.objectivesText: Speak to Quel'dora Quickgale in Valanaar.
94050.title: Training the Beast

94413.description:
The recent emergence of the leylines on the surface of Zephras has been profound for our order. We have more direct and tangible access to the energies that permeate this place and it has increased our understanding of said magic greatly.

The Windshapers, however, view these emergences as scars on the land that must be "healed". This is an affront to our order and is something we simply cannot abide.

Go to the leyline in the forest to the southwest and drive off the Windshapers you find there.
94413.objectivesText: Slay 6 Windshaper Novice Seers in Shen'dar Highlands.
94413.title: A Magical Affront

94414.description:
Greetings, young $n. I oftentimes come here to look upon the ancient anchor pylon. Gifts from the spirits of the winds, they bind and sustain our island. Of late however, their magic has grown unstable and inconsistent.

They suffer no distress I can see. Their splendor has not changed.

If you'd like, I can lend you my gift to look upon them yourself.
94414.objectivesText: Speak with Halaan Hawk-Eye and borrow his gift to view the anchor pylon in the distance.
94414.title: The Anchors of Zephras

94438.areaDescription: Take the Symbol of Life and use it to resurrect Deathguard Falgan at Venomweb Vale.
94438.completionText: Take the Symbol of Life and use it to resurrect Deathguard Falgan at Venomweb Vale.
94438.description:
Falgan and I were sent on a mission to scout out scarlet activity in Venomweb Vale. We managed to sneak close enough to one of their camps to hear about new orders involving an attack on Brill. Before we could decide what to do next, I stepped on a twig and the noise alerted them to us.

Falgan yelled at me to run, so I ran. By the time I realized he wasn't with me, I was halfway to Brill. That brave idiot probably stayed behind to hold them off for me.

Please, find my friend and help him if you can.
94438.objectivesText:
Take the Symbol of Life and use it to resurrect Deathguard Falgan at Venomweb Vale. 

Should you misplace your Symbol of Life, return to Danitha Morr for a replacement.
94438.title: A Lesson in Divinity

94440.description:
These Scarlet Crusaders often carry satchels with their deployment orders. We know an attack is coming, but if we can recover their orders, we can warn the rest of the Deathguard and prepare an ambush. 

You are clearly an impressive paladin. Kill these scarlet animals and retrieve a copy of their orders and bring them back to Deathguard Billmuth. He'll take it from there.
94440.objectivesText: Retrieve the Scarlet Crusade Attack Plans from the Scarlet Crusaders at Venomweb Vale, and return to Deathguard Billmuth at Bandarion Keep.
94440.title: A Lesson in Divinity

94465.description:
Aye, ye've the strength to bear the totem o' fire, lad--but strength alone won't make ye ready.

Beyond the Valley o' Kings, in the crags of Loch Modan, lies a hidden path to one o' our sacred peaks. There, Braldir Ashmantle guards the Shrine o' the Dormant Flame. 

Take this torch to him--it shows yer intent. Return it burnin' by the shrine's brazier, and I'll see ye earn the totem proper.
94465.objectivesText: Bring the Torch of the Dormant Flame to Braldir Ashmantle in Loch Modan.
94465.title: Call of Fire

94466.description:
Bah, ye didn't trek all this way for tales, did ye, $n? Ye seek the Eternal Flame and the fire totem.

First, ye'll need a sapta to bind yer spirit to the flame.

I'll craft it--but I'll need two things: fire tar from Tunnel Rat Geomancers in the kobold caves up north, and a reagent pouch from a Stonesplinter Seer lurkin' in the southern hills. Dangerous work, but worthy of the flame.
94466.objectivesText: Bring 1 Fire Tar and 1 Reagent Pouch to Braldir Ashmantle in Loch Modan.
94466.title: Call of Fire

94479.description:
Picking up the rusting metal, you see another, shinier, engineering component. It looks like anything else of use has been picked clean.

Perhaps somebody nearby recognizes this part or who might want to salvage it.
94479.objectivesText: Search the Tainted Foothills for someone interested in the metallic piece you found.
94479.title: One Person's Trash

94480.description:
The humans of these lands are only one of many threats. With the encroaching Twilight and snarls of gnolls echoing from the hills nearby, battle may call at a moment's notice. Maintaining the strength of our allies may be the difference between Rog'mar's success or our removal from these lands.

Deliver the goods you've gathered to Gorg. He'll make sure our allies are well fed.
94480.objectivesText: Deliver the Stolen Feed to Gorg in Rog'mar.
94480.title: A Gift From Our Enemies

94485.description:
If we are to save my fellows in the Nightclaw Den, I am going to need some ingredients for a poultice. The first and most important is a spindly moss called Lady's Tear. It typically grows on the base of the trees here in Shadowgale.

This moss secretes a sticky substance that acts as an antiseptic and is perfect for binding open wounds. I have gathered what little I can reach but I know there is more in this forest.

Go and be swift. We are going to need a lot if the injured I left behind still live.
94485.title: Tears of the Lady

94488.description:
The reason for cultists' presence here still baffles me, but I smell a familiar scent over the bloodshed.

One of our circle druids, Haalien, disappeared months back. It appears he's thrown his sorry hide in with the cultists.

Show him what happens when he spills the blood of his kin! Take his head and return it to me.
94488.objectivesText: Kill Commander Haalien and bring his head to Elegael Thornpaw in the Shadowgale Forest.
94488.title: The Ties That Bind

94491.description:
It would appear that there is a correspondent hiding somewhere in Valanaar feeding information to the cult. I am clearly in no shape to make the journey, but Lotheluum needs to know what transpired here.

He should also know the fate of those who are no longer with us. Thanks to your help I think we can handle the rest of the situation from here, though the damage has been done.

Please go swiftly, $n. I hope our paths will cross again someday. Until then, I have cultists to slay.
94491.objectivesText: Give the missive to Lotheluum in Valanaar and tell him what has transpired.
94491.title: The Fate of the Den

94494.description:
Long has it been since ye were last tested, $n. Ye have shown patience thus far in yer studies, but the time has come for ye to learn about the purity of water.

Seek out Norric Lochthane in Loch Modan. He is along the north western edge o' the lake, south of Stonewrought Dam. Ye will find him there at his burrow hut. Good luck to ye, $n.
94494.objectivesText: Find Norric Lochthane in Loch Modan.
94494.title: Call of Water

94497.description:
Ah, so ye've come seekin' the sapta, have ye? Well then, listen close, love. To find understandin' and earn the sapta, ye must seek water in its various forms. As ye gather the samples, keep yer eyes open. Watch the beasts that guard it, the land it nourishes, and how it changes lives.

We'll start simple: fill this skin at the base o' the falls, where the fresh meets the brackish. Go on now, and mind the marsh.
94497.objectivesText: Fill the Empty Brown Waterskin at the bottom of the waterfalls below Hervdana's cave and return it to her in the Wetlands.
94497.title: Call of Water

94499.description:
Aye, Redridge drinks deep from Lake Everstill, but by the time the waters tumble down Stonewatch Falls, somethin' has seeped in. The murlocs down there are big, twisted brutes. Not like the ones ye find here or in the Loch. Lucky for the townsfolk they keep to the base o' the falls.

Bring a sampling to me. I've a mind to find out if it's magic, venom, or somethin' worse that's taintin' the waters near that old fort.
94499.objectivesText: Fill the Empty Red Waterskin at Stonewatch Falls near the Nightcrawler Murlocs and return to Hervdana Saegrund in the Wetlands.
94499.title: Call of Water

94533.description:
Among the cackling inhabitants of the Bristle Hills southwest of here is an elder gnoll by the name of Snargl. The sounds emanating from this particular gnoll are quite unpleasant. Their presence inspires those around, creating a problem for allies and scouts who enter the area.

A trophy as a memento of our having dealt with this most unpleasant gnoll fiend would fit nicely with my collection.

Be swift about it, $n.
94533.objectivesText: Locate Snargl in the Bristle Hills, kill him, and retrieve his snout for Neza Bloodsnout.
94533.title: Snargl's Snout

94556.description: Jom-jom came looking for friend. Now Jom-jom want to go home.
94556.objectivesText: Escort Jom-jom to Clugfist at Bolder'ok.
94556.title: Jom-jom's Escape

94613.description:
Our warhorses come from two nearby farms. One of them, owned by the Wheeler family off the road just outside of town, has apparently lost all of their stock. The cause of this is currently unknown.

With no horses, we have no cavalry, and without cavalry, our campaign against the Horde stands no chance.

Thus, you see, this situation must be resolved with utmost haste. Of where to start, however, I am less sure.

Go to Wheeler's Grange and speak to Benjy. See what he has to say for himself.
94613.objectivesText: Go to Wheeler's Grange to inquire about the missing horses.
94613.title: My Kingdom for a Horse

94618.description:
From what you found, it seems like the coyotes got most of the horses. Still, there's a few not accounted for.

Those that didn't get eaten probably ran off scared someplace. I don't know how many of those horses there are, but we'd better find 'em before the coyotes come back.

<Benjy holds out a sack in front of you.>

Here. If you find one, give it some of our feed. That'll get it to trust you so you can lead it back here.
94618.objectivesText: Find one of the horses that fled Wheeler's Grange after the coyote attack and give it some feed.
94618.title: Wheeler's Fleeing Steeds

94678.description:
The gnolls have been a thorn in our side ever since we arrived. While less a threat than the Twilight's Hammer, they are aggressive, persistent and, worst of all, numerous.

The hills beyond this post are infested with them, making passage to the north dangerous, and posing a threat to those living outside the walls of Farholde Keep.

If we are ever to make these lands safe, removing the gnoll threat is imperative.
94678.objectivesText: Kill $1oa Redridge Mystics, $2oa Redridge Trappers, and $3oa Redridge Brutes for Cedric Dalton at Southern Watch.
94678.title: Gnoll Infestation

94679.description:
Gnolls value strength above all else. By killing their strongest, we not only lessen the threat they pose physically, but also strike fear into their hearts.

In a den among the Bristle Hills is a notorious gnoll by the name of Snargl. His death would no doubt sow panic among the Redridge's ranks.

Bring me his snout, and be quick about it.
94679.objectivesText: Locate Snargl in the Bristle Hills, kill him, and bring his snout to Cedric Dalton at Southern Watch.
94679.title: Snargl's Snout

94739.description:
Glad you made it through the first round, I guess.

This next contestant and I go way back. He ain't the brightest fella, but he's sure good at pummeling anything in his path.

Just head on into the pit and get yourself ready while I make the announcement.
94739.objectivesText: Defeat Kronk in the Bloodmaster's Ring.
94739.title: Bloodmaster's Ring

94775.description: Elune bless you, good $r. I hope your Light finds you and protects you well this day.$B$BOne of your priests was here not long ago looking for you. He mentioned you returning to the Cathedral of Light as soon as possible to speak with High Priestess Laurena. It seems you've done well to garner such attention. I wouldn't spend too much time here--your people have need of you.
94775.objectivesText: Speak to High Priestess Laurena in Stormwind.
94775.title: Divine Grace

94820.description: Your race is so very clever, $n. We are proud to call you allies. And as each day's sun sets, you and your kin grow closer to reclaiming your city, but with the burden of keeping your families safe in exile. That yearning for home must weigh heavily on you.$B$BWord came from Ironforge just recently. It asked that you return there and speak to High Priestess Mims in the Mystic Ward. I would not keep her waiting. May Elune guide your travels.
94820.objectivesText: Speak to High Priestess Mims in Ironforge.
94820.title: Contingency Plan

94829.description:
If you've come to demand more of our crop, you're too late. No doubt you saw my farm. Destroyed. All of it.

Good folk toiled in these fields for years to feed troops and civilians alike. But when those cultists arrived, where was the military? Where was our promised protection after all the rations they'd taken from us?

If you've any sense of decency, I beg you. The least we can do is recover their belongings from those cursed raiders. Let my people rest with their kin in the graveyard to the west.
94829.objectivesText: Collect $1oa Farmers' Mementos from Twilight Raiders and place them on the graves west of Elbrim's Farm.
94829.title: What We Lost

94832.description:
Unfortunately I haven't had much luck with identifying the ring's owner to bring closure to their family.

Perhaps Daythor can be of assistance. He knew the others of our regiment quite well.

I only hope it does not bring back unpleasant memories...
94832.objectivesText: Show the ring to Daythor Brellan.
94832.title: Belle's Ring

94841.description:
<A handwritten label appears on the side of the crate. On the right side is a map with a large red circle along a southeastern shoreline north of a poorly drawn temple surrounded by water and some kind of winged creatures. On the left is a note in massive font.>

PROPERTY OF FRIZ FRAZZLESPARK

POWDERFUSE PORT

WARNING: NOT for tampering. Do NOT open without supervision.

<An additional note appears at the bottom of the label.>

If lost, return to Friz Frazzlespark. Powderfuse Port. Riverglades.
94841.objectivesText: Deliver the Lost Shipping Crate to Friz Frazzlespark at Powderfuse Port in the Riverglades.
94841.title: Lost Shipping Crate

94842.description:
We make our own fertilizer out here. It's a special formula of mine that reeks like hell, but grows trees like they're weeds.

It's a 1:1:2 ratio of crawfish shells, manure, and murloc heads. Tasty, right?

The manure's easy enough. We've got the ranch to the south for that. The heads and shells? Those you're going to have to go wading in the river for.

If you feel like lending a hand, we could sure use your help getting some fertilizer ingredients.
94842.objectivesText: Gather 4 Jumbo Crawfish Shells, 4 pieces of Fresh Manure, and 8 Mudfin Murloc Heads for Halligan Turner.
94842.title: Unsavory Plant Food

94861.areaDescription: Go with Hurley to save Curly.
94861.description:
Well, I guess that explains why Curly didn't come back for lunch break. Looks like I have to bail him out again -- typical. The way he makes me worry, I swear, I'll be gray in a year.

Come on, we'll have to save him ourselves, and it sounds like we don't have much time.
94861.objectivesText: Go with Hurley to save Curly.
94861.title: Helping Hands

94872.description:
The fierce Magram are undoubtedly winning the war of territories at the moment. While we can all be thankful the clashes haven't erupted too frequently throughout the desert, every day their village just to the east grows a little bigger; their soldiers a little bolder.

I worry gravely about the consequences of an unchecked Magram clan, but I cannot deny their potential as an ally.

If you wish to earn their trust, offer this sack of totems to their quartermaster, but be careful.
94872.objectivesText: Bring the Totem Tote to the Magram Quartermaster at Magram Village in the Desolace to significantly increase your reputation with that clan. You must be of at least Neutral standing with the Magram Clan Centaur.
94872.title: Buying Friendship: Magram

94877.description:
When you look around you, what do you see? A broken home and a tired people.

Stormwind has left us to fend for ourselves, and we have less to do that with every day. Many within these walls are refugees who barely escaped tragedy without so much as even their own families.

Farholde is no Stormwind, stranger. We lost a settlement in the northwest to the Twilight's Hammer, but we will not let them keep it. If you wish to fight, go to Sunnyglade and purge those savages from our lands.
94877.objectivesText: Defeat $1oa Twilight Raiders, $2oa Twilight Shadowmancers, and $3oa Twilight Neophytes within Sunnyglade for Demar Brant.
94877.title: Saving Sunnyglade

94884.description:
I've had enough of this cave. Once you clear your way out, I'll slip out amidst the chaos.

I'm afraid I'm in too weak of condition to carry those samples, however. Their energy is overwhelming, and I've been trapped down here for Light knows how long. Once we get out of here, please take them to Lady Amberhall immediately. I must rest.
94884.objectivesText: Bring the Filled Crystal Catalyst to Ashe Amberhall in Farholde Keep.
94884.title: An Unsettling Discovery

94886.completionText: Find Sergeant Riftan near the Twilight's Shroud to the west.
94886.description:
As helpful as you've been here in Farholde, I believe your talents could be put to better use elsewhere.

A patrol of ours went missing some time ago. They were in charge of our western borders, but with the information Miss Amberhall has uncovered, I fear they walked right into the Twilight Hammer's central encampment.

We can handle the cleanup in Sunnyglade ourselves. If the good lady is right, it's critical that we check on our wayward sergeant. He could use all the help he can get.
94886.objectivesText: Find Sergeant Riftan near the Twilight's Shroud to the west.
94886.title: The Western Front

94887.description:
Field Marshal Ryan is one of our best. His keen eyes and reliable intel have been paramount to our war efforts.

His final reports refer to a Twilight's Hammer fortress to the west. Find him before it's too late. And take his logbook with you. It may offer more clues as to the whereabouts of our missing marshal.
94887.objectivesText: Find Marshal Ryan within the Twilight's Shroud.
94887.title: Saving Marshal Ryan

94890.description:
With this kind of momentum, we can't stop now. The soldiers we rescued are itching to draw blood, and you've already proven yourself a capable battering ram.

Return to the Twilight's Shroud and finish what we've started. Their leader, an orc by the name of Overlord Kilgar, hides deep within his keep while his underlings are lost in their panic.

If we want to put an end to this, bring me the head of Kilgar. These gods-fearing cowards can't make a single decision on their own.
94890.objectivesText: Defeat Overlord Kilgar within the Twilight's Shroud and bring his head to Sergeant Riftan.
94890.title: Bring Me His Head

94891.description:
Seems like things are quieting down around here for now, but I want to keep an eye out. You want to send Amberhall a report? Send her this.

<Sergeant Riftan tosses Kilgar's head back to you.>

That ought to shut her up. At least for a while. Good work out there.
94891.objectivesText: Return to Ashe Amberhall in Farholde Keep.
94891.title: News to Farholde

94892.completionText: Return to Knight Commander Demar Brant in Farholde Keep.
94892.description:
It's too late for me, stranger. I'm not going to be making it out of this one. Take my crest to the Knight Commander. Warn him...

<Ryan's eyes begin to glaze over as he mumbles to himself.>

I'm sorry. I should have come home. Abigail...
