94892.objectivesText: Return Marshal Ryan's crest to Knight Commander Demar Brant in Farholde Keep.
94892.title: Dying Wish

94893.completionText: Deliver Marshal Ryan's Crest to Terry Lawrence in the Cathedral Square of Stormwind City.
94893.description:
So, his final thoughts were of Abigail?

I know this is not your business, friend, but I must ask you to deliver the news of the Marshal's passing on my behalf. Ryan's betrothed, Abigail Lawson, did not join us when we established Farholde Keep. The two of them apparently had a disagreement, and while I do not know the specifics, I do know that she now resides within Stormwind City.

Please take the Marshal's crest to Terry for me. I don't think my presence would be a welcome one.
94893.objectivesText: Deliver Marshal Ryan's Crest to Abigail Lawson in the Cathedral Square of Stormwind City.
94893.title: Delivering Closure

94894.completionText: Deliver Kilgar's Head to Bolvar Fordragon within Stormwind Keep in Stormwind City.
94894.description:
Lady Amberhall told me of your exploits with the Twilight's Hammer. I'm impressed. But concerned.

Farholde started its campaign originally to remove the Horde from our homeland. While that remains our primary goal, we cannot take this sudden surge in cultist activity lightly. If our pleas to Stormwind remain unheard, we will be overwhelmed as we face foes on two fronts alone.

With the evidence you carry, perhaps they can set aside their pride long enough to listen. At this point it's our only option.
94894.objectivesText: Deliver Kilgar's Head to Bolvar Fordragon within Stormwind Keep in Stormwind City.
94894.title: The Twilight Threat

94895.description:
<A handwritten label appears on the side of the crate. On the right side is a map with a large red circle along a southeastern shoreline north of a poorly drawn temple surrounded by water and some kind of winged creatures. On the left is a note in massive font.>

PROPERTY OF FRIZ FRAZZLESPARK

POWDERFUSE PORT

WARNING: NOT for tampering. Do NOT open without supervision.

<An additional note appears at the bottom of the label.>

If lost, return to Friz Frazzlespark. Powderfuse Port. Riverglades.
94895.objectivesText: Deliver the Lost Shipping Crate to Friz Frazzlespark at Powderfuse Port in the Riverglades.
94895.title: Lost Shipping Crate

94896.description:
You look like a capable adventurer. Do you happen to be headed towards Shadowgale Forest? Ban'aethal lies deep in the forest; that's where we're all from.

<Ealaane gestures to the other refugees.>

We've recently had to evacuate Ban'aethal, as it began to fall into the sky. It was sudden and in the middle of the night. If you are headed that way, would you please look for any belongings left behind? The forest and village are far too dangerous for us to return to now.
94896.objectivesText: Collect $1oa Abandoned Belongings from the ruins of Ban'aethal.
94896.title: Aid For The Refugees

94907.description:
You've been such a good little $c for me, I wonder if I could ask you to do one more small favor.

With the reagents you collected being so finely attuned to Twilight's Hammer magic, they are perfect for a summoning ritual. However, we'll need to take them to the source of their power.

Should you happen upon a conduit while you're gallivanting about the Twilight's Shroud, see if you can't call upon one of the cult's thralls and capture it with this soulstone for me. For questioning, of course.
94907.objectivesText: Summon a Twilight's Thrall from a conduit within the Twilight Shroud and capture it with Amberhall's Soulstone.
94907.title: A Small Favor

94911.description:
Greetings, young $r. I can see that you have much promise in the druidic arts. There is one who you may want to speak with in the city of Thunder Bluff by the name of Turak Runetotem. He will teach you how to reach the stronghold of the Cenarion Circle on Kalimdor, Moonglade. 

You will be welcomed there, and the druids of the circle will impart their knowledge upon you. 

As your people would say--go with the wind's blessing, young one. I wish you good fortune in your adventures.
94911.objectivesText: Speak with Turak Runetotem in Thunder Bluff.
94911.title: Child of Nature

94912.description:
Greetings, young $c. 

Have you heard of the Cenarion Circle? I'd expect not. They are an ancient order of naturalists and practitioners of the druidic arts, much like yourself. In the city of Stormwind you'll find a night elf by the name of Sheldras Moontree. He will teach you how to reach the stronghold of the Cenarion Circle on Kalimdor, a place called Moonglade.

Go now. You have much to learn if you wish to save your home.
94912.objectivesText: Speak with Sheldras Moontree in Stormwind.
94912.title: Child of Nature

94923.description:
<Robbie leans in to talk to you, as if sharing a grave secret.>

Psst! Hey $gmister:miss;, I need your help!

My sister got me a hat for my birthday but I lost it playing in the river. I'm not allowed to be down there because of the murlocs so I can't ask Dad or Ellie for help because then they'll know where I was!

It's a good hat. I bet one of those murlocs found it and kept it for himself!
94923.objectivesText: Find Robbie's Hat somewhere along the river near the murlocs.
94923.title: Hats Off

94926.description:
Like most ogre weaponry, this hammer is large, unwieldy, and well-worn. A creature of any other race could hardly swing it at all.

To you, it is of little more use than a trophy, but perhaps someone at Farholde would appreciate knowing of Komuk's demise.
94926.objectivesText: Take Komuk's Maul to Farholde Keep as proof of the ogre's demise.
94926.title: Drop the Hammer

94928.description:
These hides are to be delivered to Powderfuse Port. It is a goblin-run port to the northeast.

When you get there, deliver the hides to Friz Frazzlespark. Tell her they're from Cornelius. The details of our trade have already been worked out, so she'll know what they are for.
94928.objectivesText: Deliver the Bundle of Lion Hides to Friz Frazzlespark at Powderfuse Port.
94928.title: A Few Furs for Friz

94931.description:
The boys up at Southern Watch do a good job keeping gnolls out for the most part. Every now and then a few sneak into the camp at night and cause a bit of trouble. They especially like to steal saw blades, which they likely use to make weapons out of the sharp metal.

If you could get some back for us, it'd be a big help. The gnolls have probably got 'em stashed away somewhere in their camps up in the hills to the west.
94931.objectivesText: Recover $1oa Saw Blades from the gnoll camps in Bristle Hills for Halligan Turner at the lumber mill.
94931.title: Stolen Saws

94947.description:
It's a big world down here, and we need our people to start branching out to explore it. That's where you come in.

The Kirin Tor is a member of an "Alliance" of like-minded nations. The de-facto heart of this alliance is the city of Stormwind to the south. Elaadrin has asked me to find someone to travel to Stormwind and meet with the regent lord there, a human named Bolvar Fordragon.

When you are ready, the Kirin Tor mages have set up a special portal for the High Order to use to access Stormwind.

objectives.text: Take the Skyborne Portal to Stormwind

94947.objectivesText: Take the Skyborne Portal to Stormwind and report to Bolvar Fordragon in Stormwind Keep.
94947.title: Welcome to Azeroth

94963.description:
Come, $r. It is time to leave this place. If any try to stop us, we will tear them to shreds!

Once we are safe, I will take you to your reward.
94963.title: Biting the Hand

94968.description:
Of the few that managed to infiltrate the cave, most have perished. It seems these Twilight have a foothold much larger than we thought. We will not stand by while these cultists continue to ravage these lands and make sacrifices of our allies. We end this now, $n.

Infiltrate this stronghold, slaughter their forces and bring me proof of their leader's demise.
94968.objectivesText: Infiltrate Krol'dok Stronghold and return to Krom'rosh with proof of their leader's demise.
94968.title: Eye of Mugg

94971.description:
One of the most important parts of a paladin's arsenal has always been their warhorse. These specially consecrated animals bear paladins and their arms into battle, and are as fearless and bold as the best of us.

While our situation has changed, our need for steeds to bear us into battle has not. It's time that you had such a mount for yourself.
94971.objectivesText: Speak with Danitha Morr to learn to summon your Warhorse.
94971.title: A Paladin's Steed

94972.description:
With their location revealed, it is likely that within this stronghold are secrets kept well hidden from those we have encountered thus far. It would be wise for us to locate and recover any information that may be of use to our fight against these cultists.

See what you can uncover, $n. I await your return.
94972.objectivesText: Recover the Tome of Twilight from Krol'dok Stronghold.
94972.title: Tome of Twilight

94973.description: <The moulding appears to be for a key.>
94973.objectivesText: Find someone in Rog'mar who may know about the mould.
94973.title: Krol'dok Moulding

94974.description:
The moulding is crude and worn, but we may be able to fashion a key.

It may take some time to gather the components necessary. I'll keep these embers running hot while you gather the materials.
94974.objectivesText: Bring $1oa Thick Leather and $2oa Iron Bar to Kreza Darkthorn.
94974.title: Key Ingredients

94975.description:
Our work here is not finished, $n. These cultists have inflicted unimaginable pain upon our allies and rendered these lands for their taking.

We will not tolerate these actions any longer.

To the north lies a hidden cave network, masked by the rugged terrain. Our scouts spoke of cultist movement under the veil of darkness.

Seek out this cave and find where these cultists are hiding. It's time we deliver a message they won't soon forget.
94975.objectivesText: Collect $1oa Cultist Ears from the Twilight's Hammer in Krol'dok Stronghold.
94975.title: A Token of Vengeance

94982.description:
Our scouts mentioned a network of caves to the northwest along the mountains, hidden by natural surroundings. Most who sought information from deep within have yet to return. I fear they may be lost.

Those watching from a distance mentioned a Twilight presence moving in and out of the caves, often in darkness.

Locate this stronghold. If it is what I think it is we must deliver a deathly blow to their leader. Only then may we continue our efforts to remove them from these lands.
94982.objectivesText: Infiltrate Krol'dok Stronghold and return to Commander Brant with proof of their leader's demise.
94982.title: Eye of Mugg

94984.description:
No matter our efforts, the Twilight forces persist. We've deduced they must be coming from somewhere else.

With the new pet you brought me, I was able to politely ask our dear Twilight Thrall if it knew anything about where its former masters were coming from. Of note was mention of shadow magics and an ogre by the name of Nar'gurk in a hidden stronghold north of Sunnyglade.

Seek him out. Kill him and recover what you can. There must be something we can learn from these efforts.
94984.objectivesText: Kill Nar'gurk within Krol'dok Stronghold and recover any valuable information.
94984.title: Tome of Twilight

94992.areaDescription: Escort the lost horse to Wheeler's Grange.
94992.description: <The horse bows its head in your direction then nudges its nose into your underarm. Wherever you go, it may follow.>
94992.objectivesText: Bring the lost horse back to Wheeler's Grange.
94992.title: Rescue Roundup

94998.description:
Quite simple to dispel, really. Remnants of something, that's for sure. What, exactly, I do not know.

Well, I'm afraid I've done all that I can. I'm sorry if you were expecting more from me, but... on second thought, the craftsmanship of these is quite unique. Perhaps they could be of some use.

Take these to Melanie Sable. Tell her I sent you. Let her know they're safe.

She may have some use for them just yet.
94998.objectivesText: Bring the Satchel of Mementos to Melanie Sable.
94998.title: Curios of Curiosity

94999.description:
Oh! Sorry, I didn't see you there.

I was just putting together a little something for a friend of mine. Well... more of an acquaintance, really. Have you met Watcher Fredericks yet? He's stationed at Southern Watch just west of here.

He comes by the ranch on patrol every now and then. I thought it would be nice to give him a little something to show my appreciation.

I'd deliver it myself, but I need to keep an eye on my little brother and tend to the ranch.

I'm sure you understand.
94999.objectivesText: Deliver Eleanor's care package to Watcher Fredericks at Southern Watch.
94999.title: Eyes for the Watchman

95026.description:
Escapin' war don't mean we be safe here. Dem creatures to da east been plaguin' da area all dis time.

Maybe you be ready for a challenge, eh?

Strike 'em down. Ain't nobody gonna be missin' dem after all.
95026.objectivesText: Eliminate $1oa Forgotten Soldiers and $2oa Fleshflay Raveners.
95026.title: Blight No More

95033.description:
If you be gettin' tired of dem wide open plains, my old friend Uzer'i always be lookin' for help. He always be twistin' dem magics, but little do most o' dem people know he be quite da hunter too.

If you's interested, you can find him all da way out at Camp Mojache in Feralas.

Tell him ol' Tan'jani sent ya.
95033.objectivesText: Tan'jani wants you to speak with Witch Doctor Uzer'i at Camp Mojache in Feralas.
95033.title: On the Other Side

95036.description:
Trevan tells me that the worgen are a major threat to the citizens of Silverpine Forest. Despite their strength and resilience they can be killed, but there is one in particular that just doesn't ever seem to stay dead due to unknown magic.

That's the one that attacked us. He is known as Old Fire-Eye and he is the biggest and meanest of their kind. To put him down, we'll need a special kind of weapon.

Speak with Trevan and he will supply you with a list of what is needed to forge such a weapon.
95036.objectivesText: Speak with Trevan Rol in the Sepulcher and bring him the materials he requires.
95036.title: A Moon-Kissed Blade

95059.description:
Time for a special delivery.

Knight Commander Demar Brant at Farholde is waiting for this. For some reason he always makes me say his full name. What an odd fella.

Anywho, you can find him holed up in the keep southwest of here. Massive stone fortress. Ya can't miss it.
95059.objectivesText: Deliver Frazzlespark's Crate to Knight Commander Demar Brant in Farholde Keep.
95059.title: Frazzlespark's Crate

95062.description:
Time for a special delivery.

Old Krom'rosh is waiting for this package over at Rog'mar just west of here.

I suggest you get it to him quickly, but carefully. Why, you might ask? It's better to not ask questions.
95062.objectivesText: Deliver Frazzlespark's Crate to Krom'rosh at Rog'mar.
95062.title: Frazzlespark's Crate

95064.description:
The orcs have become an encroaching threat ever since their arrival. First, claiming the lands by the river and now their presence grows within the plains...

I'll never understand their kind, nor do I care, truth be told, but I'll be damned if they think there's more ground to be taken.
95064.objectivesText: Kill $1oa Rog'mar Trainees for Watcher Cornelius at Terral's Watch.
95064.title: Preventative Measures

95066.description:
The message we've delivered is clear.

Return to Brant within the keep and show him the report. I'm certain he'll be pleased with our progress.
95066.objectivesText: Deliver the report to Demar Brant in Farholde Keep.
95066.title: The Rog'mar Situation

95107.description:
One chief of the Deadwood, Deeproar, barks in the depths of their den. He was once of no burrow, and in a night of bad blood, he fell sway to their spells.

Now, he feeds on their sour sap, with twice the cursed roar.

Go. End his foul ways. Take his staff and bring it here, so I know he holds it no more.
95107.objectivesText: Kill Chieftain Deeproar and return his staff to Elder Pinespeaker in Barkskin Burrow.
95107.title: Deeproar Down

95111.description:
In Tarren Mill there is a weaponsmith known as Ott. By all accounts he is an unremarkable smith, selling simple blades to travelers. I purchased a sword from him myself, and when I took it to the undercity for maintenance some time later, the smiths there were surprised at its quality. They assumed it came from a well-known master smith, but no, it was just Ott.

I'd like to give this orc a chance to do something truly special. Take the materials to Ott in Tarren Mill and offer him the commission.
95111.objectivesText: Speak with Ott and ask him to forge your blade.
95111.title: An Underrated Talent

95118.description:
Murlocs, murlocs, murlocs! That's all I ever hear about; from the sailors, the fishermen, even my own kids! Everyone's on my case about 'em! They're a nuisance, I admit, but I got a port to run here!

Help a guy out, would ya? Kill a couple 'a those things and I'll make it worth your time.
95118.objectivesText: Kill 8 Murloc Oracles and 8 Murloc Warriors along the Eastwind Shore.
95118.title: Saltwater Savages

95119.description:
You know the Eastsea crew? Real unsavory bunch, and that's coming from the guy running a place called "Powderfuse Port".

They're destructive, bloodthirsty, and, worst of all, cutting into my bottom line. They steal cargo, and sink ships, both of which end up costing me the big bucks!

We gotta take down their whole operation, starting with the ones closest to here. You can find 'em along the beaches to the north.
95119.objectivesText: Kill $1oa Eastsea Buccaneers and $2oa Eastsea Musketeers along the Eastwind Shore, north of Powderfuse Port.
95119.title: Unfriendly Competition

95120.description:
Sailors and swimmers beware! An especially aggressive murloc, nicknamed "Old Rot-Chum" by local fishermen, has been seen attacking rowboats and other small vessels in the waters to the south, near a collection of murloc-infested islands.

A reward is being offered by Wharfmaster Whizzbuzz in exchange for proof of the creature's demise.
95120.objectivesText: Bring proof of Old Rot-Chum's demise to Wharfmaster Whizzbuzz.
95120.title: WANTED: Old Rot-Chum

95121.description:
Welcome to Fimbo's cafe on the water! Today's menu is roasted boar, and roasted fish...same as every day...

This menu needs a shake up, badly. I've had my eye on a new seafood stew recipe, but I'm gonna need some fresh meat. A few murloc eyes and some crab meat oughta do.

You can find both along the beaches nearby. Can't beat some good ol' fashioned local ingredients!
95121.objectivesText: Gather 12 Murloc Eyes and 6 pieces of Sand Crawler Meat for Fimbo Greasemitz.
95121.title: A Taste of the Sea

95122.description:
Those Eastsea pirates you whacked, while dangerous, were just the small fries. They've got bigger, badder brothers in arms north of here. They ransacked Windstead--took all the plunder they could, then burned it to the ground.

They've gotta be stopped before their turf gets any farther inland. Thin out their ranks so that doesn't happen.
95122.objectivesText: Kill $1oa Eastsea Raiders and $2oa Eastsea Bombardiers for Wharfmaster Whizzbuzz.
95122.title: Unchecked Expansion

95123.description:
As much as I love seeing Eastsea heads roll, we also gotta take out their ships. Can't have 'em running off for reinforcements, now can we?

I've got a plan for that, but we're gonna need some gunpowder. A LOT of it.

The pirates are probably storing some near the freshly-demolished Winstead to the north. See if you can get your hands on it. I'll fill you in on the rest later.
95123.objectivesText: Steal $1oa Eastsea Powder Kegs for Wharfmaster Whizzbuzz.
95123.title: A Blast Ye Scurvy Dogs!

95124.description:
Now it's time to go after the big man himself: Admiral Lamora. Obviously, I want him dead, but I need a little something extra from him too.

Seeing how all his plundering has been costing me a fortune, I figure it's only right that I recoup some losses.

Lamora's on one of the Eastsea's boats northeast of here. Find out which and where on it he's keeping his loot. Bring me whatever he's got. If it's locked up, he's likely got the key on him.
95124.objectivesText: Slay Admiral Lamora, locate his stash of loot, and return it to Wharfmaster Whizzbuzz.
95124.title: Admiral Lamora

95125.description:
These are some truly fine materials, $c. You honor me by allowing me to forge this blade for you and I only hope that I can live up to your expectations.

Please, stand back so that I may begin the forging process.
95125.objectivesText: Watch as Ott forges your blade.
95125.title: Ott's Masterwork

95140.description:
I see that you have your weapon now, $c. I pray that it will not fail you.

The locals tell me that Old Fire-Eye hunts in a large area south of here and you can generally find him near the gates to Gilneas. Find him, and use your new blade to end him. When it is done, return and you will have the gratitude of the Windshapers.
95140.objectivesText: Use the Moonsilver Blade to destroy Old Fire-Eye in Silverpine Forest.
95140.title: Old Fire-Eye

95141.description:
Far to the northeast beyond Stonard lies an embattled land along the eastern coast known as the Riverglades.

Many have sought to lay claim to these lands, but few have succeeded. There is one, however, whose experience battling our enemies proved enough to settle a small outpost known as Rog'mar. Through countless attacks, it still remains.

As ruthless as Krom'rosh may be, his will has served our allies greatly. If it's battle you seek, head northeast to seek out this old friend of ours.
95141.objectivesText: Report to Krom'rosh at the Rog'mar outpost in the Riverglades.
95141.title: Report to Rog'mar

95144.description:
Hey, bub. Got a package that needs to go to an old friend of mine. Whatever you do--

DO NOT OPEN THE PACKAGE!

Take this--carefully--to Friz Frazzlespark across the seas over to our sister port in the Riverglades. And before you ask, no I would not suggest swimming. Didn't work out so well for the last guy. Oh, and don't tilt it, shake it, or make any sudden movements.

I recommend heading east to Steamwheedle Port. The ship from there usually provides safe passage.

Best of luck to ya!
95144.objectivesText: Deliver Fizzgrimble's Mysterious Crate to Friz Frazzlespark at Powderfuse Port in the Riverglades.
95144.title: Overseas Delivery

95156.description:
Our training dummies are starting to show significant wear and tear. If we don't fix them up soon I worry our recruits may be unprepared for battle.

If you hadn't seen it on your way in, there's a small farmstead just outside the keep run by a man by the name of Wheeler. He may have a few extra bushels of hay he'd be willing to part with.

I'll see to it he's compensated if he's able to spare supplies for our efforts.
95156.objectivesText: Collect $1oa Bundles of Hay for Ember at the training grounds.
95156.title: Stuff 'Em and Stick 'Em

95162.description:
With so little land not claimed by the humans or Twilight's Hammer, this ranch is one of our very few sources of food. Ogres aren't much in the way of farmers, but they love a good paletusk roast, and have agreed to let me stay so long as the meat keeps coming.

As our war advances, the demand for food is only ever increasing. Now I hardly have enough food to keep these ogres from looking at me like I'm their next meal.

If we want to have enough meat for Rog'mar, I'll need your help with the harvest.
95162.objectivesText: Gather $1oa Chunks of Boar Meat for Na'zok near Bolder'ok.
95162.title: Paletusk Harvesting

95163.description:
As you can see, there are more pigs strewn about the valley than there are in their pens. Gorgegut has been less than an ideal farmhand, but he keeps the humans away.

Some of the little ones have escaped across the river. They're still too small to be harvested out in the field so we need to return them here. Take this stick and give them a good swat! That should send them scampering back to their pens.
95163.objectivesText: Return $1oa Young Paletusks to Na'zok's farm near Bolder'ok.
95163.title: Drive Them Back

95165.description:
So, here's how we're gonna sink those ships. 

I can use that gunpowder you stole and make timed charges. All you've gotta do is hop on each of the Eastsea's boats, and plant one charge in the hull of each. Look for a spot near their cannons, that gunpowder'll make our explosives even more powerful. Once the charges are set, get outta there, and I'll hit the detonator!

The elegance of the plan is in its simplicity, don't ya think?
95165.objectivesText: Plant a remote explosive charge on each of the Eastsea's three boats.
95165.title: See Ya, Scallywags!

95181.description:
Quiet down!

<Azka snaps, adjusting her gaze in your direction.>

I'll have your head before you give away my position to the cultists.

Watch your step and keep a low tone when traveling through these hills. Otherwise I'll be sending a report to Krom'rosh that another of our own has been taken.

Now take this and get out of here quickly... and quietly! Krom'rosh is waiting on this report. You can find him and the others at the outpost inland to the east.
95181.objectivesText: Deliver Azka's message to Krom'rosh at Rog'mar.
95181.title: Twilight Scouting Report

95183.description:
You want ogre weapon? Me know no. You small. Can't hold good.

You bring Hamur more rocks, me make you tiny weapon. Good for tiny creature.

Find good rocks for good weapon. Hamur has discerning eye. Not just any rock will do. Find rocks near river outside Bolder'ok.
95183.objectivesText: Gather $1oa Good Rocks for Hamur in Bolder'ok.
95183.title: Step One: Rock

95184.description:
The rigors of training for battle are one thing, but these trainees don't yet understand the difference between a training sword and the well-kept blade of a seasoned veteran.

I think it's time we show our recruits how a sharpened blade can be the difference between victory and death.

If you can find us a few sharpening stones, we'll put them to good use. There are certain craftsmen known to study this trade. I'd suggest starting there.
95184.objectivesText: Bring $1oa Solid Sharpening Stones to Ember Bladewhisper at the Farholde training grounds.
95184.title: The Sharpest of Blades

95189.completionText: Return the Crest of Lordaeron to Lady Dena Kennedy in Stormwind City.
95189.description: <A weathered crest depicting the mark of Lordaeron. With so few relics left after the kingdom's fall, someone in Stormwind would be very keen to get their hands on this.>
95189.objectivesText: Return the Crest of Lordaeron to Lady Dena Kennedy in Stormwind City.
95189.title: Crest of Lordaeron

95198.description:
Take this. It's a handy bit o' glamour that the mages back home put together to make a quick disguise. It'll make you look like a Kul Tiras Marine which should do nicely for this mission.

Sneak in to the tower and do yer best to listen for any mention of the man that washed up on the beach. I warn you though, do not get too close to Jaina. She will see right through this disguise. 

Come back and see me if you lose your disguise, I'll set you up with a new one.
95198.objectivesText: Use the SI:7 Disguise Kit to eavesdrop on Jaina and her inner circle at the Theramore Mage Tower.
95198.title: The Return of the King?

95212.description:
We're getting ready to send a team of rams to reinforce the Alterac expedition, but we've run out of material to make their saddles.

Collect pelts from the largest, fiercest leopards to the east and bring them to me. It's biting cold up there and our forces deserve nothing but the finest pelts to keep them warm!
95212.objectivesText: Collect 6 Pristine Leopard Pelts and deliver them to Amberstill Ranch.
95212.title: Never Saddle on Quality

95213.description:
The keg is stamped:

BLASTING POWDER - DANGER - DO NOT HANDLE - DANGER - QUARRYMASTER AUTHORIZATION ONLY - DANGER

You get a sinking feeling that the troggs shouldn't have this. It would be best to report this to the quarry sooner rather than later.
95213.objectivesText: Bring the Empty Powder Keg to Quarrymaster Thesten at Gol'Bolar Quarry.
95213.title: Stolen Blasting Powder

95214.description: This keg held enough powder to turn King Magni's throne room into an open air courtyard. We've got to get it back from the troggs before they work out how to ignite it.
95214.objectivesText: Recover $1oa Stolen Blasting Powder from the troggs east of Gol'Bolar Quarry, then return to Quarrymaster Thesten.
95214.title: Stolen Blasting Powder

95218.description:
The Light has forsaken me. A purpose served, and now everything... gone...

It's just a matter of time until the light turns to darkness.

I fought against the demons and scourge forces with a ferocity I did not know the Light could produce... and yet, I sit here, talking to you, feeling... well, I can't quite put it into words. Some reclaim their purpose after loss, yet I struggle... After all, I am only who I am.

Now, unless the commander has one last call to action, I await what comes next.
95218.title: More of the Same

95254.description:
Calling all anglers!

I'm in the market for some crab meat. Not just the usual shreds either, I'm talking whole claw. I've seen a big one crawling around under the docks, stealing bait and cutting lines.

I'll pay a reward to anyone who brings me that thing's pincer. You'll also get a helping of the dish I whip up.

-- Fimbo Greasemitz
95254.objectivesText: Bring Trapclaw's Pincer to Fimbo Greasemitz.
95254.title: WANTED: Trapclaw

95260.description:
The hide is painted with broad strokes of fish guts and squid ink. It appears to depict some kind of sea monster, rising up from the waves, with a long neck. What could this beast be?

The nearest port is Powderfuse Port. If this monster is real, and lurks these waters, a sailor there has surely seen it.
95260.objectivesText: Find someone at Powderfuse Port who can identify the monster from the painted hide.
95260.title: Terrors From the Deep

95261.description:
That monster...with the long neck, just like you said. I've seen 'im around those islands -- out on my boat. I tried <hic> tellin' folks, but ohh nooo, you can't <hic> believe ol' Argo. He's just some...some...drunkard fisherman! Makin' up stories!

We'll show 'em...soon as I get some bait...

Hey! Quit standin' around! I'm gonna need entrails, a LOT of 'em. Any beast from around here. The smellier <hic> the better. I'm also gonna need some Rotflesh mushrooms. Those grow in that cave by Windstead.
95261.objectivesText: Collect $1oa Beast Entrails and $2oa Rotflesh Mushrooms for Argo Brinewhistle.
95261.title: It Takes Guts

95267.description:
The last part's <hic> easy...just take that big ball 'a guts, aaand chuck it in the water! Er...not here though...that'd be a disaster.

Go to those <hic> murloc islands, where ya found the drawing. Look for fresh wreckage in the water. That's where you gotta throw the bait.

Soon as that thing sticks its head up, chop it off! We'll make a decoration of it...for the boat!
95267.objectivesText: Use the Big Ball o' Bait to lure out the sea monster. Then, bring its head to Argo Brinewhistle.
95267.title: The Monster Surfaces

95284.description:
A small force of Kor'kron soldiers passed through here a few days ago. Never told me why they were here, and I didn't ask. They bought supplies, took a bit of rest, then moved on.

The Kor'kron are the elite of the elite and tougher than elekk hooves, but I can't help feeling that something went wrong.

I did overhear one of them mention "the island", and there's an island called Alcaz just off the coast. It's a really nasty place. Get some friends and look into what befell these Kor'kron.
95284.title: The Elite of the Elite

95285.description:
<Sergeant Ulka struggles to sit up to speak with you. You offer your hand in aid, but she merely swats it away.>

Alright recruit... let's get you caught up.
95285.objectivesText: Speak with Sergeant Ulka to learn more about the situation on Alcaz Isle.
95285.title: Right Place, Wrong Time

95288.description:
You look like you're in the habit of doing whatever other people tell ya. I like that in a lackey. With a little trainin' you could be a great asset. Let's put that to the test.

Recently some of those Eastsea pirates made off with a shipment of MY stolen goods. That's bad sportsmanship. I stole them first!

Lesson one, lackey. Never backstab a backstabber. Go show them that they messed with the wrong goblin and take back my stuff. With force, preferably.
95288.objectivesText: Collect $1oa Smuggled Goods for Friz Frazzlespark at Powderfuse Port.
95288.title: Smuggler's Paradise

95293.description:
Those goods you procured from the Eastsea pirates were supposed to be shipped directly to me. That means ol' Bentcoin thinks he can muscle in on my turf. Looks like he's fixin' to start a trade war. We, however, are civilized people.

Lesson two, lackey. We don't need to stoop to their level. Take this crate I made 'specially for the good captain. You'll find him on his ship along the Eastwind Shore. He deserves a reward for his shrewd negotiatin' tactics.
95293.objectivesText: Deliver The Friz Special to Captain Bentcoin in Eastwind Shore.
95293.title: Smuggler's Special

95294.description:
Friz sure knows how to get her point across. Well, you won't hear any objections from me. The Eastsea pirates won't interfere with her business. In exchange, maybe we can come to an arrangement. Pirating's a little difficult when you've got a scorned goblin sending marauding adventurers after you all day.

Run along back to your master, $c. Let Friz know there's a new captain in charge, and he foresees a profitable relationship in our future.
95294.objectivesText: Return to Friz Frazzlespark in Powderfuse Port.
95294.title: Smuggler's Bargain

95295.description:
Ya did good with those pirates, lackey. But here's a lesson for ya you may want to remember. What some may call a pirate, others call a freebooter. And you can't spell freebooter without free booty. And there's no better place for free booty than Booty Bay!

<Friz waits for your reply.>

Keep up with me here, kid. I'm sayin' I need you to go to Booty Bay to meet with my contact. He gets goods from the local pirates there-- err, freebooters. Look, just go find Ruzzgot. He'll explain the rest.
95295.objectivesText: Speak to Friz's contact in Booty Bay.
95295.title: I Know a Guy

95312.completionText: Speak with Fizbuz Mithril in Gadgetzan
95312.description:
I don't have Friz's money. Well, I had her money, but I bet it all on ol' Slugjaw here in Fizbuz's arena in Gadgetzan.

Don't gimme that look. It was a sound investment. I won big! I just haven't had a chance to collect my winnin's yet. If you're Friz's new errand $Gboy:girl;, why don't you go get it for me? I got a bad back, you know.

Hey, you don't want to go back to your boss empty handed, do ya? Gadgetzan is just west of here. You can't miss it.
95312.objectivesText: Speak with Fizbuz Mithril in Gadgetzan.
95312.title: Coming to Collect

95314.description:
Before the Scourge invasion, the reclusive village of Shadowvale was known for its Whispering Elixir. Distilled from herbs found only in Tyr's Fall, the elixir was sought by apothecaries, mystics, and poisoners alike even after being banned in the city.

I've had requests from a number of buyers eager to get their hands on some elixir. Travel to the ruins of Shadowvale deep in the Whispering Forest to the west. I'm prepared to offer significant compensation if you can recover some bottles for me.
95314.objectivesText: Collect $1oa Bottles of Whispering Elixir from Shadowvale, then return to Carolai Anise in Brill.
95314.title: That Shadowvale Green Elixir

95315.description:
Word from one of our scouts suggests a large force of enemies amassing to the far, far south, well beyond the Wetlands.

Even more curious is there appears to be an alliance settlement out there. Farholde? The name sounds familiar.

Let's not wait on this. Best to begin the conversation before it's too late. We're dealing with enough here as it is.

Take this correspondence and deliver it to whoever claims to be the leader of this detachment.
95315.objectivesText: Deliver Captain Nials' Correspondence to Demar Brant at Farholde Keep along the southeastern coast in the Riverglades.
95315.title: The Riverglades Report

95319.description:
Listen, I know you can smell the fel blood pools behind me and I'm sure you've seen the crystals that grow out of them. These crystals have special properties from the ashes of Archimonde that rain down on this side of the hill.

Something about how they are formed makes them especially good at draining fel energies, which is a big problem for someone like me, but they can still have their uses.

I want you to gather some for me. Try and get a few kinds. I'll know what I need when I see it.
95319.objectivesText: Gather $1oa Fel-Slime Crystals and $2oa Pristine Fel-Slime Crystal.
95319.title: Crystalline Collection

95320.description:
There is a caged demon just up the road near the entrance of the demon caster encampment that has been making a great deal of fuss.

All this ranting and raving about imprisonment and freedom. Something about scorching bones and revenge?

<The crow leans in and gives you a mischievous look. As if to emphasize, she then dangles an iron key in one of her talons.>

Let's see if we can't make a deal with our little 'friend' and see what he knows about these nasty demon casters.
95320.title: A Curious Question

95321.description:
Tazzik sent you to collect his winnings? That's a joke, right? His slackjaw champion didn't even last two minutes in the arena! That loser didn't earn a single copper.

It's none of my business, pal, but if I were you I'd skedaddle back to Steamwheedle Port. While you're standin' here talkin' to me, that little rat Tazzik is probably tryin' to hop the next ship outta here.
95321.objectivesText: Confront Tazzik in Steamwheedle Port in Tanaris.
95321.title: Tazzik's Dues

95322.description:
Your timin' couldn't be better, friend. I was just on my way to collect my shipment from the Bloodsail Buccaneers. They're good friends of mine. Always happy to supply anything Friz is willin' to pay for.

But, ahem, just in case, it couldn't hurt for you to be my liaison. A good caravaneer knows it doesn't hurt to show off a little muscle. Just as a deterrent, of course.

They said they left my stuff in a chest on the hill outside of town for safekeepin'. Why don't you take a look for me, eh?
95322.objectivesText: Find the Bloodsail Trunk outside of Booty Bay in Stranglethorn Vale.
95322.title: Get the Goods

95327.description:
Looks like a deal's a deal. The Venture Co. got their comeuppance, Friz gets her loot, and everybody's happy. Overall a pretty smooth transaction if I do say so myself.

Now scram, I got another shipment comin' in soon from some Southsea Pirates.
95327.objectivesText: Return to Friz Frazzlespark at Powderfuse Port in the Riverglades.
95327.title: All's Well That Ends Well

95328.description: Against your better judgement you scrape up and collect the squirming remains of the beast. Someone in Undercity might have a use for them.
95328.objectivesText: Deliver Whispering Horror Residue to Father Lankester in the War Quarter of Undercity.
95328.title: Whispering Horror Residue

95329.description:
There is a watch tower overlooking the plains to the north. It serves as an observation point to track any motion of the Horde's forces.

The watcher stationed there is named Cornelius. Speak to him and get a status report. He is all alone out there, so I like to check on him with some regularity. Fair warning, he can be a bit...taciturn. It's why he was assigned such a remote post in the first place.
95329.objectivesText: Go to Terral's Watch to get a status report from Watcher Cornelius.
95329.title: Out in the Field

95379.description:
Brashann Grimdark, Master of Vessels.

<Felflick's mouth curls into a snarl.>

He was the one to subjugate me at the summit. HE is the reason I am here in the first place.

His work with these fel-ash crystals are the backbone of this operation. He's been obsessively experimenting with anchoring souls in these crystals and his work has not gone unnoticed by those Blackthorne creeps.

Use this pristine crystal to drain his power, then put an end to him and bring me his soulstone.
95379.objectivesText: Slay Brashann Grimdark and search his body for his soulstone.
95379.title: A Revenge So Sweet

95380.description:
Listen here, $c. It seems we're in quite the sticky situation. I knew those blasted demon casters were up to no good, but this is far worse than I had expected.

Good thing I have an idea!

For this to work I will need fel-slime from the surrounding slime creatures that can be found in the fel blood pools behind me. Not the bones or bits, just the slime! Make sure you wipe your hands after handling it. It seems to be corrosive.

Not to fear, I'm sure you'll find a way to bring it back to me.
95380.title: A Prolific Source

95384.description: <The strange symbols on the magical scroll confound you. Though you do not speak the language recorded, you don't sense any particularly volatile forces within. Perhaps a collector of odd magics would find some use for the scroll.>
95384.objectivesText: Bring the partial scroll to Dudd Fizzlescroll in Booty Bay.
95384.title: Partial Mystical Notes

95385.description: <Faint magic emanates from the scrap of scroll. The language is unfamiliar, though you intuit that it is not dangerous. Most would find the parchment useless, but there may be a unique collector that may find some use out of it.>
95385.objectivesText: Bring the partial scroll to Dudd Fizzlescroll in Booty Bay.
95385.title: Torn Mystical Scroll

95417.description:
Clubtoe see friends go. Some no come back. Some come back purple. Dat weird. Purple ones no act like friends no more.

Where others go? Why they no come back? Make Clubtoe think.

You hit hard. Maybe you go find friends in cave? Maybe you turn purple. Dat weird too.
95417.objectivesText: Find missing ogres in the caves beneath Sunnyglade for Clubtoe.
95417.title: The Purple Ones

95420.description:
Clearly these wayward ogres are no friends to the Twilight's Hammer. We orcs have an honored history fighting alongside ogres, and it may be time to call upon those old alliances again. And this head may be the key.

There have been reports of ogre activity in the hills far to the north. If this Clubtoe is to be believed, that must be where this clan calls home. Go to their stronghold and offer this trophy as a token of our friendship. With luck, they will listen to your proposal before they step on you.
95420.objectivesText: Deliver Chogg's head to the ogre city to the north.
95420.title: Land of Giants

95426.description:
Supply delivery to this area is no easy feat. All sorts of unscrupulous characters surround us in all directions, each seeking their own piece of the pie.

Now, with that said, perhaps this is an opportunity to slow Rog'mar's growth. What do you say to throwing a little wrench in our orc friends' plans?

Head north of Rog'mar to their training grounds and steal their supply shipments. The recovery time alone ensures our forces remain battle ready while theirs... well, you see where this is going.
95426.objectivesText: Retrieve $1oa Horde Supply Shipment from the training camps north of Rog'mar.
95426.title: Rog'mar Supplies

95432.description:
When Crag'rog hear $r-ling free ogres, Crag'og want free ogres too.

With tiny $c here, we smash Twilight together. Break them bones. Make them scream. Free ogres! Then be home in time for stew.
95432.title: Rise Up!

95483.description:
Thrall needs to know what happened here. I will meet up with Ulka and see to it that he is fit to travel before returning to Orgrimmar, so I am trusting you to bring this information to the warchief in my stead.

Go now, soldier of the Horde. Tell our warchief what fate befell Varian Wrynn.
95483.objectivesText: Bring word of Varian Wrynn's fate to Thrall in Orgrimmar.
95483.title: Thrall Needs to Know

95495.description:
These hides are bound for a tanner who I often trade with. He is something of a hermit and he lives alone on the top of the ridge behind me. Climbing up a steep hillside isn't something I can manage easily right now so I'd be in your debt if you could make this delivery for me.

Oh, and about this tanner's... appearance. You need not be alarmed. In spite of his looks, he is no threat. I swear this is true.
95495.objectivesText: Bring the Bundle of Hides to the hermit on the ridge overlooking the Dry Hills in the Barrens.
95495.title: The Hermit Tanner

95534.description:
<The note is singed in places, but is still readable.>

Rumor has it those old bellows have a mind of their own, springing to life when no one is watching. I don't care if it's a ghost story, you'd better get to the bottom of it before I return.

There's great power in Strahnbrad, I know it.

< The rest of the note is singed and torn, as if burnt by fire magic. >

objectives.text: Discover the fiery mystery of Strahnbrad

95534.objectivesText: Solve the mystery of Strahnbrad and report your findings in town in Hillsbrad.
95534.title: Strahnbrad Mystery

95562.description:
I have a confession to make. Lady Amberhall did send me to collect those samples, but in truth I volunteered. Sunnyglade was my home before the war took it from me, and I could not rest knowing monsters still taint it. Be it horde or Twilight.

There is no victory here by learning from them. There's nothing to learn. They're beasts, plain and simple, and should be put down like beasts.

We must slay their master at the bottom of this cave and bring an end to this. Surely my mistress will understand.
95562.objectivesText: Kill Chogg'Zac in the caves beneath Sunnyglade and retrieve their heads for Apprentice Claire.
95562.title: Cut Off the Heads

95602.description:
Me hate smashing rock. All day me smash. Chogg'Zac say so. He big boss. Say we smash tinies, but now we work for tinies. That stupid.

Why smash rock? Me no know. Find shiny light in rocks. Chogg'Zac like shiny, me guess. Are you here for shiny light too? Others won't like that. They really like light. They draw pictures with it.

Clubtoe not get it. Light make Clubtoe feel sick. Me hate light. Me want SMASH shiny pictures! But Chogg'Zac be mad. Squish Clubtoe. That bad. But someone should.
95602.objectivesText: Destroy $1oa Twilight Ritual Circles found throughout the caves underneath Sunnyglade.
95602.title: Sickening Lights

95613.description:
While we no longer hold service at the church, I feel it important to keep the candles lit on the graves of our fallen in the church's crypt. To me, keeping the candle's flame alive is a symbol that they are not forgotten and their sacrifices were not in vain.

If you would, bring me candles so that I might continue this ritual. It would mean a great deal to me.

If you're not sure where to find them, speak with Marla in the house just outside of the church. She's a friend and may have some to spare.
95613.objectivesText: Bring $1oa Holy Candles to Sister Rowland in Farholde Keep.
95613.title: Keeping the Light On

95642.description:
You there! Thank the light you've come. Did Amberhall send you to find me?

No? Figures as much. Ashe Amberhall sent me down here to investigate the Twilight's Hammer. As you can see, they are digging for something within the Riverglades, but I need a sample of their witchcraft to figure out what.

It's imperative Farholde gets those samples. Please, $c. Take this catalyst. It's enchanted to absorb the powers of the cult. Runes, cultists, it doesn't matter. Just hold it aloft and it will do the rest.
95642.objectivesText: Absorb $1oa samples into the Crystal Catalyst from Twilight's Hammer cultists and Twilight Ritual Circles in the cave underneath Sunnyglade for Apprentice Claire.
95642.title: Abominable Magics

95643.description:
As Lady Amberhall's apprentice in the dark arts, I may not look it but I'm usually quite capable of handling things on my own. I did not, however, anticipate an entire cave of void-infused ogres.

If you managed to get all the way down here without being captured, you must be powerful yourself. I was not so lucky with those ogres and their masters roaming about. Do the world a favor and kill the hideous beasts. Nothing good comes from a fanatic with a purpose, empowered or otherwise.
95643.objectivesText: Kill $1oa Twilight Ritualists and $1oa Empowered Brutes within the caves underneath Sunnyglade.
95643.title: Indiscriminate Purge

95646.description:
These brackish wetlands hold a greater well of unsalted southern waters. It pains me, yet within my roots I sense a corruption seeping through that mountain gully.

The creatures, like those in our lowlands, react more bitterly to the taint. Lacking the sea's hardening salt since life's dawn, they have little strength against such evil.

Go to those highlands, and bring me the Highland Horror's root core.
95646.objectivesText: Kill a Highland Horror within Excavation Sites and bring its root core to Rethiel the Greenwarden in the Wetlands.
95646.title: Horrors in the Highland

95647.description:
My husband, Ardin, has a rare gift for sensing nature. He'll scale any peak to gather the herbs and flowers I need for my alchemy, keeping our shelves and pantry stocked.

But I fear he's wandered into trouble. An excavation crew passed through seeking supplies. They spoke, among other things, of towering grasses unlike anything they'd ever seen. Those were what he told me he had to go see for himself. He's been gone too long!

If you learn anything of him, I'd be grateful.

objectives.text: Learn what happened to Ardin Grassman

95647.objectivesText: Find Ardin Grassman in the Excavation Sites.
95647.title: Lost in the Thicket Things

95697.description:
Zamja tells me we need more homestyle cooking.
If we start selling raptor, she thinks it'll draw in customers who don't usually visit Borstan's Firepit.

Her idea is not so bad. But I want something that rises above the smells of our birth villages. We're in Orgrimmar! Borstan should serve a grand take on their familiar favorites.

A hunter recently came back from the Wetlands with a giant talon from the thicket raptors in the Excavation Sites.

Up for a job?
95697.objectivesText: Enter the Excavation Sites in the Wetlands and bring back Thicket Raptor Meat.
95697.title: Changing Tastes

95753.description:
<The totem pulses with wild magic. The image of a ghostly wolf appears in your mind, beckoning you. 

It appears to be offering you a challenge.

Another totem--a twin to the one that your hand now rests upon, appears in the distance just beyond the large sun-bleached skeleton nearby.>
95753.objectivesText: Reach the other Odd Totem at the end of the massive skeleton before time runs out.
95753.title: Challenge of the Desert Wolf

95766.description:
The cycle of renewal has finally begun. The ancients... shall rise again, and the power of the natural world take its course... to bloom.

You... have helped us tip the scales in nature's favor. Perhaps... we can yet make a larger impact... on a more dire situation.

Head west... where the land itself is ashen... and you may find an entity who can help. She may look like just a small bird... but her power is great.
95766.objectivesText: Find the strange bird in the corrupted lands on the southwest slope.
95766.title: Fine Feathered Friend

95769.description:
Every day be a challenge when you living rough like we do! Takes a toll on your tools, your clothes, your whole life. Good thing it can't take our spirit!

We be really hurting from our clothes and blankets wearing out. You do some tailoring, right? So maybe you can bring me some Bolts of Runecloth and I can fix a few holes?
95769.objectivesText: Bring $1oa Bolts of Runecloth to Mez'dan in Elderwild on Mount Hyjal.
95769.title: Threading a Solution

95774.description:
The healer who saved me could not save her, and she has died in battle. Her name is Olgra, and I will never forget her.

You did not find her adornments on her body? She wore many jewels of polished bone.

Slay the Razormane Raiders near where she fell, and find her precious works of art!

I will place them with the memorial that I build in her memory.
95774.objectivesText: Slay quilboars and collect $1oa of Olgra's Adornments for Mankrik's memorial.
95774.title: Her Name Is Olgra

95788.description:
The Skullsplitter fetishes Brother Nimetz sent with you are indeed powerful, though I do not think they contributed to Kurzen's condition, or at least not directly.

Still, if the rumors are true and the lost troll city of I'lalai has indeed risen from its watery grave, it is possible the dark magics used to raise the doomed city may be related.

If you dare to venture into the Drowned City of I'lalai, please gather any troll fetishes you find and bring them here to me for further study.
95788.objectivesText: Collect $1oa I'lalai Fetishes from trolls in the Drowned City.
95788.title: Magics of the Drowned City

95789.description:
Hey pal, you look like you can handle yourself in a fight.

Baron Revilgaz has me keep'n my ear to the ground for magical objects. Word on the street is that a sunken troll ruin has mysteriously become, eh, un-sunk, which means there are a lot of unclaimed goods, if you catch my meaning.

Problem is, it's also caught the eye of pirates! Not just any pirates, the Saltseers specifically collect magical artifacts. I need you to go into the Drowned City, clear them out and take their stolen artifacts.
95789.objectivesText: Collect $1oa Voodoo Infused Artifacts from Saltseer pirates in the Drowned City.
95789.title: Shady Saltseers

95791.description:
The Saltseer pirates have been a thorn in my side recently and knowing they're in the Drowned City makes it worse! I mean they're always bad news, but there is one captain in particular I want outta the picture. That damned Captain Dreadrise!

He and his crew are very accomplished at gathering all the magical artifacts I've been after, and I'm tired of the competition.

I want you to remove Captain Dreadrise and his Saltseer Coroners from the picture. Permanently.
95791.objectivesText: Slay 3 Saltseer Coroners and Captain Dreadrise in the Drowned City.
95791.title: The Saltseer Captain

95809.description:
I need a moment to rest before I find my own way out.

<He pulls some reeds from his pack and quickly braids and bends them into a heart.>

Take this, and bring it back to Caitlin. Let her know I'll be home soon! Now that we have a path cleared out thanks to you, I'll gather my bushels and follow your trail.

Thank you.
95809.objectivesText: Return to Caitlin Grassman in Menethil Harbor.
95809.title: Heartwoven

95816.description:
Greetings, accomplished craftsperson!

Completion of this form will grant you non-exclusive, revocable, and legally limited permission to display advertisement signs for your tradeskill(s) all across Azeroth!

Once completed, please bring this to your local Azeroth Commerce Authority branch's Contract Coordinator to begin processing.

Happy crafting!
95816.objectivesText: Bring the completed form to Elaine Compton in Redridge Mountains.
95816.title: Sign Me Up!

95817.description:
Have you ever met Rotgath Stonebeard? He is a dwarven blacksmith in Ironforge. Not the most chatty fellow around, but always reliable. We often come to him when we need bulk crafts of simpler designs--the kind that Stondry is too proud to take on himself.

His turnaround times are excellent, particularly when it comes to helping new craftspeople get their shops established. I would trust no other to get your sign made fast. Let him know I sent you if he gives you any trouble!
95817.objectivesText: Meet Rotgath Stonebeard near the Great Forge in Ironforge.
95817.title: Rotgath Stonebeard

95818.description:
We can get ye sorted out and out of here in no time, provided you have the materials on hand! We are going to need $1oa Mithril Bars and $2oa Heavy Leather. Normally we need some other metals and the like too, but I've got some scrap that's been taking up space we can use for those extra bits.

Oh, as a personal favor, I am gonnae ask for $3oa Goldthorn as well. My wife knows a great recipe for tea and I'd like to surprise her. Consider this your payment!
95818.objectivesText: Bring the requested materials to Rotgath Stonebeard near the Great Forge in Ironforge.
95818.title: A Quick Craft

95821.description:
The materials for the sign should be easy to come by as an accomplished crafter like yourself. All we will need is $1oa Heavy Leather and $2oa Mithril Bars.

Normally for a rush order I would charge a few gold, but I have had a craving for homemade Goldthorn Tea lately. Don't worry, I enjoy making it myself, but I do need $3oa Goldthorn to make it happen.

If you bring me all of these, you'll have your first sign ready to go in no time!
95821.objectivesText: Bring the requested materials to Karolek in the Kodohide Leatherworkers shop in Orgrimmar.
95821.title: A Quick Craft

95883.description:
<The preparations for a hastily-assembled ritual are gathered unceremoniously on the altar. According to the scrap of note, everything has been gathered. All that's missing are the offering of blood and the Tortured Soul.

The undead around you look tortured enough. They may have what you seek.>
95883.objectivesText: Collect a Tortured Soul from the nearby undead in Beren's Peril in Silverpine Forest.
95883.title: The Tortured Soul

95912.description:
With each orc we cut down, another takes its place--somehow even more capable than the last. A skilled warrior must be training this new generation. If we are to make a dent in their numbers, we need to ensure they don't have a chance to recoup their losses.

If any soldier is brave enough, it's imperative we find this blademaster and put an end to him. He is likely at the trainee camp north of the Horde outpost even now. Kill him, take his banner, and destroy the orcs' morale.

-- Ember Bladewhisper
95912.objectivesText: Bring the Blademaster's Banner to Ember Bladewhisper in Farholde Keep.
95912.title: WANTED: Blademaster Kaijo

95913.description:
<Tessa rocks her baby, trying to help her sleep.>

If she isn't hungry, maybe she's just tired. To be honest, Emma here was a delightful surprise, but that means we were a little unprepared. My husband built her this lovely bassinet, but I worry these blankets are too old. She deserves the best, after all.

If you're still willing to help, I would be forever grateful if you could find some pelts for me to line her bed with. If this stops her crying, I think everyone in Farholde would be grateful.
95913.objectivesText: Collect $1oa Coyote Pelts for Tessa Dawnbright in Farholde Keep.
95913.title: Fit for a Princess

95926.description:
You there! I have a job for someone of your... skills.

I have gotten word from my sources of a crystal found in Shaper's Terrace that can seemingly drain the elements around it. Or perhaps it can drain life essence itself. It is unclear from this report.

I must have a fragment of this crystal! Just think of the applications of such a powerful artifact.

Go to Shaper's Terrace and bring me back a sample of this colorless Achromatic Crystal, and I will reward you for your efforts.
95926.objectivesText: Gather a colorless Drained Crystal Fragment near the Achromatic Crystal in the Shaper's Terrace.
95926.title: The Dark Crystal

95928.description:
Ah, it is good you have come here, $c.

I have been studying crystals of late and word has reached me about a peculiar set of crystals said to be from Un'Goro Crater. I have samples of the most basic ones, but I have heard tell of larger more potent crystals seen in a place called Shaper's Terrace.

I do not know much of this place aside from it containing these crystals that supposedly have the very elements within them. If you find yourself there, please bring me a sample of each color.
95928.objectivesText: Bring Mayena Earthseeker a Moist Crystal, a Charged Crystal, a Noxious Crystal and a Fiery Crystal from Shaper's Terrace.
95928.title: Crystalline Elements

95934.description:
My surveying tools show signs of a never-before-seen mineral in these caves. Cubic draconia, I call it. Probably worth a fortune.

Exciting as this is, no one's gonna come help me dig it up if I can't show 'em proof that it exists. Sure, I have the readings from my tools, but people like to hold a big shiny crystal, not look at charts.

I'm sure there's a few crystals poking up from the dirt in there. If you're willing to dodge a few dragons and get one, you'd really be helpin' a gal out.
95934.objectivesText: Find a piece of Cubic Draconia for Gelinda Coppergleam.
95934.title: Proof of Profit

95943.description:
G'day, $Glad:lass;. Name's Bertrand, Bertrand Ironbrow! At yer service.

<Bertrand extends a filthy hand.>

These fine folk contracted me tae oversee construction of this here keep. What they lack in experience they make up for in spirit! Problem is, I misplaced me tools.

Had a bit of a run in with a few Twilight in a small grove northwest o' here. Had to choose between me life or me tools. On one hand, I'm alive. On the other... ye see where this is goin'.

Think ye could help find me tools?
95943.objectivesText: Locate the Foreman's Crate and return it to Bertrand Ironbrow in Farholde Keep.
95943.title: Foreman's Plight

95957.description:
Here ya go, champ. One drink for ol' grumpy guts over there. If this doesn't sober him up, nothin' will.

Oh and uh... wash your hands after touchin' this. And don't get it in your eyes.
95957.objectivesText: Deliver Zizplink's Frothing Mug to Gray Dawnbright in Powderfuse Port.
95957.title: Drink Up!

95961.description:
<Tessa's baby continues to wail loudly.>

I guess she isn't tired. Oh... everyone makes it look so easy. Her father always knows how to cheer her up. If only he'd come home already.

$n, I hate to ask this, but can you see what is taking him so long? He set out a while ago but he should have been back by now. Emma just lights up when she sees him.

You should find him at Powderfuse Port-- he seems to go there a lot lately. You'll know my Gray when you see him. He shines as brightly as the sun.
95961.objectivesText: Find Gray Dawnbright in Powderfuse Port.
95961.title: Stepped Out

95975.description:
Tess says little Emm can't sleep without me? And you did all that for them? A total stranger? Damn it. What was I thinking...

Even if I can't guarantee a perfect world for her, I still need to be a part of it. What am I even fighting for if I can't hope for a brighter future?

Thank you for helping my family in my absence, friend, but it's time for me to go home. If I could ask one more favor, can you pick some flowers and take them to Tess? Let her know I'll be home soon? I need to clean up first.
95975.objectivesText: Gather $1oa Wildflowers and deliver them to Tessa Dawnbright in Farholde Keep.
95975.title: Her World

95981.description:
Taking away their pendants is just the first step. If the Kirin Tor really are shipping a steady supply of relics from Dalaran, we must stop them at the source.

Search the roads around Ambermill for Dalaran's wizards and watchers. Their presence has allowed free access across our borders for too long. If we can cull their numbers, that should put a stop to these pendants making it into Silverpine Forest in the first place.
95981.objectivesText: Slay $1oa Dalaran Wizards and $2oa Dalaran Watchers for Shadow Priest Allister in the Sepulcher.
95981.title: Watching the Roads

95982.description:
Folks keep dumpin' their furry friends here like I know what I'm doin'. And then they blame me if they come back and their horse or wolf or... whatever they brought is dead or ran off. What do I look like, I'm runnin' a charity?

You look like you know your way around a trough. Mind whippin' me up some grub I can use to keep these beasties in check?

If you can't make it yourself, someone might be willin' to sell you some. And hurry! Last thing I need is a stampede of hungry animals.
95982.objectivesText: Bring $1oa Briny Seafood Stew to Jasper Geartoggle in Powderfuse Port.
95982.title: Not My Circus

95983.description:
The skeleton is badly mangled. Deep markings on its limbs vaguely match patterns of teeth and claws. Many days beneath the beating sun have made the bones pale and brittle as well. The brutality of both the attacker and the weather have rendered the victim's identity a mystery.

You can't take the whole skeleton with you, but you could bring its skull to the nearby watchman and see what he knows.
95983.objectivesText: Bring the Gnawed Skull to Watcher Cornelius at Terral's Watch.
95983.title: A Feast for Buzzards

95984.description:
These markings are from a lion. By the look of them, this one's especially large. The leader of the nearby pride, most likely.

If rumor spreads about a man-eating lion prowling around on my watch, Demar will be furious. Fortunately, I have a plan.

I can make a whistle that mimics the call of a wounded tallstrider. We can use that to lure the beast out. I'll just need one of their beaks to give it the right sound. There's tallstriders all over the plains. Get me a beak, and make it snappy!
95984.objectivesText: Bring an Intact Tallstrider Beak to Watcher Cornelius at Terral's Watch.
95984.title: Song of the Strider

95986.description:
The whistle's made, $n. 

Take it, and go to the top of the hill where the lions are. Should be just north of here.

Once you're there, blow the whistle, and our man-eater should appear. I'd tell you not to come back if you don't manage to kill him, but you'll probably be dead anyhow.

Now then, off with you. Let's see if you fare better than our skeletal friend.
95986.objectivesText: Use the Tallstrider Call to call forth the leader of the lion pride. Slay the beast and retrieve its hide for Watcher Cornelius at Terral's Watch.
95986.title: King of the Wild Plains

95988.description:
Talked to Gray, didja? Ball of laughs, that guy. Last thing he needs is you gettin' him another drink. This is an inn not a bar. He's lucky I haven't thrown him out.

You tryin' to take him with you, be my guest. Though I don't think he's in any condition to go anywhere like that. Not without a little goblin pick-me-up.

Why don't ya gather some ingredients for me from this list while I prepare your little friend his 'drink.' We'll see if he still wants booze after he's had my specialty cocktail.
95988.objectivesText: Gather $1oa Crawler Spittle, Fresh Chum, Goblin Degreaser, and Expired Poison for Innkeeper Zizplink in Powderfuse Port.
95988.title: Goes Down Smooth

95991.description:
It's dangerous enough transportin' horses 'round the glades without talk of some mysterious phantom crocolisk snappin' up my prized ponies! They say this one must be at least three times as big as a regular croc. And twice as mean!

I ain't a gamblin' man. I ain't takin' no chances with my horses till someone puts this good-fer-nothin' monster down. If anyone finds this varmint along the rivers, bring me its tooth so's I know it's safe to travel again. Till then, I'm stayin' put!

-- Wheatley
95991.objectivesText: Bring Ghostmaw's Fang to Wheatley in Farholde Keep.
95991.title: WANTED: Ghostmaw

95992.description:
Dese waters be treacherous. My headhunters keep the paths clear as dey can, but there be a beasty stalkin' de rivers even we cannot catch. Excitin', eh?

Boss say we gotta clear it out, so we got a little competition goin'. Find de white one patrollin' de rivers and bring me its fang. Whoever sticks this slippery crocolisk win de whole pot. Just don't get snapped yourself, heheh!

-- Tan'jani
95992.objectivesText: Bring Ghostmaw's Fang to Tan'jani in Rog'mar.
95992.title: WANTED: Ghostmaw

95999.description:
Wanted! Incinerator Gar'im, Leader of an orc incursion in Render's Valley. Purported to be working with the Blackrock of Stonewatch Keep.

Beware of Incinerator Gar'im. He and his Shadowcasters are extremely dangerous. A handsome reward will be given to any brave soul that can deliver proof of Incinerator Gar'im's demise to Magistrate Solomon.
95999.objectivesText: Deliver the Broken Staff of Incinerator Gar'im to Magistrate Solomon in Lakeshire.
95999.title: WANTED: Incinerator Gar'im

96009.description:
One thing that never ceases to amaze me is the drive of humans. They see a desolate warzone teemin' with orcs and cultists and figure that's the perfect spot tae set up shop! Amazin'.

But, it's not me job tae tell 'em where to build. Just gotta show 'em how. And if we want this keep tae be as big as they say, we're gonna need lots o' wood.

With how dangerous the roads have become our lumber shipments from the mill tae the northwest are slowin' to a crawl. Think ye can fetch a few bundles for us?
96009.objectivesText: Collect $1oa Wood Bundles from Turner's Logging Camp for Bertrand Ironbrow in Farholde Keep.
96009.title: High Stakes

96010.description:
Although I am sure we can attribute the damage to both pylons to the reckless centaur stomping about, I suspect the timing of their rampage resulted in the shards being separated. I know little about their quarrels, but I do know there are at least two main factions that have trespassed into Shen'dralas: the ferocious Magram and the cunning Gelkis.

Keeping these treasures in the midst of a battlefield would be unwise. By now, I am assuming they have taken their trophies back to their own villages.
96010.objectivesText: Recover shards and fragments of the pylons, found guarded at the Magram and Gelkis villages. Return them to Mordent Evenshade.
96010.title: Fragments of the Pylons

96015.description:
We should be thankful that our foe is stupid. An army of ogres at their disposal, and the Twilight's Hammer have them working in the mines nowhere near the fight. I don't know if I chalk it up to mismanagement or an internal struggle, but either way they're in no position to defend themselves.

That's where we come in. With the cult's focus divided, we have an opportunity to strike the enemy while they're vulnerable and split them further. Go to this mine and sow some chaos among their ranks.
96015.objectivesText: Defeat $1oa Ogre Miners and $2oa Twilight Subjugators in the cave near the Twilight's Shroud for Sergeant Riftan.
96015.title: A Miner Problem

96018.description:
You may have seen the floating sparks of mana scattered throughout Shen'dralas. This is a new phenomenon, likely the result of the damage the pylons have endured.

We need this mana back in a semicrystallized form. We can accomplish this by using the Mana Sieve found within the temple. Borrow the sieve and collect any floating mana orbs you find.

The temple's denizens will not appreciate their precious artifact being borrowed without their consent, but they will understand in time.
96018.objectivesText: Acquire the Mana Sieve from within the temple in Shen'dralas and use it to collect Ancient Mana Crystals. Once you have acquired enough mana, empower the pylons and return to Mordent Evenshade.
96018.title: Powering the Pylons

96025.description:
Thank you for your help, $n. A dear friend of mine awaits your arrival at the summit.

You can find her up the road to the east.
96025.objectivesText: Meet Elaena's friend at the summit in Hyjal.
96025.title: As the Crow Flies

96026.description:
Dese good rock. Now need finishing touch. More rock.

Only rock can make rock stronger. Dat the way of rocks.

Me see some tinies make extra heavy rock. Bring me heavy rocks and me make weapon.
96026.objectivesText: Deliver $1oa Heavy Weightstones to Hamur in Bolder'ok.
96026.title: Step Two: More Rock

96027.description:
Bal trapped to annoying head. Mog follow everywhere Bal go. Annoying!

He say magic strongest. Please. Without Bal, Mog cast magic on nothing!

Bal no need Mog! Bal show fist is enough! We kill many tinies. Show Mog fist best.
96027.objectivesText: Kill $1oa Plains Prowlers for Bal'mog in Bolder'ok.
96027.title: Might Over Magic

96028.description:
Bal stupid. He only want hit things.

Mog smart. Mog learn magic to make Bal'mog stronger.

We show Bal he stupid. We use magic. Use magic to show Mog better!
96028.objectivesText: Use $1oa magic for Bal'mog in Bolder'ok.
96028.title: Magic Over Might

96045.description: Now that you've taken up Alchemy, I can also teach you how to craft a Mana Well for your camp once you've learned a bit. Build one of these and all of the healers and spellcaster types will come running to get a refreshing taste.
96045.objectivesText: Speak with Vosur Brakthel in Ironforge to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.
96045.title: Camping 101: Alchemy

96047.description:
So you've taken up First Aid? That's an honorable... and pragmatic pursuit as a $c.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft a First Aid Kit for your camp. Injuries are a reality in the world of adventuring and offering some much-needed healing at your camp could even save lives.

objectives.text: Raise your first aid skill to 20

96047.objectivesText: Speak with Thamner Pol in Kharanos to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.
96047.title: Camping 101: First Aid

96050.description:
You might not think so, but your skill as a fisherman can actually come in handy at camp.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft a Fish Bowl for your camp. You can use this fixture to help provide a bit of joy to yourself and your fellow adventurers. A happy adventurer is a strong adventurer and I'm sure your combat capabilities will reflect that.
96050.objectivesText: Speak with Paxton Ganter near Iceflow Lake in Dun Morogh to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.
96050.title: Camping 101: Fishing

96056.description:
Being able to skillfully harvest the skins and hides of fallen beasts is one of the more valuable skills an adventurer can possess.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft a Camp Chair for your camp. Sometimes it's important to just take a load off, and you can use some of those hides you've gathered to make a comfy chair to sit in. A bit of relaxation can help ensure that you are at your peak condition and can strike where it counts the next time you find yourself in a dust-up.
96056.objectivesText: Speak with Balthus Stoneflayer in Ironforge to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.
96056.title: Camping 101: Skinning

96059.description:
Now that you've begun your journey into being an enchanter, I reckon I can teach you how to craft an Enchanted Lute for your camp once you've learned the ropes.

It's so important to find entertainment during your downtime, and this bit of magic can help ensure you are ready to weather all sorts of challenges when you hit the old dusty trail once again.
96059.objectivesText: Speak with Thonys Pillarstone in Ironforge to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.
96059.title: Camping 101: Enchanting

96063.description:
The fuel of the future's not coal, or oil, it's gas, baby! Those marshy ponds to the southwest spew it out by the ton, and I've got just the invention to put it to use--a new type of engine that runs on the stuff. The gas is a real pain to collect, though.

If you feel like making a humble contribution to the future of science and industry, why don't you help me get some of that gas? You can see it coming up from vents near the water.
96063.objectivesText: Gather $1oa Marsh Gas Vials for Sleebo Fizzlespout.
96063.title: Gaseous Gold

96067.areaDescription: Fight G45-B4G in a stress test of Sleebo's engine.
96067.description:
You may have noticed my mechanical companion here, G45-B4G. Whirlin' around in that burlap chest of his is the one, and only, working prototype of my gas-powered engine.

I figure it's in need of some stress testing. How'd you like to take him on in a fight? I can power him up with the gas you've collected.

Oh, and don't worry about hurting him. He can't feel a thing!
96067.title: Rock 'em and Sock 'em

96075.description:
My employers are looking to get their hands on legal documents surrounding the ownership of Blackrock Mountain. Some kind of property dispute. In any case, if you could acquire these key records, I can afford to reward you generously.

Retrieve Nefarian's Remit from General Drakkisath in the upper part of Blackrock Spire, an Overseer's License from Overlord Wyrmthalak in the lower part of Blackrock Spire, and a Bronzebeard Wedding Contract from Emperor Thaurissan in the Blackrock Depths.
96075.objectivesText: Acquire Nefarian's Remit from General Drakkisath in Blackrock Spire, Overseer's License from Overlord Wyrmthalak in Blackrock Spire, and Bronzebeard Wedding Contract from Emperor Thaurissan in Blackrock Depths, and bring them to Pix Xizzix in Booty Bay.
96075.title: In Demand - Blackrock Legal Records

conditionalDescriptions.text:
$n, you know our tribe keeps our traditions alive by oral storytelling and passing legends such as these to the next generation. No doubt you yourself have learned lessons and heard such cautionary tales in your youth.

These etchings must be taken to our spiritual leader, Master Gadrin in Sen'jin Village. I am sure he would be happy to see you again, and he will wish to hear the truth of this tale.

I have prepared an extra copy of this tale for you as well. If you ever lose your copy I would be happy to create another, for a small fee.

96078.description:
$n, we Darkspear keep much of our traditions alive by oral storytelling. We pass legends such as these to the next generation, teaching lessons and weaving cautionary tales to our younglings.

These etchings must be taken to our spiritual leader, Master Gadrin in Sen'jin Village. He is one of the wisest Darkspear and he will wish to hear the truth of this tale.

I have prepared an extra copy of this tale for you as well. If you ever lose your copy, I would be happy to create another, for a small fee.
96078.objectivesText: Take the tablet etchings to Master Gadrin in Sen'jin Village in Durotar.
96078.title: A Tale Spun Around the Fire

96081.description:
If there is one thing a fighting force always needs, it's bandages. Unfortunately, Farholde has no reliable way to manufacture cloth. Thus, we depend on imports from the goblins or, if we are lucky, what we can take back from the orcs.

Currently, our supply of quality cloth is running low. I will have to start making bandages of old shirts before long. If you have the means to aid us, you would be saving many lives.
