96081.objectivesText: Gather 20 Mageweave Cloth for Brother Lowley at Farholde Keep.
96081.title: Wound Dressings

96082.description:
I will fashion the cloth you've given me into bandages. In the meantime, please take these ones that I have already made, and dress the wounds of the soldiers who need it. It should be a matter of basic first aid.

Your assistance here is both necessary, and highly appreciated. I simply cannot be everywhere at once.
96082.objectivesText: Bandage up 3 Wounded Soldiers for Brother Lowley.
96082.title: Doctor's Orderly

96083.description:
You have done all you can here, for now.

If you wish to be of further aid, go up the hill to the chapel. It is the smaller building outside the main church.

Sister Rowland is looking after a few quarantined soldiers there who have contracted an unknown illness.
96083.objectivesText: Speak to Sister Rowland at the chapel in Farholde Keep.
96083.title: Clerical Quarantine

96085.description:
The impurities in this sample look organic in nature. Not quite waste, but certainly something toxic.

I am no expert on wildlife, but I would guess that there is something upstream causing the water contamination. Some kind of animal, or at least a creature.

Follow the rivers as far north as you can, and see if you can find what is responsible for this. If it is an animal, it must be put down. It is for the safety of all here in Farholde.
96085.objectivesText: Find whatever creature is causing the drinking water contamination and eliminate it. Then, return to Sister Rowland at the chapel in Farholde Keep.
96085.title: Upstream Contamination

96101.description:
Greetings, $c. I can see you've got the look of an adventurer about you. This is good. The world needs more of us restless souls, seeking fortune and glory.

You'll need to learn to thrive in the wilds to be successful in this line of work. Not sure how your outdoor skills are but I can probably teach you a thing or two, if you'd be apt to learn.

Have a seat near the fire and get comfortable. I'll walk you through it.
96101.objectivesText: Sit near Raan's Basic Campfire and wait until you receive the Boosted Rest buff.
96101.title: The Great Outdoors

96104.description:
These markings are from a lion. By the look of them, this one is especially large--the leader of the nearby pride.

I would gladly hunt the beast myself, but you have first claim. Instead, I will aid you.

I can make a whistle that mimics the call of a wounded tallstrider. You can use it to lure the lion out. I'll just need one of their beaks to give it the right sound.

There are tallstriders all over the plains. Find me a beak and the hunt can begin!
96104.objectivesText: Bring an Intact Tallstrider Beak to Neza Bloodsnout at Rog'mar.
96104.title: Song of the Strider

96105.description:
The whistle is made, $n.

Take it and go to the top of the hill south where the lions dwell.

Once you are ready to face your quarry, blow the whistle and the beast should appear.

I wish you luck in your hunt. May you return in glory.
96105.objectivesText: Use the Tallstrider Call to call forth the leader of the lion pride. Slay the beast and retrieve its hide for Neza Bloodsnout at Rog'mar.
96105.title: King of the Wild Plains

96107.description:
A hunter goes through more arrows in her lifetime than there are stars in the sky.

Personally, I make mine by hand. I only trust my own work.

The coarse feathers of the nearby buzzards make for excellent fletching. Would you aid me by collecting a few?
96107.objectivesText: Bring $1oa Plains Buzzard Feathers to Neza Bloodsnout at Rog'mar.
96107.title: Feathers for Fletching

96125.description:
Now that the lion hides have been collected, and the orcish poachers culled, I can finally get a break.

At least, that's what I would say, if the man who was supposed to relieve me of my watch wasn't missing.

Dunston Willis, explorer extraordinaire, went to investigate the ogre settlement to the north a few days ago. He said he'd take over my post upon his return.

Find him. If he's alive, bring him back here. If he's hanging up on meat hooks, bring me proof so Demar can send me someone else.
96125.objectivesText: Find Dunston Willis somewhere among the ogres in Bolder'ok.
96125.title: In Need of Relief

96126.description:
I'm not sure how you got in here, but please, listen to me.

As you know, I serve as a watchman for Farholde Keep.

While on patrol, I was ambushed by a band of these brutes and taken prisoner. Now, I am forced to fight in the ring for their amusement.

I haven't much strength left. If I'm to escape, it's now or never. 

My captor is an ogre they call "Gronok the Butcher". He has the key to my shackles. Will you bring me that key and help me out of here?
96126.objectivesText: Find Gronok the Butcher, kill him, and bring Dunston the key to his shackles.
96126.title: An Ogre's Captive

96130.description:
Among the prairie wolves that hunt the hills nearby is one that is especially aggressive. We have taken to calling her Chakuyak. She has become a threat to travelers coming from abroad.

She stalks the trees west of Stonebull Lake, moving from tree stand to tree stand.

End this threat and bring me her pelt, and I will speak your praises to the chief. Beware, for she is dangerous! You might see other hunters seeking her out there, and perhaps you could work as a team.
96130.objectivesText: Defeat Chakuyak and bring back her pelt.
96130.title: Chakuyak

96131.description:
I'm sure you've met that old stick-in-the-mud, that lives in the cave south of here? 

You must take this staff to him along with my feather. He will know what it means. Or he won't! Either way it will get his attention.

He may be an oldstone, but he is reliable. He's one of the few mortals I would trust with a matter as grave as this. 
 
Quickly, Dirtwalker! I fear a shadow is falling over Hyjal we cannot see.
96131.objectivesText: Take the Faintly Glowing Branch to Ketharas.
96131.title: An Oldstone But An Old Friend

96136.description:
As you have no doubt experienced yourself, the elements of Azeroth are unique to those in Zephras. It is one thing to channel the forces of nature within the elemental plains, and another thing entirely to do it down here in the muck.

I could grant you your totem of air, but I think it would do you more good to meet with the one who trains the other earth-bound initiates. What say you, $n?
96136.objectivesText: Find Prate Cloudseer in Thousand Needles.
96136.title: Call of Air

96138.description:
A bow left by the spirit of Merrick Valor, famed Watcher who prided himself on keeping the roads safe from encroaching enemies.

With Merrick's spirit still wandering the roads, perhaps his unfinished business was to clear out invaders near his home in Raven Hill. The ogres south of town may be what's troubling his spirit.
96138.objectivesText: Defeat $1oa Splinter Fist Warriors and $2oa Splinter Fist Taskmasters then return to Sirra Von'Indi in Darkshire for more information.
96138.title: Merrick's Bow

96139.description:
In dark times like these, it's important we remember our heroes as much as our foes. Darkshire would not still be standing if it weren't for the bravery of folk like the good Lady Althea or those who lost their lives at Raven Hill.

Have you read much on Raven Hill? No, of course not. Its history was wiped out along with its people. My library, impressive as it is, has little on the subject.

If you happen to find anything, I'd appreciate it if you brought it here. Those folk deserve to be remembered.
96139.objectivesText: Search Raven Hill for anything of interest and return to Sirra Von'Indi in Darkshire.
96139.title: The Valor Family

96145.description:
Traveler, be wary! Though the Shrine of Aviana lies ahead, the area is claimed now by the harpies of the Wormwing tribe.

Like my family, the Highfeathers, I am a follower of Aviana, but the Wormwings are not so loyal. They are a danger to anyone who passes through their territory.

If you can make your way past them, my cousin Phoebe Highfeather helps to protect the shrine.
96145.objectivesText: Seek Phoebe Highfeather at the Shrine of Aviana.
96145.title: Past Wing and Claw

96222.description:
While war rages throughout the region, the Maraudine centaur stand unchallenged in the Valley of Spears. I worry that they will grow callous in time and stir further unrest if the other clans continue to turn a blind eye to their presence.

Khan Hratha possesses a Maraudine Key Fragment, and I wish to have it as a negotiation tactic. Find a war horn mouthpiece from the centaur there and use it to challenge him atop the highest peak.

Bring the key to me, and I will have a proposition for you.
96222.objectivesText: Bring the Maraudine Key Fragment to Umarak in the Desolace.
96222.title: Khan Hratha

96241.description:
Something funny be happenin' over there at Gloomrise. Ol' Mazu'kon be hearin all about these nasty new beasties skitterin' all around there.

Some say those creepy crawlies got a venom that have some unique properties and this be gettin' me curious. Take my extractor. Use it on the dead bodies layin' around that place to harvest the venom. Do this and I be in ya debt, mon.
96241.objectivesText: Use the Toxin Extractor to gather $1oa Gloomrise Toxin Samples from the Gnawed Corpses at Gloomrise.
96241.title: Talkin' bout Toxins, Mon

96255.description: <Something wriggles ominously within the bone pile as green ooze seeps out from under the freshly added bones.>
96255.objectivesText: Slay the Awakened Fel Ash Slime.
96255.title: Amalgamated Marrow

96262.description:
I've known these hills since I was a hatchling. If there is one thing I know, it's that pinecones can solve a lot of problems.

Probably not what you expected, eh?

<The crow winks at you, conspiratorially.>

Go fetch me some; it's part of a little scheme I'm hatching. I promise you it will be worth the effort.

You should be able to find them under any healthy or living tree nearby. Stay away from those corrupted ones though, those pinecones aren't any good!
96262.objectivesText: Collect $1oa Prickly Pinecones under healthy trees.
96262.title: Prickly Pinecones

96264.completionText: Bring the Tattered Note to Veyric Thunderhame in Arathi Highlands.
96264.description:
So yer a big shot shaman now, eh? Ye've mastered the elements and want tae put 'em to good use? I think I got just the thing.

If ye want the elements' respect, ye gotta repay yer debts to 'em. They help you, you help them. And right now they need all the help they can get from those who would abuse their power.

Earth's rumblin', $n. It speaks of the quilboar amassin' for some ritual of terrible power. We need tae go investigate their kraul and see what they're up to. Bring me back whatever ye find.
96264.objectivesText: Defeat Charlga Razorflank in Razorfen Kraul and collect information on the quilboar's plans.
96264.title: Elemental Aid

96294.description:
<The Broodmother you just killed is no spider at all, but rather a night elf druid who assumed a twisted animal form. A variety of questions flood your mind about the nature--and purpose--of the spiders at Gloomrise.

You notice a note peeking out of the folds of the dead elf's robe. Perhaps this document may answer some of the questions filling your head.>
96294.objectivesText: Bring the letter you recovered from Broodmother Valraxx to Muln Earthfury at Skywatcher Plateau.
96294.title: A Darker Truth

96303.description:
$n, the ancestral spirits called to Hyjal during the great battle weren't all lost. Some linger still, drawn to Nordrassil after the great sacrifice. These wisps have stayed within the root canopy that hangs over the well, trapped in a state of purgatory between this world and the next.

Use this enchanted branch to bring peace to these wisps, joining their memories with eternity.

You need not release them all yourself. Recover the will of five and return the branch to us.
96303.objectivesText: Use the Enchanted Branch to release $1oa wisps around Nordrassil.
96303.title: Memory Mist

conditionalDescriptions.text:
You know, for a mortal I'm impressed with how easily you follow orders.

You just went in there and killed all of those people without batting an eye! It wouldn't be so bad to follow along in your bloody wake, even for a warlock. I imagine the demonic carnage would be beautiful.

Ahhhh... but now it's time for YOUR end of the deal, 'friend'. I've helped you dismantle those wannabe warlocks, take out their leaders and cripple their operations here.

I think I've earned my freedom.

<Felflick's eyes glimmer in anticipation.>

96322.description:
You know, for a mortal I'm impressed with how easily you follow orders.

You just went in there and killed all of those people without batting an eye!

Ahhhh... but now it's time for YOUR end of the deal, 'friend'. I've helped you dismantle the moronic Ashen Reign, take out their leaders and cripple their operations here.

I think I've earned my freedom.

<Felflick's eyes glimmer in anticipation.>

objectives.text: Decide What to do with Felflick

96322.title: A Revenge Now Bitter

96332.description:
A second wave of Naga was approaching the keep when we were falling back. I suspect that the battle is still raging inside. 

We Kor'kron play blood for blood. If you are going in there anyway, I want you to kill any Naga you see. I saw a sorceress among them as well, and you can bet that was their leader. Bring me her head.

We lost a lot of good orcs today and I won't rest easy knowing that we didn't give as good as we got.
96332.objectivesText: Enter the Alcaz Prison and slay $1oa Strashasz Soldiers, $2oa Strashaz Enchantresses, and bring the head of Tidemistress Ca'zass to Sergeant Ulka.
96332.title: A Little Payback

96334.description:
Most of the humans we fought wore blood red bandanas. I seem to recall hearing of a criminal organization operating in the Eastern Kingdoms known as 'The Defias Brotherhood' who are known for their red masks. Why they are active here in Kalimdor I don't know, but kill any that cross your path and bring their masks to Eitrigg in Orgrimmar. 

He'll be able to determine if these are in fact Defias masks.
96334.objectivesText: Enter Alcaz Prison and collect $1oa Blood Red Bandanas from the human guards there.
96334.title: Blood Red Bandanas

96335.description:
Wow! That was impressive. The way you took down that dragon was really something!

While you are here... do you think you might be able to help me get out of this ball and chain?

If he hasn't fled or been killed already, the torturer they call 'The Questioner' should have the keys to these shackles. Get the key from that sadist and bring it to me.

I promise that I'll make it well worth your while if you do.
96335.objectivesText: Recover the Alcaz Shackle Key from The Questioner in Alcaz Prison.
96335.title: The Man in the Iron Chains

96337.description:
I told you that I'd make it worth your while to free me. I don't have any gold for you, but I have something better.

Take this. It will help you find a treasure more valuable than gold. Do what you want with it, but if anyone asks you where you got it, tell them that the person who gave it to you died. 

Tell them he was vaporized by dragonfire... blown out to sea.
96337.objectivesText: Use the note provided by Mason Connery to find his hidden treasure.
96337.title: More Valuable Than Gold

96381.description:
Was spyin' on the shore of Alcaz with my trusty lookin' glass whilst you were off eavesdroppin' on Lady Proudmoore. I think the island may be under attack. I saw naga--lots of them, chargin' onto shore. 

The enemy of my enemy is certainly not my friend when it comes to naga, so let's do the world a favor and take some of them out. I also spied what looks to be the leader--a spellcaster type barkin' orders. Take her out as well, if you can.
96381.objectivesText: Enter the Alcaz Prison and slay $1oa  Strashasz Soldiers, $2oa Strashaz Enchantresses, and bring the head of Tidemistress Ca'zass to Sully McCleary.
96381.title: A Bit of Wet Work

96393.description:
Gather some allies and head down into the caverns beneath Old Ironforge. Enter the Hall of Thanes there and push to the lower vaults. 

My Dark Iron is a bit rusty, but I can make out a name--one Durgen Dirgehammer. It's likely that he's the commander. Take his head and deliver it to King Magni Bronzebeard. 

Oh, and when you do, tell him his old friend Farsen sends his regards!
96393.objectivesText: Enter the Hall of Thanes beneath Old Ironforge and claim the Head of Durgen Dirgehammer.
96393.title: Old Ironforge Incursion

96394.description:
Something has disturbed the tombs down in the Hall of Thanes, and strange noises have been heard coming from deep within the vaults. The spirits of the dead are light sleepers, and whatever is going on down there seems to have startled them.

Head down there and see what you can do about that for us. If any of the dead are awake--well, put them back down!
96394.objectivesText: Kill $1oa Enraged Apparitions, $2oa Tormented Souls and put the spirit of Anvilmar to rest.
96394.title: The Restless Dead

96403.description:
You there, adventurer... I could really use your aid.

I was sneaking--uh... 'patrolling' in the vaults when a force of Dark Iron dwarves emerged from the depths in mole machines! I don't know what they are here for, but there is priceless loot--uh or, rather... I mean, 'important cultural heirlooms' down there! Please, recover any such relics you see and return them here.

I assure you that anything you recover will be catalogued and returned to its proper place of honor.
96403.objectivesText: Collect $1oa Dwarven Heirlooms from the Hall of Thanes.
96403.title: Important Heirlooms

96529.description:
Your help has been key to our scouting efforts. Take this information to Master Mathias Shaw in Stormwind.

Remember, you're not to speak of our activities here, my presence, or SI:7 involvement to anyone else. I have a lot to continue setting up here, and plans to keep on track. 

We'll be in touch.
96529.objectivesText: Bring the Blackthorne Information to Master Mathias Shaw in Stormwind.
96529.title: A Shaw Deal

96558.description:
Beneath the shattered stones of that watchtower lies a cache we buried in haste, when the world was starting to burn. What little we carried from Hyjal rests there still. Take it--you have earned that much.

The pull is increasing... the mountain no longer holds me as it once did. I am unsure if we will ever speak again.

Because of you, I remember who I was, and who we were. Go with my thanks, and let this spirit finally be at peace.
96558.objectivesText: Recover the Battle Cache buried on Mount Hyjal.
96558.title: Soldier's Solace

96559.description:
Every Gnomish test pilot knows that one must be prepared for the worst-case scenario when taking to our great skies!

That's why we never leave the hangar without our pilot survival kits. They have a self-activating beacon attached that will radio our position home as soon as you open it. Not to mention being stuffed full of other useful supplies.

If you can find that pack wherever it fell, by all means open it immediately and help yourself to the contents. You'll still be doing me a favor!
96559.objectivesText: Locate Fenwick Togglespring's Pilot Survival Kit.
96559.title: Supply Drop

96608.description:
Greetings, $c. I can see you've got the look of an adventurer about you. This is good. The world needs more of us restless souls, seeking fortune and glory.

You'll need to learn to thrive in the wilds to be successful in this line of work. Not sure how your outdoor skills are but I can probably teach you a thing or two, if you'd be apt to learn.

Have a seat near the fire and get comfortable. I'll walk you through it.
96608.objectivesText: Sit near Eric's Basic Campfire and wait until you receive the Boosted Rest buff.
96608.title: The Great Outdoors

96655.description:
So you want to learn more about camping, huh? Good for you, $c. The first step any adventurer needs to take is to become a cook and learn how to make a campfire.

Cooking's not just about making tasty foods. It's also the foundation for your camp.

objectives.text: Learn cooking from Cook Torka in Razor Hill

96655.objectivesText: Speak with Cook Torka in Razor Hill to learn to become a cook.
96655.title: Camping 101: Cooking

96656.description:
$n, you have proven yourself trustworthy in your endeavors against the Scarlet Crusade so far. That is why I am now entrusting you with an unusual task.

I've heard of a new adventurer down the road by Brill. Go and see what she's doing.
96656.objectivesText: Speak to Eleanor Shackleton near Brill.
96656.title: The Adventurer

96661.description:
So you want to learn more about camping, huh? Good for you, $c. The first step any adventurer needs to take is to become a cook and learn how to make a campfire.

Cooking's not just about making tasty foods. It's also the foundation for your camp.

objectives.text: Learn cooking from Pyall Silentstride in Bloodhoof Village

96661.objectivesText: Speak with Pyall Silentstride in Bloodhoof Village to learn to become a cook.
96661.title: Camping 101: Cooking

96674.description:
<Mirt's eyes grow wide as you approach.>

Whoa, who are you? My mom said there was a new person here. She said you killed a lot of Scourge and are super strong! Have you ever fought a bear? *gasp* A DRAGON!? I--

<Mirt looks behind himself, then looks bashful.>

Maybe... you could help me? I was supposed to be watching the sheep but they got out when I was making mud dragons. They are over on THAT side. I'm not allowed to go over there. Mom says they might hurt me. Could you go find the sheep?
96674.title: Ewe Wandered Off

96676.description:
Well, informant, you're being promoted.

Take these updated orders to Johun at his base camp in Hyjal. There's some additional equipment in here that he'll be needing for our operations in the Summit.

Your assistance in these matters is pivotal to our overall strategy in Kalimdor, $n. Tarry not.

You are dismissed.
96676.objectivesText: Bring the Alliance Equipment to Johun "Punchy" Dillas in Hyjal.
96676.title: Unsealing Blackthorne Pact

96774.description:
The ancient Gurubashi of Stranglethorn Vale were da masters of dark blood magics. Rumors be they'd use pure truesilver idols to channel that bad bad voodoo.

Ol' Mazu'kon would love to get his hands on one of those idols... for academics ya see. How 'bout you gather some friends and do a bit of smash and grab on that drowned city stickin' out the ocean off the coast of Stranglethorn? Kill the most impressive lookin' priest ya can find in there, and they sure to have what I be lookin' for.
96774.objectivesText: Recover an Ancient Gurubashi Idol from the Drowned City.
96774.title: Ancient Gurubashi Idol

96775.description:
Ol' Mazu'kon got a bone to pick with a Witch Doctor that go by the name of Zum'rah and I be thinkin' you can help me out with that. 

Zum'rah practice all his bad voodoo in the Sandfury city of Zul'Farrak, far to the south in the deserts of Tanaris. Go there. Kill Zum'rah, and bring me his head.

Trust me mon, the world be a better place with his head stuck on pike outside my hut than it be sittin' on his shoulders.
96775.objectivesText: Slay Witch Doctor Zum'rah and bring Zum'rah's Head to Mazu'kon in Mulgore.
96775.title: Zum'rah's Head

96776.description:
I have had a vision.

Deep in the place known as Maraudon, past the earth song falls, there is a chamber filled with brilliant white crystals and guarded by mighty giants. At the highest part of this chamber is a crystal of exceptional brilliance. It is an aspect of the sun god, the right eye of the Earthmother herself--An'she.

I've dreamed of its radiance and it calls to me. $c, remove An'she's Radiance from that place and bring it here where it belongs, under the open skies of Mulgore.
96776.objectivesText: Recover the crystal known as An'she's Radiance from Maraudon.
96776.title: An'she's Radiance

96779.description:
Sometimes, $r, a single cut in the right place will drop a foe dead. The same is often true of organizations.

Our agents have identified a key target among the ranks of the Syndicate: a man by the name of Lord Tomas.

He plays an instrumental role in the functions of Durnholde Keep, in Hillsbrad Foothills. If you wish to be of service to Ravenholdt, go to Durnholde and eliminate him. The quicker, and quieter, the better.
96779.objectivesText: Find Lord Tomas inside Durnholde Keep, in Hillsbrad Foothills, and kill him. Then, return to Myrokos Silentform.
96779.title: Syndicate Sabotage

96783.description:
Stromgarde Keep is one of the Syndicate's largest strongholds. Many of the organization's most important dealings take place behind its walls.

I have received word of a certain trade taking place between members of the Syndicate somewhere in Arathi Highlands, and I'm certain the details of this trade can be found somewhere in Stromgarde.

To infiltrate the keep without arousing suspicion, you'll need a disguise. See if you can find one among the Syndicate outside the keep, at Northfold Manor.
96783.objectivesText: Steal a Syndicate uniform from Northfold Manor to infiltrate Stromgarde Keep.
96783.title: A Way In

96784.description: <You recall Myrokos' instructions to find out about an important deal going on with the Syndicate in Stromgarde Keep. With your disguise, you should be able to talk to members of the Syndicate somewhat freely. Surely, one of them knows something.>
96784.objectivesText: While disguised as a member of the Syndicate, find someone inside Stromgarde Keep who knows about the secret deal.
96784.title: Master of Disguise

96800.description:
You there, $c. I have a matter I could use assistance with.

I just so happen to be writing a thesis on the ancient Wildhammer runemasters of Grim Batol, and there's a particular tome I need to complete my research. According to our ledgers, a mage by the name of Doan checked the book out of the old Dalaran library before the Third War and never returned it!

Arcanist Doan is now holed up in the Scarlet Monastery in Tirisfal Glades. Retrieve this book for me and you'll be well rewarded.
96800.objectivesText: Retrieve the book The Lost Magic of the Runemasters from the Scarlet Monastery.
96800.title: Past Due

96821.description:
We see fewer and fewer travelers from Razor Hill these days. The scorpids were never much fun, but now I hear there are spiders making their nest along the road.

If your travels take you up north, kill some of the spiders on your way. Then, let Razor Hill know the path's a bit safer for them.
96821.objectivesText: Kill 6 Ridgeshade Creepers and 6 Ridgeshade Lurkers in southern Durotar, then report to Gar'thok in Razor Hill.
96821.title: Legging It

96822.description:
We lost many brave warriors of the Horde when we sacked Tiragarde Keep. Now that the humans have reinforced the ruins, we cannot collect their remains to properly honor their deaths.

Go to the ruins surrounding the keep, and search for the weapons left by our fallen kin. We will display them in a place of honor.
96822.objectivesText: Collect the Raider's Battleaxe, Raider's Bow, and Raider's Shield from the Tiragarde Keep outskirts, then return them to Turroc in Razor Hill.
96822.title: For Honor

96825.description:
Our hunters and fishers bring back plenty of savory food for our troops - but it's rare that they get a sweet treat.

I've seen a cactus that produces a prickly, tasty fruit. But it only grows in the hills to the west, where the wretched quilboars make their camps. Make your way past the quilboars and bring me some of those fruits. And be careful - the fruits are as spiny as the quilboars!
96825.objectivesText: Cook Torka in Razor Hill wants you to collect 8 Prickly Pear Fruit from the Razormane Grounds west of town.
96825.title: This Fruit Could Bite Back

96833.description:
Gh... Ghan. Sur... Okk... Ghansurok. That's the fel chimaera's name. I thought I could manage out here... ugh... alone. No chance. Picked me clean into the air.

Stuck my dagger through its closest eye I could find, and I fell farther than the tree tops.

I wasn't the only one who bit off more than I could chew this time. Haha--agh... I shouldn't make myself laugh, this hurts bad enough.

Broken bones we could mend, but... the venom... is too vile.

Pass on a warning. I beg you!
96833.objectivesText: Pass on the warning of the aggressive chimaera known as Ghansurok to others on the mountain.
96833.title: Venom Maws

96873.description:
The trolls east of here have lost their will to the witchdoctor, Zalazane. He uses many cruel magics to keep hold of his prisoners' minds, but one of his favorite tricks is to make them wear pendants wrapped in evil binding spells.

Practice your enchanting skills by stripping the magic from these pendants, and bring me the results. And don't accidentally put one around your neck, if you value your freedom!
96873.objectivesText: Pa'zula in Sen'jin Village wants you to collect 3 Luminous Residue. Luminous Residue can be obtained by disenchanting Hexed Pendants dropped by trolls in the Echo Isles.
96873.title: A Pain in the Neck

96875.description:
Orgrimmar is always expanding, $c. And when the peons need hides to line the walls and roofs of our new buildings, they come to me!

The hides of the lizards in Thunder Ridge are typically too thick for armor, but they make excellent building material. Bring me some of their hides, along with a few lighter cured hides. Let's see your skill with leather!
96875.objectivesText: Kamari in Orgrimmar wants you to collect 5 Rough Lizard Hide from beasts in Thunder Ridge, along with 2 Cured Light Hides.
96875.title: Beasts of Thunder Ridge

96895.description:
Not sure if you heard, but two emissaries of the Argent Dawn just passed through here. I don't mind the Argent Dawn, but I don't like them poking around Tirisfal unsupervised either. They were both Forsaken... but that doesn't make me any less nervous.

One of them just passed by here, headed southeast. There's a group of scourge cultists snooping around the outskirts of the city in that direction. If those two heard about them, there's no doubt that would have caught their attention.
96895.objectivesText: Find the Argent Dawn member near the entrance to the Undercity.
96895.title: The Argent Emissary

96896.description:
Danitha and I fought against the Scourge in the defense of the Undercity when Naxxramas attacked. We lost many good friends that day, including the hero after which this keep was named--Garek Bandarion.

He might just have been the first Forsaken to rediscover how to wield the Light as a paladin. I am encouraged to see his legacy and potential live on here with Danitha and her cohort.

If only the rest of the Forsaken felt the same way...
96896.objectivesText: Observe the conversation between Danitha Morr and Leonid Barthalomew the Revered.
96896.title: A Righteous Cause

96899.description:
You've done a great thing for the cause of the Argent Dawn here today, and I thank you. I don't know how familiar you are with the fortress of Bandarion Keep, but my commander and I were headed that way to meet with the paladins that reside there. That was before we learned of the presence of the Cult of the Damned.

If you'd like to learn more about the Argent Dawn and our mission, seek out my commander at Bandarion Keep, to the northwest of here. I'll remain here to mop up the rest of this mess.
96899.objectivesText: Meet Leonid Barthalomew at Bandarion Keep in Tirisfal Glades.
96899.title: Bandarion Keep

96930.description:
We need powerful magic indeed to counter the strength that Ve'han Talongrasp now commands. The staff Velician snatched might just be the key.

My powers as a druid are not what they once were. We will need aid from the divine denizens of the mountain in order to stop this evil.

Return to the crow you met up the mountain. She is wise but the spirits of the wilds are ever-capricious, even in the face of dire threats. She may be challenging, but we will need her help.
96930.title: The Capricious Corvid

96957.description:
Listen, mortal. Though it may not appear a glorious job, those that are under my wing help keep the natural balance. We return many essential nutrients to the soil, allowing for new life.

These undead have disrupted the cycle here and have driven off those that seek shelter under my wings. While you are out there being the little murderous creature you are, would you collect some bones for me?

I would like to rebuild the nests of my children and followers so we may feast when this blight has ended.
96957.title: Bone Sweet Bone

96959.description:
War.

By the time I heeded the call of our clans, the battle had passed, and only ashes answered my blade.

My purpose is forged anew.

This mountain remembers strength--ancient power riding its winds and holding its water. I would earn the right to walk its spine, to reach the fallen stronghold that lies upon the road to the summit.

Demons profane these graves. Before I fight at your side, I must know you stand capable. Light the two bonfires and return to me. Their flames draw our enemy out.
96959.objectivesText: Light the two bonfires in Dae'gun and return to Yashiro.
96959.title: Blademaster's Bonfires

96982.description:
Ah, I've been expecting you, $c. It would seem the winds have brought you to me this day. You have come seeking a kodo, correct?

The kodo is a noble beast that is slow to anger, and you would be hard pressed to find a more dependable companion.

Today you have an important choice to make. You and your kodo will travel the world together, so find which one speaks to you. Fear not, whatever choice you make will be the right one.

Go examine the kodos and return to me when you have made your choice.
96982.objectivesText: Inspect the riding kodos to choose your first mount.
96982.title: Your First Riding Kodo

96984.description:
You may not have our best interests at heart, but I won't deny an extra pair of hands. And if Dalaran falls, it takes everything with it--including your Undercity.

So, your benefactor wants in? Fine. I'll imbue your key to work past my wards so you can enter the city. Once you're in, meet me at the Violet Citadel where this all began. With everything going on the Kirin Tor will be too busy to stop you.

Scavenge what you will, but whatever happens, our first priority is to prevent a catastrophe.
96984.objectivesText: Collect the Arcane Mote in the City of Dalaran for Magus Wordeen Voidglare in Tarren Mill.
96984.title: Heart of Disruption

96986.description:
Within the underbelly of the mage city to the north is a traitor to our kind. A necromancer of disturbing talent. He raises an army of undeath right under the Kirin Tor's nose.

I care not for the fate of the mage city, $n, but this grave knight spits in the face of everything we Forsaken stand for. Put an end to him. Show him no one is beyond the reach of the Dark Lady.
96986.objectivesText: Defeat Atrexis the Grave Knight in the City of Dalaran for Melisara in Tarren Mill.
96986.title: The Grave Knight

96991.description:
The climb grows steeper from here, as you say. Even an empty pack weighs on tired legs. I would ask another kindness of you, traveler. Take my excess gear and carry it ahead to the Summit, where Marn Euhron aids in restoring a foothold near Nordrassil.

I will follow at my own pace when my ceremonies here are complete. When I arrive, I will reclaim them from him and assist him in their work. This way, we both honor the journey and gifts of the mountain.
96991.objectivesText: Deliver Galvinquam's Belongings to Marn Euhron in the Summit.
96991.title: Trail Assist

conditionalDescriptions.text:
<Ogunaro narrows his eyes as you approach.>

Lok'tar, warlock. I must admit I am surprised to see one of your... talents here.

If you are looking for a riding wolf, you have come to the right place, however know that riding and befriending a wolf is very different from the felsteeds you are accustomed to summoning.

The bond between orc and wolf is not one chosen by vanity. No, each orc and wolf forms a special bond that goes beyond a mere purchase.

If you are here to bond with a wolf, I would suggest going to each and examining them. Return to me if you sense a kinship with one.

96994.description:
Lok'tar, $c. Come to bond with your first wolf? Good.

There is no stronger bond than that of an orc and their wolf. They are no mere mount, but are a lifelong companion and friend.

Ours is not a bond chosen by vanity. No, each orc and wolf forms a special bond that goes beyond a mere purchase.

They will choose you as much as you will choose them. You will understand when you meet them.

Go and find which wolf speaks to you. Return to me when you have your answer.
96994.objectivesText: Inspect the riding wolves to choose your first mount.
96994.title: Your First Riding Wolf

96996.description:
Now that you have completed your training, it would seem the winds wish you to bond with your first strider.

These galestriders have been ridden by our ancestors for generations. Despite their wispy and slender appearance, they are steadfast and fierce mounts.

You and your strider will traverse the world together, so you have an important choice to make. Fear not, whatever choice you make will be the right one.

Go examine the striders and return to me when you have made your choice.
96996.objectivesText: Inspect the riding striders to choose your first mount.
96996.title: Your First Riding Galestrider

97006.description:
I've added a note and my signature beside my name on the original page.

Take it to Royal Overseer Bauhaus at the Undercity Census and explain where it was found. He must know how it came to me while I remained at my shop.

You can be honest and say to him that Abigail Sawyer told another stranger her sob story and you happened to actually have the means to follow up on it.

Again, thank you for doing this for my family.
97006.objectivesText: Take the Sawyer Family Ledger to Royal Overseer Bauhaus in Undercity's Trade Quarter.
97006.title: Notarized Claim

97007.description:
I've stamped the pertinent pages for Abigail's records and updated our own documents.

Abigail will have to send a follow-up to the Royal Census when she intends to transport any of the property into Forsaken territories.

You may return her ledger and bring with it a reminder: Her contractual obligations to the War Quarter's commissary are not yet fulfilled, so she would be prudent to wait before attempting to act on any of these pre-war ownership claims.
97007.objectivesText: Return the notarized Sawyer Family Ledger to Abigail Sawyer in the War Quarter.
97007.title: Wood Remains

97009.description:
Left bleeding and abandoned--thrown aside so an army could flee. I was meant to die buying them moments. 

Instead, I was cursed to endure, forced to watch ever-burning demons finish what steel could not. This is my fate.

But something is changing. Horde and Alliance return to this desecrated mountain, and war stirs again.

My fury answers it. 

If yours does as well, prove it. Bring me two handfuls of felhound spikes from these Defiling Hounds.

The pain will align our wills.
97009.objectivesText: Bring $1oa Felhound Spikes to Maerion Thaelemaches in Dae'gun.
97009.title: Maerion's Misery

97022.description: Danitha Morr has ordered you to report back to Bandarion Keep to receive additional training. Please make your way back to the keep as quickly as you are able.
97022.objectivesText: Speak with Danitha Morr at Bandarion Keep.
97022.title: Report to Danitha

conditionalDescriptions.text:
Greetings, paladin! I must admit I am surprised to see one of your order here at my stables.

If you are looking for a mount, you have come to the right place, though they may pale in comparison to the chargers you are accustomed to.

Regardless, I encourage you to peruse our steeds, should you want one. Ours are some of the finest steeds in the land. These steeds are descendants from both the historical Lordaeron stock and our own local horses. You won't find a more steadfast companion for your journeys.

Go examine the horses to see if any are to your liking and return to me when you have made your choice.

Greetings, warlock. I must admit I am surprised to see one of your talents here at my stables.

If you are looking for a mount, you have come to the right place, though they may pale in comparison to the felsteeds you are accustomed to summoning.

Regardless, I encourage you to peruse our steeds, should you want one. Ours are some of the finest steeds in the land, and they should still bear you as faithfully as your summoned infernal felsteed.

Go examine the horses to see if any are to your liking and return to me when you have made your choice.

97045.description:
Greetings! Are you here to examine our horses?

These steeds are descendants from both the historical Lordaeron stock and our own local horses. You won't find a more steadfast companion for your journeys.

Choosing one may be difficult as they are all excellent and trained to be steady even when in danger. Don't forget, you and your horse will traverse the world together. I'm sure whatever choice you make will suit you best.

Go examine the horses and return to me when you have made your choice.
97045.objectivesText: Inspect the riding horses to choose your first mount.
97045.title: Your First Horse

conditionalDescriptions.text:
Salutations, warlock! I must admit I am surprised to see one of your talents here, but your coin is certainly still welcome.

If you are looking for a mount, you have come to the right place, though they will certainly feel different than the felsteeds you are accustomed to summoning.

Regardless, I encourage you to peruse our latest mechanostrider models, should you want one. If you see one you like, let me know so we can synchronize your biometrics to the rider detection protocol. This protocol will help the strider distinguish you from other possible riders.

Go examine the mechanostriders and let me know if you find any to your liking!

97046.description:
Salutations! I see today is a big day indeed; today you will synchronize your biometrics to the rider detection protocol of your first mechanostrider! This protocol will help the strider distinguish you from other possible riders.

As such, you have an important choice to make. You and your strider will traverse the world together so choose wisely! Fear not, whatever choice you make will be the correct one.

Go examine the mechanostriders and return to me when you have made your choice.
97046.objectivesText: Inspect the riding mechanostriders to choose your first mount.
97046.title: Your First Mechanostrider

97047.description:
Hey! You! You have to help me! I was just out exploring the jungle when, all of a sudden, I was ambushed by these maniacs! I don't know what they plan to do with me, but I've heard talk of tigers and headshrinkers, and I don't want part in either!

I don't know how, but you have to get me out of here! Please! A key to this cage, a disguise to sneak out, something! Anything!
97047.objectivesText: Find a key to Wendel's cage, and a disguise for him to sneak out, within the Kurzen compound.
97047.title: The Cook in the Cage

97049.description:
If you're headed into Shaper's Terrace, I would ask a favor of you.

There are reports of slimes that live in the pools by the colorless Achromatic Crystal. I believe their essence could be of use in my experiments, and would like you to bring me some samples for study.

I will make it worth your while.
97049.objectivesText: Gather $1oa Seeping Slime Essence in the Shaper's Terrace.
97049.title: Essence of Seeping Slimes

97176.description:
I have added some dirt from the tainted ground of Terrordale in the Eastern Plaguelands to the censer. Go there and use this censer to find areas with the greatest signs of corruption. You'll know these areas by the green necrotic auras that rise up from the ground at the location where tormented souls congregate.

Use the censer to reveal these spirits. Free them from their torment. When you have put these souls to rest, return and we will discuss the next steps.
97176.objectivesText: Use the Exorcism Censer to drive out the tormented spirits in Terrordale. When you have destroyed 25 Terrordale Spirits, return to Danitha Morr at Bandarion Keep in Tirisfal Glades.
97176.title: Exorcising Terrordale

97177.description:
With the blessings of the loa, take the censer. I be usin' it more than once to exorcise bad voodoo spirits, and it should serve ya well for the trials what be comin'.

You best be headin' back to Danitha now, $n. Ya quest continues with her.
97177.objectivesText: Return the Exorcism Censer to Danitha Morr at Bandarion Keep in Tirisfal Glades.
97177.title: Acts of Mercy

97182.description:
A paladin charger's barding requires the blessing of a powerful equine spirit. In the ruins of Dire Maul the corrupted treant known as Tendris Warpwood has such a spirit imprisoned. Seek retribution on behalf of this spirit, and free it from its bondage. With luck, it may be willing to provide its blessing. 

To help ensure success, I'd also advise you to bring a special type of spiritually-attuned feed. Travel to Eastern Plaguelands and speak with the ranger known as Nathanos Blightcaller about this.
97182.objectivesText:
Acquire special horse feed used for feeding a spirit horse. Nathanos Blightcaller in Eastern Plaguelands may be able to provide such a feed.

Travel to the Dire Maul in Feralas and slay Tendris Warpwood. Doing so will free the Ancient Equine Spirit. Feed it the special horse feed to soothe it. 

Lastly, give it the Arcanite Barding and hope that it is willing to provide the needed blessing.
97182.title: An Offering of Vengeance

97184.description:
We now must assemble a Divination Scryer that will be vital for your final trial. The exorcism censer you used in Terrordale is the catalyst for it, and I should be able to fashion a suitable housing for the scrying device.

The last components needed, though, are two diamonds--one white, one black. This represents the duality of our nature as paladins of The Forsaken. These two will be the beacon by which the scryer will pierce the veil between the living and the dead.
97184.objectivesText: Bring an Azerothian Diamond and a Pristine Black Diamond to Danitha Morr at Bandarion Keep in Tirisfal Glades.
97184.title: The Divination Scryer

97185.description:
In this satchel you will find the items you will need for your trial. Use the divination scryer in the heart of the Great Ossuary's basement to bring forth accursed spirits to face justice. The power of your judgements will be extremely valuable in this battle, so use them wisely.

Once you have dispersed these spirits, Darkreaver will appear. Defeat him and claim the lost soul of the charger. Show it the path of justice and retribution that you walk and with luck, it will take its place at your side.
97185.objectivesText:
Use the Divination Scryer in the heart of the Great Ossuary's basement in the Scholomance.  Doing so will bring forth the spirits you must judge. Defeating these spirits will summon forth Death Knight Darkreaver.  Defeat him and reclaim the lost soul of the fallen charger.

Give the Spirit of Retribution and the Blessed Enchanted Barding to Darkreaver's Fallen Charger.
97185.title: Justice and Retribution

97194.description:
Mok'ra, $c. You are now seasoned enough as an adventurer for me to teach you how to ride one of our wolves, for a fee of course.

Ogunaro will provide you with a free mount once you have trained with me, and after you will be able to purchase any additional mounts you would like. There are many creatures out in the world, and each requires their own riding skill, but you will have to find trainers for each.

Speak to me when you have enough gold, and I will teach you about wolf riding.
97194.objectivesText: Learn the Apprentice Riding skill from Kildar.
97194.title: Learning to Ride

97196.description:
There is a servant of the Lich King that makes his home deep in the Death's Head quilboar lair known as Razorfen Downs. It is known to us that he makes use of a scrying orb to observe and direct the movements of his minions elsewhere.

With this artifact, we'd be able to hunt down the covert agents of the Scourge and put an end to them and the threat they pose to Kalimdor forever.

Go into Razorfen Downs to the lair of Amnennar the Coldbringer and retrieve the orb known as the Coldbringer's Eye for me.
97196.objectivesText: Recover The Coldbringer's Eye from Razorfen Downs.
97196.title: The Coldbringer's Eye

97197.description:
Muln tells me that there is a location in the deepest depths of a place called Blackrock Mountain where the barrier between Azeroth and the elemental plane has been damaged, allowing a myriad of elemental creatures from the realm of the Firelands to escape into this reality, including giants as large as an Anchor Pylon!

I'd very much like to study any fragments of material that could be gathered from one of these creatures. Would you brave the Blackrock Depths and recover a sample for me?
97197.objectivesText: Recover a Fragment of the Firelands from Blackrock Depths for Alaana Stormwalker in Mulgore.
97197.title: Fragment of the Firelands

97198.description:
The Blackmaw furbolgs in the mountains overlooking Azshara have been corrupted by dark and sinister magic. We do not know the full extent of the corruption and what impact it may have upon the elements in the area, but we hope to understand it better.

Travel to the stronghold known as Blackmaw Hold and recover one of the Blackmaw Ritual Totems for us. Only the most powerful of the Blackmaw's shamans will be carrying one of these, so bring allies and prepare for a difficult battle.
97198.objectivesText: Recover a Blackmaw Ritual Totem from Blackmaw Hold.
97198.title: Blackmaw Magic

97225.description:
When we fled the isles that Zalazane and his ilk now inhabit, we left behind many precious idols that help us commune with spirits we worship: our loa. They are of grave importance to our tribe.

The followers of Zalazane show no reverence for our loa and have scattered these idols across the largest of the isles.

This is an action that will not go unnoticed if we are not able to collect these idols, and offending a loa is a grave matter.

Go, find as many loa idols as you can and return them to me.
97225.objectivesText: Collect $1oa Forgotten Loa Idols from the Echo Isles. Bring them to Master Gadrin in Sen'jin Village.
97225.title: Forgotten Loa Idols

97243.description:
Even though we are in the realm of Skywall, this is still the elemental plane. The spirits of all four elements speak to us, if we deign to listen. One among us Windshapers is in particular attunement with the element of fire. A shen'dorei by the name of Olariaan Swiftburn.

Bring this to him at the Shrine of Flames in the Gustberry Lowlands. You'll find it tucked away along the edge of the island, west of Valanaar.
97243.objectivesText: Bring the Torch of Dormant Flame to Olariaan Swiftburn at the Shrine of Flames in the Gustberry Lowlands.
97243.title: Call of Fire

97246.description:
My son, Migi, always takes off to play with his friends all day. I tell him to pick up a lunch at Borstan's, but I know he almost never does, because he comes home starving. These kids think their games are more important than their own bodies!

Please, stop at Borstan's Firepit and tell him you're there to deliver Migi's lunch. You can almost certainly find Migi behind Grommash Hold with the rest of his friends.

Duties keep me here during the day and I can't watch over his every meal.
97246.objectivesText: Visit Borstan's Firepit and tell him Thatog wants you to deliver Migi's lunch to him personally.
97246.title: Meal Appeal

97253.description:
Hey, got a sec?

So, apparently, nobody I've sent to deal with the recent pirate problem has come back alive. After five or six attempts I thought, "what if I sent a machine instead?" Turns out, scimitars double as screwdrivers in a pinch, and before I could redirect it home, it was already in pieces and scattered across their camp!

I need those parts back, and since this is a quick little retrieval mission, I'd wager your odds for survival are MUCH higher than the others. Whaddya say?
97253.objectivesText: Collect $1oa Handfuls of Complicated Parts from the upper pirate camp south of Ratchet, then return to Wrenix the Wretched in Ratchet.
97253.title: Parts and Pieces

97270.description: There must be more to the Maul than this!$B$BPerhaps the loud Spectator who oversees the event at Dire Maul will know!
97270.objectivesText: Speak with Griniblix the Spectator above the Maul in Dire Maul.
97270.title: Brawl at the Maul

97279.description:
With an influx of new recruits like yourself, it's been hard to keep our weapons supplied. Our weaponsmith, Kzan, is running low on training weapons and I'd like to see what kinds of skills you possess to get an idea of what I have to work with. Luckily for you, I have a solution to both.

While you're out there cutting your teeth on boars, salvage six abandoned training weapons. Our failed recruits left them laying on the ground. Once you do, return them to our weaponsmith Kzan behind me in the Den.
97279.objectivesText: Collect $1oa Abandoned Training Weapons, then return to Kzan Thornslash in the Den.
97279.title: Wayward Weapons

97284.description:
If Malem is still alive, then I suspect the Burning Blade orcs are expecting someone to come searching for her soon enough. They will certainly be ready for a fight.

I would prefer if you kept a low profile and stayed out of their way, but the far more likely reality is that they will be looking to meet you, blade to Burning Blade, at every opportunity.

So how about we plan to keep score from the start. Kill as many as you can, and I'll make it worth your time.
97284.objectivesText: Slay Burning Blade orcs at Thunder Axe Fortress in the Desolace, then return to Vahlarriel Demonslayer at Nijel's Point.
97284.title: Vahlarriel's Vengeance

97290.description:
You... abomination...

Why should... help you...

Be gone...
97290.objectivesText: Report your findings to Master Apothecary Faranell in Undercity.
97290.title: Unending Torment

97292.description:
I have concocted a lovely serum that our new guest is sure to find quite... stimulating.

Take this. Feed it into the workings dripping from above him. Let's see if we can't show him why it's in his best interest to serve loyally.

And try not to drop it. I can't afford a new assistant.
97292.objectivesText: Inject the Hissing Serum into the system above Othmar's body for Master Apothecary Faranell.
97292.title: Unending Torment

97319.description:
A cousin of mine on Kalimdor has been cutting his way through the most dangerous sites there and, last I heard, is on his way to Mount Hyjal.

This seems like a ridiculous waste of time.

If you ever find yourself out in that part of the world, it would be good to know that he hasn't gotten himself killed. Yet.
97319.objectivesText: Find the missing cousin somewhere on Mount Hyjal.
97319.title: A Cousin Abroad

97326.description:
Hey! You've got time to help us out! I know you do, I can tell by the way you smiled watching the game we're playing.

This spot behind Grommash Hold is nice because it's clear enough for us to set up our figures. But what stinks is we don't have enough rocks for chairs or tables.

You're big and strong... d'ya think you could carry back some medium-sized rocks, smooth enough to sit on if we need a rest?
97326.objectivesText: Return $1oa Smooth Boulders to Thra behind Grommash Hold.
97326.title: Rocks to Rests

97327.description:
It breaks my heart to admit, but my brothers and sisters inside Blackmaw Hold are irreparably corrupted.

If you bring me some of their personal belongings, I can at least give their families something to remember them by. Every bundle you recover will serve as a symbol of your service to my people.
97327.objectivesText: Enter Blackmaw Hold and recover $1oa Blackmaw Pouches for Ekkal at the Ruins of Eldarath in Azshara.
97327.title: Blackmaw Pouches

97329.description:
You! Yes, you! Come here, keep your voice down!

I screwed up big time. I managed to secure a sweet deal for Booty Bay to use their zeppelin tower for expedited deliveries and on our very first route I saw a huge bird--err, got SHOT DOWN just to the east of here!

I survived the crash, unfortunately, but before I woke up, I was already being dragged by my ears! Now I'm surrounded by bloodthirsty trolls and locked in a cage!

Look, I just need the key, okay? I can escape on my own.
97329.objectivesText: Bring the Primitive Key obtained from the trolls at the Ruins of Zul'kunda in Stranglethorn Vale to Zimmix Sputterspark.
97329.title: Where's the Key?

97332.description:
As much as I don't like the guy, I've heard what the Bloodscalp tribe do to their prisoners, and it ain't pretty. I'm glad Zimmix made it out alright.

However, I have another urgent delivery and I do NOT trust him to take it on. The problem? Nobody else will be available to take this before he does. You, however, have rescued lost cargo and a captured goblin, so you're looking pretty trustworthy from down here.

Any chance I can convince you to take this to Whizzbuzz at Powderfuse Port?
97332.objectivesText: Deliver the Twice Reordered Package to Wharfmaster Whizzbuzz at Powderfuse Port in the Riverglades.
97332.title: Twice Misplaced Trust

97378.description:
$n, you have proven you are a strong and dutiful hunter and I am impressed by your bravery. It is only because of this I offer you this hunt.

A wind serpent hunts along a road off the coast of Feralas and has been ambushing travelers, and leaving their corpses strewn about the road. It is clear she does not hunt out of necessity. This is a creature that no longer shares the Earthmother's blessing.

The windserpent Mirrorscale makes her lair at the bottom of the waterfall along the coast of Feralas.
97378.objectivesText: Bring Mirrorscale's Wing to Melor Stonehoof in Thunder Bluff.
97378.title: Mirrorscale

97386.description:
$n! Your arrival is timely, as always.

You have provided valuable assistance to the defense of Grom'gol, and we are grateful. After your recent push against the ogres nearby, we sent out a scout to see if there are more out there that may try to enact vengeance against us. As it turns out, there is a cave far to the east that they have claimed as their hovel.

Gather a friend or two and make it very clear that we will not tolerate another threat to our settlement, now or ever!
97386.objectivesText: Commander Aggro'gosh of the Grom'gol base camp wants you to kill ogres at the Mosh'Ogg Ogre Mount.
97386.title: The Offense of Grom'gol

97405.description:
Gnaz over there has been building that death trap for the competition all the way over in Kalimdor. I have been warning him that his constant late-night tinkering is making a ton of noise, and last night I saw an ogre peeking his ugly head out from behind that tree!

He's obsessed with this ambitious dream to win the Mirage Raceway Championships, but I'm obsessed with not getting mauled to death! Please head over the hill to the north and make sure they stop snooping around the place.
97405.objectivesText: Knaz Blunderflame wants you to kill $1oa Mosh'Ogg Spellcrafters, $2oa Mosh'Ogg Warmongers, $3oa Mosh'Ogg Maulers, and $4oa Mosh'Ogg Shaman at the Mosh'Ogg Ogre Mount.
97405.title: Noise Complaints

97412.description: You've proven to be a very reliable individual, $n.  As much as I trust that you'll help me through this predicament, it would be wise of me to reward you according to your performance.$B$BFor now I will exchange your belt and gloves. If we both see this through I shall make the rest of the pieces available to you.
97412.objectivesText: Bring a Lightforge Belt and a set of Lightforge Gauntlets to Mokvar in Orgrimmar.
97412.title: Just Compensation

97446.description:
Ah, I've been expecting you $c. It would seem the winds have brought you to me this day. You have come seeking a kodo, correct?

The kodo is a noble beast that is slow to anger, and you would be hard pressed to find a more dependable companion.

Today you have an important choice to make. You and your kodo will travel the world together, so find which one speaks to you. Fear not, whatever choice you make will be the right one.

Go examine the kodos and return to me when you have made your choice.
97446.objectivesText: Inspect the riding kodos to choose your first mount.
97446.title: Your First Riding Kodo

97450.description: That's an amazing story, $n! You have my thanks, and the heartfelt gratitude of all who were involved. Now maybe I'll be able to sleep at night with both eyes shut.$B$BAs to your reward, I believe I have a few things that you'll really enjoy.
97450.objectivesText: Give Deliana your Coif of Elements and Vest of Elements.
97450.title: Saving the Best for Last

conditionalDescriptions.text:
Blessings of An'she, child.

We have a tradition of scattering incense to the winds, and I was wondering if you'd be interested in honoring our tradition.

You will need to craft the incense by purchasing herbs from Nida, cedar from Nata, sinew thread from Mahu in the mid rise, and ceremonial flint and tinder from Naal on the upper rise. Once you have these items, combine them and spread them off the south facing cliff of Hunter's Rise.

You will find a mat and incense at the ceremonial site.

97485.description:
Blessings of An'she, friend.

We tauren have a tradition of scattering incense to the winds and I was hoping you'd be interested in honoring this tradition.

You will need to craft the incense by purchasing herbs from Nida, cedar from Nata, sinew thread from Mahu in the mid rise, and ceremonial flint and tinder from Naal on the upper rise. Once you have these items, combine them and spread them off the south facing cliff of Hunter's Rise.

You will find a mat and incense at the ceremonial site.
97485.objectivesText:
Purchase a Bundle of Herbs from Nida the herbalist, a Bundle of Cedar Twigs from Nata the enchanting supplier, and Sinew Thread from Mahu the leatherworking supplier and Ceremonial Flint and Tinder from Naal the cooking supplier.

Combine the items and sprinkle the incense off of Hunter's Rise.
97485.title: Traditions of the Bluff

97490.description:
Hey bub, I'm trying to break down some junk to get parts for my machine, but things are gettin' too hot.

I know what you're thinking, Winterspring? Getting hot? As you can see, my crusher and reployer are running, but sputtering hard! What they really need is something to cool 'em down that won't melt, slide, or burn off.

In the southern hills roams a nasty giant we call Hailspite. Put an end to Hailspite and bring me the frosty moss that grows on his crags. 

It might work for me!
97490.objectivesText: Search the southern hills of Winterspring for the giant known as Hailspite and recover the frost moss that grows upon him.
97490.title: Halt the Hail

97530.description:
A merchant caravan took a wrong turn through the desert and got jumped by the Dunemaul ogres. Only reason they made it out alive is 'cause they tossed some cargo overboard to distract the brutes.

Must be this merchant's got friends with the nobs runnin' ships and zeppelins, 'cause now they want ME pickin' up what got lost.

I'm stuck here working. But if YOU see a nice shiny bangle while you're beatin' on ogres, I'll make it worth ya while.
97530.objectivesText: Security Chief Bilgewhizzle of Steamwheedle Port in Tanaris wants you to recover a particularly shiny bangle bracelet lost near the Dunemaul ogre compound.
97530.title: Dunemaul Dues

97534.description:
Pssst, wanna know somethin'? It's easier to make profit in a place like this than you think... it's all about knowing how to market! I've seen what these tech-heads do when they get their hands on something they think they can turn into a fuel cell.

Even better if it's still glowin' or sputtering steam.

Why don't we strike a deal? Bring back some of the parts that fall off their machines in the desert, and I'll kick you back a share of the coin I get from selling the salvage back to the junkers!
97534.objectivesText: Quinn wants you to recover $1oa  pieces of Desert Debris and return to her in Gadgetzan.
97534.title: Gritty Business

97536.description:
The Matter Transporter required experimentation to get right. Many tests were conducted on all sorts of materials... with various outcomes! Some of the results are no longer with us. Others have become dangerously charged!

These subjected objects emit an energy that burns if you stay near for too long. Almost like they've been charged with a year's worth of the desert sun's power.

Take this Crate of Radioactive Refuse and empty the contents in the sand a safe distance from town and other trash.
97536.objectivesText: Jhordy Lapforge wants you to return to him after you have dumped the Crate of Radioactive Refuse in the desert of Tanaris a safe distance away from Gadgetzan and other trash.
97536.title: Gnomish Garbage

97540.description:
Oh, this fresh water smells so good... 

I'm going to stop for a moment and have a quick swim and a drink.
97540.objectivesText: Show the newly quenched Tooga the way back to his wife, Torta.
97540.title: Oasis

97617.description:
Hullo there, you look like the helpful sort.

The name's Dorgaron, and I'm with the Explorers' League. We've not had the best of luck with diggin' in the Badlands, but I know darn well there's artifacts to find and collect!

Before I can convince the boss to let us send another crew out here, I need to prove that the dig sites are safe AND haven't been picked clean.

If you find yourself down south, gather a few reasonably intact artifacts and some leftover equipment that hasn't been smashed yet.
97617.objectivesText: Recover $1oa Unstudied Artifacts, an Explorers' League Mining Helmet, and a Pristine Mattock and bring them to Dorgaron at the border of Loch Modan and the Badlands.
97617.title: Safety Checks

conditionalDescriptions.text:
You look like a well-preserved Forsaken, all things considered. I am looking for someone to travel to Sunnyglade, in the Riverglades just north of the Redridge Mountains.

My family owned an armory there, once. Now I imagine it is a burnt husk, but I would have you retrieve a tome containing my family's ancestral armor crafting techniques. It was originally in the basement, so hopefully it has not succumbed to the elements just yet.

97884.description:
You look like a healthy, able-bodied $r. I am looking for someone to travel to Sunnyglade, in the Riverglades just north of the Redridge Mountains.

My family owned an armory there, once. Now I imagine it is a burnt husk, but I would have you retrieve a tome containing my family's ancestral armor crafting techniques. It was originally in the basement, so hopefully it has not succumbed to the elements just yet.
97884.objectivesText: Travel to Sunnyglade in the Riverglades and recover the tome of Tremayne Family Blacksmithing Techniques.
97884.title: Armory of Sunnyglade

97901.description:
Enchanters make everything better and are always welcome at any camp out in the wilds.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft an Enchanted Lute for your camp. It's so important to find entertainment during your downtime, and this bit of magic can help ensure you are ready to weather all sorts of challenges when you hit the old dusty trail once again.
97901.objectivesText: Speak with Jhag in Orgrimmar to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.
97901.title: Camping 101: Enchanting

97905.description:
Looks to me like you've gained some skill in herbalism. Picking flowers isn't just for dilly-dallying, you know. It can be useful... and profitable.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft an Incense Candle for your camp. High spirits are a key component to keeping healers and spellcasters in the fight, and an Incense Candle can provide a boost that magic users will surely appreciate.
97905.objectivesText: Speak with Jandi in Orgrimmar to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.
97905.title: Camping 101: Herbalism

97914.description:
Auberdine is a humble place, $c. You won't hear its name spoken in the boughs of Darnassus. Most reference only what the Sundering took from us--the thriving cities of Ameth'Aran, Bashal'Aran, and... Lathar'Lazal.

Yet Auberdine remains in their shadow.

I would see our work here recognized. A new vessel connects us to the kingdom of Stormwind, bringing life and supplies to our shores. I beseech you to join its next voyage, and bring this letter to a human called Baros Alexston.

Make our home known.
97914.objectivesText:
Bring Thundris' Letter to Baros Alexston in Stormwind.

Thundris mentioned a boat in Auberdine that can take you there.
97914.title: Expanding Horizons

97925.description:
Tailoring is a surprisingly potent tradeskill to invest in, and I'm sure it'll serve you well.

I know someone that can teach you how to craft a Faction Banner for your camp, provided you have the skill for it. Inspiration and morale are a key part of success on any battlefield, and an inspirational banner can go a long way to keeping you energized.
97925.objectivesText: Speak with Eldrin in the Eastvale Logging Camp in Elwynn Forest to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.
97925.title: Camping 101: Tailoring

97926.description:
I wish it was that easy to help, $c. I really do.

Should you choose to spend more time in our lands, you will find that many are without. Stormwind's coffers are not what they once were, and what remains is spread thin.

Give this reply to the elder the next time you see him. It's not what he's hoping for, but it's all I have to offer right now.
97926.objectivesText: Bring Alexston's Reply to Thundris Windweaver in Auberdine in Darkshore.
97926.title: Making Do

97934.description:
You've become a leatherworker. Good for you, $c. I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to make yourself a tent that will keep you cool on hot days, and dry on rainy days.

With a good tent over your head, you'll ensure that you get all the rest you need to stay sharp on your travels.
97934.objectivesText: Speak with Chaw Stronghide in Bloodhoof Village to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.
97934.title: Camping 101: Leatherworking

97939.description:
So, you've become a Blacksmith. That's a great choice if you want to make sure your blades never dull.

I reckon I know someone that can help with that by teaching you how to craft a Sharpening Wheel. Bring one of these out at your camp and all the warriors and rogues in the area will be lining up to hone their weapons.
97939.objectivesText: Speak with Elisa Steelhand in Auberdine in Darkshore to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.
97939.title: Camping 101: Blacksmithing

97954.description:
Engineers like yourself can cook up all sorts of bits, bots, and bombs for fun and profit.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft a Reagent Bot for your camp. This helpful automaton can help keep you well-supplied so that you and your allies never run out of the materials needed to fuel your spells.
97954.objectivesText: Speak with Graham Van Talen in Undercity to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.
97954.title: Camping 101: Engineering

97955.description:
So you've taken up First Aid? That's an honorable... and pragmatic pursuit as a $c.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft a First Aid Kit for your camp. Injuries are a reality in the world of adventuring and offering some much-needed healing at your camp could even save lives.

objectives.text: Raise your first aid skill to 20

97955.objectivesText: Speak with Nurse Neela in Brill to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.
97955.title: Camping 101: First Aid

97968.description:
Looks to me like you've gained some skill in herbalism. Picking flowers isn't just for dilly-dallying, you know. It can be useful... and profitable.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft an Incense Candle for your camp. High spirits are a key component to keeping healers and spellcasters in the fight, and an Incense Candle can provide a boost that magic users will surely appreciate.
97968.objectivesText: Speak with Syriel Nightrain in Valanaar to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.
97968.title: Camping 101: Herbalism

97969.description:
You've become a leatherworker. Good for you, $c. I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to make yourself a tent that will keep you cool on hot days, and dry on rainy days.

With a good tent over your head, you'll ensure that you get all the rest you need to stay sharp on your travels.
97969.objectivesText: Speak with Indari Sunseam in Shen'dar Village to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.
97969.title: Camping 101: Leatherworking

97972.description:
Tailoring is a surprisingly potent tradeskill to invest in, and I'm sure it'll serve you well.

I know someone that can teach you how to craft a Faction Banner for your camp, provided you have the skill for it. Inspiration and morale are a key part of success on any battlefield, and an inspirational banner can go a long way to keeping you energized.
97972.objectivesText: Speak with Taleen Shimmerthread in Shen'dar Village to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.
97972.title: Camping 101: Tailoring

98046.description:
<Arch Druid Fandral Staghelm's gaze narrows.>

You're still here?

Take the phial and get out of my sight, $c. It is clear my answers do not lie in the waters, just as they did not before. 

Perhaps one of the priestesses in the Temple of the Moon to the south will dispose of it.

<Fandral looks away, no longer speaking to you.>

I must look elsewhere if this is to work...
98046.objectivesText: Bring the Drained Vessel to Lariia in the Temple of the Moon in Darnassus.
98046.title: Crown of the Earth

98059.description:
Hillsbrad's council hasn't answered our new magistrate's letters. The last word I pried out of a passing merchant from the town did little to justify their silence.

We're only asking for a small platoon--yet I'm told multiple siege ballista rest in pristine condition within a walled-off compound.

Walk into their town hall like a citizen returning a census request, and place this neatly upon the bookkeeping table.

Return to me when the deed is done.

objectives.text: Sealed Company Request delivered to Hillsbrad council

98059.objectivesText: Place the Sealed Company Request you were given on the bookkeeping table within Hillsbrad's town hall.
98059.title: Hillsbrad's Hoard

98094.description:
Now that we can trust you to deliver critical information to our forward spies, there's an extra task for you.

Bring this to Deathstalker Masoj almost directly south of us. He'll have more for you to do once you get there and hand this to him. He is posted on elevated terrain north of the rotten vineyard they call Nethander Stead.

Our plan to take control of these lands continues steadily.
98094.objectivesText: High Executor Darthalia wants you to deliver updated orders to Deathstalker Masoj, south of Tarren Mill, outside of Dun Garok.
98094.title: Scout Support

98155.description:
The Pesterhide hyenas of Thousand Needles have the most gorgeous coats. I haven't seen such a brilliant hue of fur like that in all of my travels!

I would like to send back some pelts to my sisters back in Stormwind, as I know they could make something incredible out of them.

I don't have any fighting experience, so I would be very grateful if you could gather some of the Pesterhide pelts in my stead.
98155.objectivesText: Bring $1oa Pristine Pesterhide Pelts to Kristy Grant.
98155.title: Pristine Pesterhide Pelts

98156.description:
$n, you have been so helpful to me I hate to ask for yet another favor. It will be some time until I am able to return home to Stormwind. I was wondering if you would mind delivering these pelts to my sisters in my stead?

I am sure you are more likely to return there before I am able to. Please deliver these pelts to my sisters Kelly and Kimberly in Stormwind. They can usually be found in the Park.
98156.objectivesText: Bring the Package of Pristine Pelts to Kimberly Grant.
98156.title: Packaged Pristine Pelts

98192.description:
You little! You help Krak smash the red bities and get scale hide!

Krak smash red bities to take scale hide, but Krak hands too big. Krak keep cutting hides, make them full of holes.

But you little! You go get hides from red bities in Dragonmurk in south. They mean and fast. You little, could get eaten.
98192.objectivesText: Bring $1oa Intact Raptor Hides to Krak in Brackenwall Village.
98192.title: Skin Careful, Skin Sharp

98203.description:
The Witherbark know we be huntin' them like the traitors they are. Makin' plans and hideouts to keep their tribe in the shadows even after we burn 'em for their deceit.

Our scouts be findin' a cave west of Hiri'watha. One witch doctor, Ti'ik, he bring his voodoo inside--rot, decay, an' wrigglin' larvae for some foul magic.

We not lettin' that filth crawl through our homes while we sleep. Go, take his head, and crush whatever they be growin'. 

He be tough, so don't go underestimatin' him, ya?
98203.objectivesText: Kill the Witherbark witch doctor known as Ti'ik in a cave west of Hiri'watha and return with his head.
98203.title: Witch Doctor Ti'ik

98205.description:
My associate Gizzix and I are looking to set up an outpost, and I can smell an opportunity here!

Or maybe that's just the swamp gas. Either way, I could use some help.

The little black dragons flyin' around here haven't exactly been "friendly". They even singed poor Miss Melly!

Look, I have some good coin for you if you're willing to get rid of some of these horrible dragon whelps.

So, you in or not?
98205.objectivesText: Slay $1oa Searing Hatchlings and $2oa Searing Whelps.
98205.title: Whelps are the Worst!

98208.description:
I came to Menethil Harbor from Auberdine, from the great tree Teldrassil, to recover a bloom of great import to my people.

My people's ship the Flying Osprey crashed here many moons ago, joined with the Kul Tiran Third Fleet. Among its cargo was the flower known as Nord'el--Bloom of the Heavens in your tongue--bloomed under a full moon at the peak of Mount Hyjal, our former home.
