Please help me retrieve it! The wreckage is just south of the city, but it is inhabited by fierce murloc raiders!
98208.objectivesText: Recover Nord'el for Sylessa Duskwhisper in Menethil Harbor.
98208.title: Bloom of the Heavens

98221.description:
In the Second War the Dragonmaw built a fleet where we now stand, intending to take Hillsbrad. They nearly succeeded!

They were routed by the red dragons, left to mere stragglers deep in the mountains. However, there has been a surge in activity in their encampment northeast of Menethil.

Dun Algaz is proof that they intend to march to war once again and retake this land. Find their attack plans, take note of any critical information, and destroy them. We need to know where they will strike next!
98221.objectivesText: Captain Stoutfist in Menethil Keep wants you to destroy the 4 sets of Attack Plans in the Angerfang Encampment.
98221.title: From the Ashes

98233.description:
I was having a drink with my buddies over at the tavern a few nights back and they dared me to try and take on one of those nasty oozes alone.

Seeing as I don't have a sword, you can probably guess how well that went.

When I went to attack it my sword got stuck and things didn't go as planned.

I need to get it back before my sergeant realizes I lost it! It should be stuck in an ooze out there somewhere, west of here across the bay.

Please, if you're headed out that way, can you look for it?
98233.objectivesText: Recover Jameson's Training Sword and bring it to Guard Jameson.
98233.title: Sword in the Slime

98246.description:
I'll need some eggs if my plan is going tae work. Bassbeak needs a nice an' full belly--I ain't in the business of hoppin' on the back of a surly gryphon.

They need to be perfect--no cracks or anything.

Take some from the Razormaw raptors--they're known for having yolks the size of a gnome's noggin. You can find 'em in Raptor Ridge to the northeast and Saltspray Glen to the northwest.

Let's make it a nice even dozen, just to be safe.
98246.objectivesText: Gather $1oa Perfect Razormaw Eggs for Howin Kindfeather.
98246.title: Trying Times

98247.description:
<A torn shipping label can be found on the side of the now fully stocked crate. Though the intended recipient is torn off, details of its origin still remain.

"Property of the Azeroth Commerce Authority. Please return empty crates or unfulfilled shipments to our local trade hub at the Three Corners crossroads in Redridge Mountains. Couriers will be compensated for their time and travel."

Beside the text is a crudely drawn map of the area near the aforementioned destination.>
98247.objectivesText: Deliver the Shipping Label to someone at the Azeroth Commerce Authority trade hub in Redridge Mountains.
98247.title: Shipping Label

98248.description:
<A torn shipping label can be found on the side of the now fully stocked crate. Though the intended recipient is torn off, details of its origin still remain.

"Return damaged shipments or empty crates to the Durotar Supply and Logistics trade outpost, now conveniently located due west of the Crossroads in the Barrens. Your time is valuable and we will compensate you for your efforts!"

Beside the text is a crudely drawn map of the area near the aforementioned destination.>
98248.objectivesText: Deliver the Shipping Label to someone at the Durotar Supply and Logistics trade hub near the Crossroads in the Barrens.
98248.title: Shipping Label

98282.description:
Certain alchemical recipes require ingredients sourced from, well, very dangerous places. And those are often just the base herbs! The other ingredients are even worse!

I need to make more antivenom before I can leave again. I swear everything in this marsh is venomous. It's like it runs through the land itself!

Can you help me? I'll need a venom gland from the spiders in Thelgen Rock to the far southeast. But it has to be unruptured, or too much venom will spill out before you can get here. Sorry!
98282.objectivesText: Collect an Unruptured Stalker Gland from Thelgen Rock for Caitlin Grassman in Menethil Harbor.
98282.title: Alchemical Hazards

98284.description:
Enchanters make everything better and are always welcome at any camp out in the wilds.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft an Enchanted Lute for your camp. It's so important to find entertainment during your downtime, and this bit of magic can help ensure you are ready to weather all sorts of challenges when you hit the old dusty trail once again.
98284.objectivesText: Speak with Nasalanna Windsinger in Shen'dar Village to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.
98284.title: Camping 101: Enchanting

98291.description:
I plan tae get back into Grim Batol and reclaim it for the Wildhammers, $n. Or at least learn a thing or two.

Don't look at me like that, now. I know the risks. I don't intend tae go in hammer swingin', ye know.

Regardless, I'll need your help first. The Dragonmaw orcs march as we speak. They're all up an' down the Dragonmaw Retreat, where the red dragons routed them before.

I need you tae thin their numbers before I have any chance of gettin' close. Ye can't miss 'em if you follow the road east.
98291.objectivesText: Kill $1oa Dragonmaw Reclaimers, $2oa Dragonmaw Soulbinders, and $3oa Dragonmaw Infiltrators in Dragonmaw Retreat for Howin Kindfeather.
98291.title: Death to the Dragonmaw

98293.description:
The Dragonmaw are stockpiling all manner of weaponry. It would be wise to relieve them of these before more soldiers can be armed.

Captain Stoutfist in Menethil Keep would surely be interested in these.
98293.objectivesText: Collect $1oa Dragonmaw Armaments in Dragonmaw Retreat, then bring them to Captain Stoutfist in Menethil Keep.
98293.title: Forced Disarmament

98322.description:
Spelunking dark caves is adventurer business. My job's just to make reports and send them over to Ironforge.

Trouble is, one of my reports hasn't... well, reported back. I asked a few mountaineers to learn more about the wendigo problem we have out here, but I haven't heard from them.

If you're already going to be out and about, what say you check in with Mountaineer Gretchen just west of town. I'm late enough as it is!
98322.objectivesText: Check in on Mountaineer Gretchen west of Kharanos.
98322.title: Secure the Mountain

98325.areaDescription: Speak to Warlord Goretooth to serve the Kargath Expeditionary Force
98325.description:
I seek the best the Horde has to offer, $c. And ONLY the best.

There are certain tasks that require a degree of valor that few possess. And fewer still are willing to lay it on the line when it really counts.

Are you $r enough to do what must be done? Let us speak if so.

If not, begone. I have no time to waste on cowardice.
98325.objectivesText: Speak to Warlord Goretooth to serve the Kargath Expeditionary Force.
98325.title: Blood and Thunder

conditionalDescriptions.text:
If you remember but one thing, know this: not even death can stop the Light.

This we have in common with all Forsaken--we have overcome what the living view as their end. However, some even among our own fear us; they suspect we will smite them as some monstrosity.

In truth, our relationship with undeath is complex, but we are not here to hurt our own. Help me show the others this. Venture to Night's Web Hollow to the northwest and free the freshly raised fools trapped by the spiders there.

Then they will see our nature.

98389.description:
Greetings, $c. Yes, I am a paladin. Not even death can stop the Light.

This is something my kind have in common with all Forsaken--we have overcome what the living view as their end. However, some even among our own fear us; they suspect we will smite them as some monstrosity.

In truth, our relationship with undeath is complex, but I am not here to hurt our own. Help me show the others this. Venture to Night's Web Hollow to the northwest and free the freshly raised fools trapped by the spiders there.
98389.objectivesText: Free $1oa Webbed Victims in Night's Web Hollow for Aramis Hammerhand in Deathknell.
98389.title: A Light in the Darkness

98396.description:
To draw upon my spirit, you will need more than a few words. To understand and respect my form you must prove that you can embody cunning, stealth, and if you should be cornered, ferocity.

In the Barrow Dens just east of here, are three relics of my favor you must acquire. They are guarded by powerful enraged spirits that will attack you on sight. A statue at the entrance will bless you with temporary stealth to get past them.

Return these relics to me. We will see if you are ready to take my shape.
98396.objectivesText: Recover the Relic of the Fang, Relic of the Claw, and Relic of the Silent Shadow from the Stormrage Barrow Den, and return them to the Great Cat Spirit.
98396.title: The Great Cat Spirit

98403.description:
Lord Melenas did not act alone; he was at the behest of another. The one you seek is Xethorr the Wicked. It seems he has twisted the spiders that call Teldrassil home, intending their venom for some foul plan.

He has taken residence deep in the forest, in the area to the northwest of here known as the Cleft. Take caution, and bring allies, for Xethorr is not an opponent to be trifled with.

Dispatch his brood, and bring me anything that may tell us more of the satyr's work here.
98403.objectivesText: Kill $1oa Befouled Webwoods and bring Xethorr the Wicked's Mature Fel Moss to Tallonkai Swiftroot in Dolanaar.
98403.title: Twisted Hatred

98405.description:
In the southern part of Moonglade, on a hill overlooking the bridge, resides a wise and cunning being we call the Great Cat Spirit.

Much like the Great Bear Spirit, this spirit has served as a tutor and mentor to druids that desire to take the feline shape. All druids eventually seek its wisdom, and if you desire to take the form of a cat, you will as well.

Go meet with the Great Cat Spirit and learn what it will teach you.
98405.objectivesText: Seek out the Great Cat Spirit in southern part Moonglade and learn what it has to share with you about the nature of the cat.
98405.title: The Great Cat Spirit

98435.description:
Our elders in Thunder Bluff must know of the progress we have made here, thanks to your aid.

Please, take this to Arch Druid Hamuul Runetotem in Thunder Bluff. You will find him in the Elder Rise, on the east side of the city. You must take the lifts up to the center of the city, then cross the bridges to reach it.
98435.objectivesText: Bring Thunderhorn's Report to Arch Druid Hamuul Runetotem in Thunder Bluff.
98435.title: Thunderhorn's Report

98459.description:
Bart Tidewater's a no-good cheapskate, I tell ya!

"Captain of the Maiden's Virtue" he calls himself. That ship's sailed as far as a rock in Tanaris! He's no captain, he's an actor who won enough hands of poker to buy the Virtue in the first place!

If you ever find yourself in Menethil Harbor over in the Wetlands, give this to him and let him know it's from ol' Half-fish.

There's a boat from here that can take you right to the harbor, by the way. It'll be the second stop!

And he cheats at poker!
98459.objectivesText: Deliver Tom's Gift to Bart Tidewater in Menethil Harbor in the Wetlands.
98459.title: A Lack of Virtue

98461.description:
If you're heading out of Auberdine, I could use your help!

My dear friend Tarrel and I were classmates in school. Oh, he was such a quickfire on all things excavation! We got split up after graduation--him to Wetlands, and me to here in Darkshore.

<Hollee sighs, then her brow furrows slightly.>

Sorry, and his wife... Merrin.

It doesn't matter. If you go to the Wetlands, could you make sure he's alright? And maybe give him this? He's probably near Menethil Harbor. There's a boat straight there.
98461.objectivesText: Deliver Hollee's Note to Tarrel Rockweaver near Menethil Harbor in the Wetlands.
98461.title: Unrequited Love

98477.description:
Any experienced shaman who attempts to scry the elemental plane can tell you that there is a blip of sorts, a distortion that you feel as you cross over to the other realms of existence.

We have need of adventurers like yourself to help us better understand this disturbance. Take this Elemental Attractor. You will be able to extract motes of unstable magic with it from the most skilled spellcasters and other powerful entities you may encounter. Bring me these motes so that we may study them.
98477.objectivesText: Bring $1oa Motes of Unstable Magic to Nuara Tremorhoof.
98477.title: Unstable Magic

98576.description: Ah, while you were gone a parchment came for you, $n.$B$BRead it when you have time. If I'm not mistaken, it came from the mage trainer Mai'ah. She would have words with you when you're ready.
98576.objectivesText: Read the Glyphic Parchment and speak with Mai'ah near the entrance to the Den in the Valley of Trials.
98576.title: Glyphic Parchment

98823.description:
Truly, this is a fascinating object.

It shows indications of being much more than a mere carving or sculpture.

While our elders may be interested in observing this artifact, the Earthen Ring are who would carry the most wisdom for our buried ruins and forgotten lands. Seek out Muln Earthfury, a direct approach is fitting for the gravity of what you carry.

You can find him and other elders of the Earthen Ring council at the Skywatcher Plateau in northwest Mulgore.
98823.objectivesText: Bring the Titan Relic to Muln Earthfury at the Skywatcher Plateau in northwest Mulgore.
98823.title: Earthen Echo

98891.description: The Theramore Expeditionary Force are tenacious and continue to send reinforcements to bolster their position on the Darkspear Islands. $B$BGo, show them the might of the horde! Bring me the evidence of your victory in this key battleground and you will be well rewarded.
98891.objectivesText: Bring 3 Darkspear Islands Marks of Honor to a Horde Warbringer outside the battlegrounds.
98891.title: Conflict at Darkspear Islands

98897.description: The battle against the Darkspear Raiders is heating up. Without urgent aid, the Darkspear Islands will be lost to us. $B$BIt is your duty as a proud member of the Alliance to ensure this does not happen. Bring me proof of your contributions on the front lines and you will be revered as a hero of the Alliance!
98897.objectivesText: Bring 3 Darkspear Islands Marks of Honor to an Alliance Brigadier General outside the battlegrounds.
98897.title: Darkspear Islands Clash

98899.description: The battle against the Darkspear Raiders is heating up. Without urgent aid, the Darkspear Islands will be lost to us. $B$BIt is your duty as a proud member of the Alliance to ensure this does not happen. Bring me proof of your contributions on the front lines and you will be revered as a hero of the Alliance!
98899.objectivesText: Bring 3 Darkspear Islands Marks of Honor to an Alliance Brigadier General outside the battlegrounds.
98899.title: Darkspear Islands Clash

98903.description: Go forth and represent the Theramore Expeditionary Force in battle at Darkspear Islands, $n! Achieve victory and show these Horde dogs the might of the Alliance!
98903.objectivesText: Win a Darkspear Islands battleground and return back to Brelinda McFarry at Northwatch Hold.
98903.title: The Battle for Darkspear Islands!

98904.description: Go forth and represent the Theramore Expeditionary Force in battle at Darkspear Islands, $n! Achieve victory and show these Horde dogs the might of the Alliance!
98904.objectivesText: Win a Darkspear Islands battleground and return back to Brelinda McFarry at Northwatch Hold.
98904.title: The Battle for Darkspear Islands!

98907.description: The battle at the Darkspear Islands be locked in a stalemate, $c. Show those Alliance fools who the superior force is. Carry your head high in service of the Darkspear and claim victory in battle. The Loa will surely be givin' you their blessing, $c!
98907.objectivesText: Win a Darkspear Islands battleground and return back to Nizook Boof at The Merchant Coast.
98907.title: The Battle for Darkspear Islands!

98908.description:
The battle at the Darkspear Islands be locked in a stalemate, $c. Show those Alliance fools who the superior force is. 

Carry your head high in service of the Darkspear and claim victory in battle. The Loa will surely be givin' you their blessing, $c!
98908.objectivesText: Win a Darkspear Islands battleground and return back to Nizook Boof at The Merchant Coast.
98908.title: The Battle for Darkspear Islands!

98917.description: You've handed the horde a decisive defeat at the Darkspear Islands, and now it's time to break their spirits once and for all. Dominate the battlefield utterly, and defeat the enemy while controlling all four outposts. $B$BDo this and show the Horde the unrelenting supremacy of The Theramore Expeditionary Force.

objectives.text: Win Darkspear Islands while controlling all four bases

98917.objectivesText: Win in Darkspear Islands while holding all four bases at the same time, then return to Brelinda McFarry at Northwatch Hold.
98917.title: Darkspear Island Domination

99047.description:
My sisters and I... were dispatched... Oracle Tree...

Tree... message. I... harpies... everywhere...

<Eralya coughs up blood, grimacing through the pain.>

I may not have long... no one coming. Please... Byancie... in Dolanaar...
99047.objectivesText: Seek aid from Byancie in Dolanaar for Sentinel Eralya Leafshadow.
99047.title: Not Dead Yet

99050.description:
I will need your help acquiring the ingredients I need to stop the affliction long enough for Eralya to make it back here for further treatment.

Thankfully, our living home is still bountiful and will provide in our time of need.

The core ingredient is dewy lasher fronds. You'll find them around Lake Al'Ameth directly south of here, or Wellspring Lake and its river to the northwest.

In addition, I'll need an empty vial and some spring water. Both can be bought here in town, or traded for.
99050.objectivesText: Collect $1oa Dewy Lasher Fronds, an Empty Vial, and a Refreshing Spring Water for Byancie in Dolanaar.
99050.title: The Great Tree Provides

99053.areaDescription: Escort Lynessa Duskblossom out of Ban'ethil
99053.description:
My prayers have been answered! I am thankful that you have fought your way down here.

I was sent here by the Oracle Tree to deliver a message to the slumbering druids here only to find it completely overrun by furbolg! They ambushed me before I could turn back and brought me down here--I fear for their next meal.

I don't know about you, but I loathe this place. Under the earth is no place for the kaldorei.
99053.objectivesText: Help Sentinel Lynessa Duskblossom escape Ban'ethil Barrow Den, and report her safety to Sentinel Kyra Starsong in Dolanaar.
99053.title: Escaping Ban'ethil

99080.description:
Hear my words well: we will not yield a single blade of grass to the centaur.

Go to their camp now, before they have rested and have a chance to ride to our village. Slaughter them all. Ensure none escape to the Barrens to rally others to their aid.

If you find the leader of this would-be raiding party, bring me his head so that it may serve as a warning to others who dare tread on our ancestral homeland.
99080.objectivesText: Kill $1oa Galak Centaurs, $2oa Galak Outrunners, and bring the head of Herak the Pillager to Baine Bloodhoof.
99080.title: Drive Them Out

99081.description:
You can see what appears to be a new centaur camp in the direction the arrows in Malah's back would have come from. There is a stir of activity, suggesting a small raiding party has made its way into Mulgore.

The Longwalker has a report in her still-clenched hand. Brave Wildrunner will want to know of Malah's fate--and her killers.
99081.objectivesText: Bring Longwalker Malah's Report to Brave Wildrunner in Bloodhoof Village.
99081.title: Grim Tidings

99082.description:
Your bravery defending your people demands recognition. Journey to Thunder Bluff to the northwest, our mighty city whose shadow grants us shade in the warmer months, and seek audience with my father.

It was he who led the charge with the young Warchief Thrall to reclaim these plains and drive the centaur away for good. As High Chieftain, he will reward you generously for your part in ensuring his own bravery is honored.

You must take a lift to reach the High Chieftain, who sits on the central rise.
99082.objectivesText: Seek audience with High Chieftain Cairne Bloodhoof in Thunder Bluff.
99082.title: The High Chieftain

conditionalDescriptions.text:
Hail, young warrior. Our journey together shall take many strides, but this step is no less important than the others.

Before you lies the arena. In it, it matters not who you call mother or whether you wield sword or mace. All are equal, and all learn to sharpen their horns in direct combat.

Enter our space, and learn through combat. You may face any of these novices, or any other willing adversary. I care not which.

99108.description:
Hail, young $c. Though you are not a warrior and I cannot teach you that path, that does not mean you would not benefit from my tutelage.

Before you lies the arena. In it, it matters not who you call mother or whether you wield sword or bow. All are equal, and all learn to sharpen their horns in direct combat.

Will you enter our space, and learn our ways for yourself? You may face any of these novices, or any other willing adversary. I care not which.

objectives.text: Player Duels won or Novice Warriors defeated

99108.objectivesText: Defeat 3 other players in duels or Novice Warriors for Tang Stonehoof.
99108.title: Sparring Match

99127.description:
The fish just ain't biting today, and there's something wrong going on with them. It's not just empty hooks. I haven't seen a single minnow up in the water at all.

Lee here set up some traps overnight. Go check to see if we've at least got some stock there. If you find anything weird, make sure to show me.
99127.objectivesText: Check the fishing traps in Crystal Lake.
99127.title: A Net Disaster

99144.areaDescription: Escort Bareth Dawnstone out of Crusader's Outpost

conditionalDescriptions.text:
Light bless you for finding me. I was on my way from Bandarion Keep to deliver a message to Shari Stilwell in Brill when these monsters captured me. They wield the Light with a hatred in their hearts that makes what's left of my blood seethe. It goes against all we stand for!

<Bareth Dawnstone steadies himself.>

Our ranks are thin. If you would aid me in escaping this place, I would be forever grateful.

99144.description:
Light bless you for finding me. I was on my way from Bandarion Keep to deliver a message to Shari Stilwell in Brill when these monsters captured me. They wield the Light with a hatred in their hearts that makes what's left of my blood seethe. It goes against all I meditate for... all I strive to protect!

<Bareth Dawnstone steadies himself.>

I know some still take issue with my kind, but I assure you our intentions are pure. If you would aid me in escaping this place, I would be forever grateful.
99144.objectivesText: Help Bareth Dawnstone escape Crusader's Outpost, and report his safety to Shari Stilwell in Brill.
99144.title: Seeking Refuge

99152.description:
While the Tarnished in Shadowvale to the southwest are definitely a problem, we cannot allow the cellars below the town to fester into a full-blown Scourge uprising on Bandarion Keep.

I need to get these trainees up to snuff in case that happens. You, however, are going to receive what I like to call a crash course.

Travel beneath Shadowvale and retrieve some of their wretched bones so we can study them further. I need ones that still retain some of the initial reanimation magic--that's glowing ones.
99152.objectivesText: Collect $1oa Faintly Glowing Bones for Hilda the Breaker.
99152.title: As Above, So Below

99153.description:
Oi, you! Word travels quickly among our ranks. I heard about the work you did with the cultists around the remnants of the battle with Naxxramas.

Problem is, one of them cultists got away with a piece of the focusing crystal. Seems to still have some juice in it. Best guess we have is it's somewhere beneath Shadowvale. It's either raising 'em or making 'em stronger, and you don't want either one.

Find that crystal before this gets out of hand.
99153.objectivesText: Find the Hidden Crystal Fragment beneath Shadowvale for Ephram Barbaro.
99153.title: The One That Got Away

99161.description:
I noticed that the first elemental that appeared after the rockslide was larger than its peers. And from what I can tell, it has been the source of occasional weather changes and other minor slides.

I've been calling it 'Avala', if you could kill it and retrieve the core as proof, I will reward you.
99161.objectivesText: Kill Avala and retrieve its core.
99161.title: Rime's Wrath

99202.description:
Greeting once more, $c. The time has come for you learn to ride one of our grandest mounts--the armored kodo.

Harb will provide you with a free mount once ye have completed your training with me, and after you will be able to purchase any additional mounts you would like, just as before.

This will be expensive, but speak to me when you have enough coin. I will finish your training.
99202.objectivesText: Learn the Journeyman Riding skill from Kar Stormsinger.
99202.title: Swift as the Wind

99203.description:
Ah, you've returned. Very good. Are you ready to learn to ride an armored galestrider?

As before, if you take the next step in your training with me, I will provide you with a free mount, and after you will be able to purchase any additional mounts you would like. 

It won't be cheap, but speak to me when you have enough coin. I will teach you about riding armored galestriders.
99203.objectivesText: Learn the Journeyman Riding skill from Genn Fairweather.
99203.title: Swift as the Wind

99204.description:
You have returned. Good. It's time to take your next steps. 

Ogunaro will provide you with a free mount once you have completed your final leg of training with me, and after you will be able to purchase any additional mounts you would like, as before.

Speak to me when you have enough gold, and I will finish your training.
99204.objectivesText: Learn the Journeyman Riding skill from Kildar.
99204.title: Swift as the Wind

99205.description:
You've returned, $n. Very good. It's time to learn to ride a proper mount, your armored sabercat.

Lelanai will provide you with a free mount once ye have trained with me, and after you will be able to purchase any additional mounts ye would like. There are many creatures out in the world, and each requires their own riding skill, but you will have to find trainers for each.

Speak to me when you have enough coin, and I will teach you all I know about riding sabers.
99205.objectivesText: Learn the Journeyman Riding skill from Jartsam.
99205.title: Swift as the Wind

99206.description:
I'm glad you made your way back to me. I can tell by the scratches on your skin and the dirt on your armor that you've seen much of the world. It's time we got you a proper steed.

Katie will provide you with a free mount once ye have completed the final leg of your training with me, and after you will be able to purchase any additional mounts you would like just as before.

Speak to me when you have enough coin, and I will teach you all I know about riding armored horses.
99206.objectivesText: Learn the Journeyman Riding skill from Randal Hunter.
99206.title: Swift as the Wind

99208.description:
You are back. Good. It's time for you to learn to master the steed of a true Forsaken--the skeletal warhorse.

Zachariah will provide you with a free mount once you have completed the final round of your training with me, and after you will be able to purchase any additional mounts you desire.

Speak to me when you have enough coin, and I will teach you about skeletal warhorses.
99208.objectivesText: Learn the Journeyman Riding skill from Velma Warnam.
99208.title: Swift as the Wind

conditionalDescriptions.text:
Greetings, paladin. I must admit I am surprised to see one of your order here at my stables.

If you are looking for a mount, you have come to the right place, though they may pale in comparison to the chargers you are accustomed to.

Regardless, I encourage you to peruse our steeds, should you want one. Ours are some of the finest steeds in the land, and even though you radiate with holy power they should still bear you as faithfully and without issue.

Go examine the undead horses to see if any are to your liking and return to me when you have made your choice.

Greetings, warlock. I must admit I am surprised to see one of your talents here at my stables.

If you are looking for a mount, you have come to the right place, though they may pale in comparison to the felsteeds you are accustomed to summoning.

Regardless, I encourage you to peruse our steeds, should you want one. Ours are some of the finest steeds in the land, and they should still bear you as faithfully as your summoned infernal felsteed.

Though I would advise against lighting the skeletal horses on fire. That is an aesthetic best saved for the unholy creatures you and your council conjure.

Go examine the undead horses to see if any are to your liking and return to me when you have made your choice.

99211.description:
Greetings, $n. I didn't expect to see you back to my humble stables again so soon.

You certainly have had quite a journey. I think I can guess what has brought you here today.

You now have enough power, experience and skill to ride our deftest and most fearsome warhorses. These armored fiends will bear you through any trial, even past the gates of death itself. 

Go examine the armored undead warhorses and return to me when you have made your choice.
99211.objectivesText: Inspect the armored undead riding warhorses to choose your epic mount.
99211.title: An Epic Ride

conditionalDescriptions.text:
Greetings, paladin! I must admit I am surprised to see one of your order here at my stables.

If you are looking for a mount, you have come to the right place, though they may pale in comparison to the chargers you are accustomed to.

Regardless, I encourage you to peruse our steeds, should you want one. Ours are some of the finest steeds in the land. These steeds are descendants from both the historical Lordaeron stock and our own local horses. You won't find a more steadfast companion for your journeys.

Go examine the horses to see if any are to your liking and return to me when you have made your choice.

Greetings, warlock. I must admit I am surprised to see one of your talents here at my stables.

If you are looking for a mount, you have come to the right place, though they may pale in comparison to the felsteeds you are accustomed to summoning.

Regardless, I encourage you to peruse our steeds, should you want one. Ours are some of the finest steeds in the land, and they should still bear you as faithfully as your summoned infernal felsteed.

Go examine the horses to see if any are to your liking and return to me when you have made your choice.

99213.description:
Greetings, $n! I am so glad to see you've returned to us.

It would seem you have enough experience to ride our fastest and fiercest steeds. You won't find a more steadfast companion for your journeys.

Choosing one may be difficult as they are all excellent and trained to be steady even when in danger. Some may even recognize you from the last time you were here.

Go and examine the armored horses and return to me when you have made your choice.
99213.objectivesText: Inspect the armored riding horses to choose your epic mount.
99213.title: An Epic Ride

conditionalDescriptions.text:
Ey, warlock! I must admit I be surprised to see one of your talents here at me stables.

If you are looking for a mount, ya have come to the right place, though they ain't the same as those felsteeds you are accustomed to summoning.

Either way, you're welcome to take a look at our raptors, should ya want one. Most be underestimatin' how intelligent and savage these beasts be. Ya won't be findin' a better, faster or more lethal companion once ya be bonded with it.

Go an' take a look to see if any catch ya interest and return to me when ya made ya choice.

99218.description:
Ey, $n! Today be a big day for ya, I see. It seems ya be ready to take de reins of our fastest and fiercest raptors. 

Now that you be ridin' a raptor, you know how intelligent and savage these beasts be. I think you be ready for a real raptor now. An armored raptor.

So, you be havin' an important choice to make. Ya raptor and ya will be traversin' the world together, and the raptor will also be needin' to choose ya in return.

Go an' take a look and return ta me when ya made ya choice.
99218.objectivesText: Inspect the armored riding raptors to choose your epic mount.
99218.title: An Epic Ride

99233.description: There must be more to the Maul than this!$B$BPerhaps the loud Spectator who oversees the event at Dire Maul will know!
99233.objectivesText: Speak with Griniblix the Spectator above the Maul in Dire Maul.
99233.title: Brawl at the Maul

conditionalDescriptions.text:
Greetings, paladin! I must admit I am surprised to see one of your order here at my stables.

If you are looking for a mount, you have come to the right place, though they may pale in comparison to the chargers you are accustom to.

Regardless, I encourage you to peruse our steeds, should you want one. Ours are some of the finest steeds in the land. These steeds are descendants from both the historical Lordaeron stock and our own local horses. You won't find a more steadfast companion for your journeys.

Go examine the horses to see if any are to your liking and return to me when you have made your choice.

Greetings, warlock. I must admit I am surprised to see one of your talents here at my stables.

If you are looking for a mount, you have come to the right place, though they may pale in comparison to the felsteeds you are accustom to summoning.

Regardless, I encourage you to peruse our steeds, should you want one. Ours are some of the finest steeds in the land, and they should still bear you as faithfully as your summoned infernal felsteed.

Go examine the horses to see if any are to your liking and return to me when you have made your choice.

99367.description:
Greetings, $n! I am so glad to see you've returned to us.

It would seem you have enough experience to ride our fastest and fiercest steeds. You won't find a more steadfast companion for your journeys.

Choosing one may be difficult as they are all excellent and trained to be steady even when in danger. Some may even recognize you from the last time you were here.

Go and examine the armored horses and return to me when you have made your choice.
99367.objectivesText: Inspect the armored riding horses to choose your epic mount.
99367.title: An Epic Ride

99435.description:
Windsor has already set off to confront Lady Prestor in Stormwind Keep, $c. He spoke highly of your bravery. I suggest you hurry to his aid!

He is now certain that Prestor is Onyxia: Brood of Deathwing, twin to the tyrant of the Spire, Nefarian.

According to him, even the Highlord is controlled by her trickery! The Marshal intends to break the spell and free all of Stormwind from the dark shadow of these fiends.

Find him and ensure the deed is done!
99435.objectivesText:
Follow Reginald Windsor through Stormwind. Protect him from harm!

Speak to Squire Rowe if you need to contact Reginald Windsor again.
99435.title: The Great Masquerade

99670.description:
Jereman is fortunate to be alive. It sounds like she fled from the lodge in quite the hurry, no doubt thrilled to be freed from her predicament. 

She will wish to speak with you. Go, find her.
99670.objectivesText: Return to Jereman at the Cradle of Tranquility.
99670.title: Return to Jereman
